jobs.description:
Why work with us?

We are a fast-growing company that is revolutionizing the world of SaaS platform and data in Latin America!

CIAL Dun & Bradstreet is the leading provider of business decisioning solutions and commercial data across Latin America and the Caribbean. Our solutions are designed to transform how businesses manage risk and make critical decisions about the companies they rely on.

It’s our people, not technology, that makes what we do possible. It’s our people, not data, that turns information into insights. And it’s our people, not algorithms, that help our clients make better informed decisions. We are innovative, agile, and inspired by SaaS solutions and data – and we are looking for people that share those values to join our mission to build stronger businesses!

About Us

Dunsguide, by CIAL Dun & Bradstreet, is transforming how Latin American businesses discover and evaluate potential partners. As the region's leading platform for customer prospecting and supplier discovery, we help companies make smarter, data-driven decisions about their business relationships. We're growing rapidly and expanding our suite of solutions that combine deep business intelligence with modern, intuitive tools.

Sobre a posição

Você fará parte da Squad New + AI, responsável por desenvolver a nova geração de produtos de dados da CIAL, incluindo APIs, serviços e iniciativas de IA aplicada. Procuramos alguém com sólida experiência em Python e engenharia de software, que tenha interesse em construir sistemas escaláveis e explorar o uso de LLMs e agentes em produtos reais.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver novos serviços e APIs em Python com foco em qualidade, desempenho e escalabilidade.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções seguindo boas práticas de arquitetura e engenharia de software.
  • Construir e manter pipelines de dados e workflows utilizando ferramentas como Prefect ou similares.
  • Trabalhar em iniciativas de IA aplicada, incluindo agentes, Document AI, RAG e automação de processos.
  • Participar das decisões de arquitetura e evolução técnica dos produtos.
  • Escrever testes automatizados e contribuir para a qualidade do código através de code reviews.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Forte experiência com Python para desenvolvimento backend.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de APIs REST e serviços.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e SQL.
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados e/ou ferramentas de orquestração de workflows (como Prefect, Airflow ou similares).
  • Conhecimento de testes automatizados e boas práticas de qualidade de software.
  • Experiência com Git, code review e processos colaborativos de desenvolvimento.
  • Conhecimento de princípios de arquitetura de software e boas práticas de design.
  • Experiência de no minimo 5 anos em Python
  • Inglês avançado

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com FastAPI.
  • Experiência com LLMs, agentes, RAG ou outras soluções de IA aplicada.
  • Experiência com Document AI ou extração estruturada de documentos.
  • Conhecimento em Docker, Kubernetes e plataformas cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento de aplicações.

O que esperamos

Procuramos alguém que:

  • Tenha autonomia técnica e senso de responsabilidade.
  • Goste de discutir arquitetura e propor melhorias.
  • Escreva código limpo, sustentável e de fácil manutenção.
  • Valorize testes, qualidade e boas práticas de engenharia.
  • Tenha curiosidade para aprender novas tecnologias e explorar IA aplicada.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Resident Solutions Architect (Databricks)

Location: Fully Remote (in the US) *Some travel depending on end client needs/projects

Number of openings: Many

Experience: 10+ years

Salary: $80-90/hr W2 or $95-105 C2C

Start Date: Open roles, 2-4 week process (faster for strong candidates!

Job Description:

Core Responsibilities

Some of the major responsibilities for an RSA are:

  • Engage with customers on short- to mid-term professional services projects using the Databricks platform (data engineering, data science, cloud).

  • Design and build reference architectures, help with production-level use cases and deployments of big data / AI applications.

  • Collaborate with engagement/project managers, customer teams, and internal engineering/support teams to ensure technical delivery meets customer needs

  • Provide escalated technical support or operational assistance for customer engagements, helping to resolve issues or unblock customers

  • Work hands-on: write code (e.g., Python, Scala), work with distributed compute (Apache Spark), integrate across cloud ecosystems.

  • Possibly scope new engagements, support sales or pre-sales (depending on region/team) by estimating effort, defining deliverables.

  • Provide feedback to product/engineering from customer engagements (help improve platform, features

Required Skills & Qualifications

an RSA typically needs:

  • Several years (often 8+ years) in data engineering, analytics, platform roles.

  • Strong coding ability in Python or Scala, and comfortable with distributed processing (Spark).

  • Experience working across at least one cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP) and preferably familiarity with multiple.

  • Knowledge of production deployments: CI/CD, MLOps, data architectures.

  • Good client-facing / consulting / customer engagement skills (communicating technical ideas, scoping projects, working with customer teams).

  • What You Should Expect from the Role

  • It's billable professional services: you'll often be working as a consultant/embedded engineer with customers, delivering real implementations rather than purely strategy.

  • The role is technically deep: you'll not only design solutions but often build them, debug issues, optimize performance.

Because it is delivery-oriented, you may deal with customer escalations and operational issues, not just green-field new builds.

  • You'll need adaptability: customers across industries, various workloads (ETL, streaming, AI/ML), different cloud platforms.

  • The role also helps the customer adopt Databricks, so you're enabling change in how they think about data/AI, not just delivering code

  • Role of an RSA

    • Be a trusted advisor with authority and clarity.

    • Set expectations and simplify complex ideas.

    • Earn trust early, even before delivering technical work.

    • Align with the customer, listen actively, and empathize with their concerns.

    • Always under-promise and over-deliver.

  • Strategic Nature of PS Consulting

    • Focus on solving problems to build trust and unlock future work.

    • Use clear, jargon-free communication.

    • Identify stakeholders, understand drivers of change, and mitigate risks.

    • Offer quick-win alternatives to free up customer bandwidth for strategic tasks.

  • Build vs. Buy Mitigation

    • Assess if building aligns with the company's core competencies or adds technical debt.

    • Ask: Does owning this make you money, or is it a cost center?

    • Highlight Databricks' value proposition in scalability and maintainability.

    • Empathize—custom solutions are often someone's baby.

    • Offer bake-offs to demonstrate Databricks' strengths.

    • Position Databricks as a career-enabler over maintaining fragile systems.

  • Spark Performance & Business Disruption Concerns

    • Educate the customer—understand the specifics: data size, current framework, future scaling needs.

    • Clarify if Spark is truly the bottleneck.

    • Offer bake-offs on speed, performance, and cost.

    • Build a clear, phased migration plan with deliverables.

    • Coordinate with the account team to align messaging and reinforce trust.

  • UC Feature Gaps & Overpromising

    • Determine if missing features are true blockers.

    • Educate the account team on PUPR (Public Preview) vs. GA (General Availability).

    • If necessary, build lightweight custom solutions to bridge gaps.

    • Re-align customer expectations with reality and roadmap.

7+ years experience in data eng, data platforms & analytics,

10+ years of consulting experience

Completed Data Engineering Professional certification & required classes

Minimum 6-8+ projects delivered with hands-on experience in development on databricks

Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with deep expertise in at least one

Deep experience with distributed computing with Spark with knowledge of Spark runtime internals

Familiarity with CI/CD for production deployments

Working knowledge of MLOps

Current knowledge across the breadth of Databricks product and platform features

Familiarity with optimizations for performance and scalability

jobs.excerpt: About DoitWe are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more.
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for product engineers to own product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in the United States. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in the United States.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Overview

As a Contracts Manager at Linesight, you will work with highly experienced, culturally diverse, and passionate teams nurturing a strong social dynamic and a shared sense of achievement. You will gain vast industry experience that will open doors for you, extend your skillset and expand your perspective. We will empower, support, and enable you to take real responsibility in your role so that you can take charge of your career progression with us. The Opportunity

In this role you will:

  • Administer the tender process across multiple contracts from GCs to professional consultant appointments
  • Track and manage tender process steps including bidder prequalification, tender issue, queries and responses, tender submissions, and post-tender queries and negotiation.
  • Draft contracts and collate contract documentation
  • Oversee post-contract management, including providing contract administration advice to the client, claims tracking, and producing and processing contract change orders
  • Partner closely with the construction project management and cost management teams
  • Work with the commercial team to advise the client on contract award

We would love to hear from you if you:

  • Have a working knowledge of local and international contract laws and corporate policies
  • Are a proven people leader
  • Have excellent negotiation, persuasion and judgment skills
  • Are an excellent communicator verbally and in writing
  • Are detail oriented and quality focused

All interviews are conducted either in person or virtually with video required.

The salary range for this role is between $108,000 to $145,067 but actual salary offered is dependent on experience, skill set and education.

Linesight offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and professional growth. Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid time off, paid holidays and educational assistance.

About us

Linesight is a highly successful global project and cost management consultancy that keeps clients coming back. And for that we have our people to thank. You see we’re not like the others. We’re different. Unique. It’s our fresh thinking and focus on what matters that has led to our evolving. We are on a journey working in some of the most exciting innovative sectors with some of the world’s most prestigious companies delivering major projects that deliver a more sustainable built environment. We have an open culture and a flat structure where you can expect to be treated with genuine care, respect, and empathy. With Linesight, you can truly discover the power of team!

Diversity, inclusion and accessibility

Linesight is committed to transparent, equal opportunity employment practices. We are building a diverse and inclusive organisation, accessible to all, based on having a safe culture which enables all our people to be their true selves. We are a people business, and we understand that the more inclusive we are, the happier our people and better our work will be. We will ensure that individuals with disability are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or recruitment process and are accommodated in the workplace. If you require assistance or accommodation of any kind, please mention this in your application, we would love to hear from you!

AHCCCS

Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System
Accountability, Community, Innovation, Leadership, Passion, Quality, Respect, Courage, Teamwork

The Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS), Arizona’s Medicaid agency, is driven by its mission to deliver comprehensive, cost-effective health care to Arizonans in need. AHCCCS employees are passionate about their work, committed to high performance, and dedicated to serving the citizens of Arizona. Among government agencies, AHCCCS is recognized for high employee engagement and satisfaction, supportive leadership, and flexible work environments, including remote work opportunities. With career paths for seasoned professionals in a variety of fields, entry-level positions, and internship opportunities, AHCCCS offers meaningful career opportunities in a competitive industry.

Come join our dynamic and dedicated team.

Executive Assistant

Office of the Director (OOD)

Job Location:

Address: 150 North 18th Avenue Phoenix, Arizona 85007

All AHCCCS Employees must reside within the state of Arizona.

Posting Details:

Salary: $40,000 - $45,000

Grade: 19

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

This position will remain open until filled.

Job Summary:

The Executive Assistant will support and report to the Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) and provide administrative support to the Compliance Office. Duties include managing the CCO's calendar and meeting requests; coordinating meetings and preparing meeting materials; documenting decisions, minutes, and action items; managing correspondence and confidential records; tracking deadlines and follow-up activities; and supporting office administration, onboarding, travel, and other operational needs.

Major duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to:
• Schedule and manage the Chief Compliance Officer's extensive calendar of internal and external meetings. Coordinate meeting requests, correspondence, executive communications, participants, logistics, agendas, briefing materials, and scheduling conflicts; prepare and distribute meeting materials; and record meeting minutes or summaries as assigned.
• Provide general administrative and executive support to the CCO and the Compliance Office. Organize and prioritize requests; prepare routine correspondence; proofread and format documents, presentations, and communications; coordinate review, signature, and approval routing; and maintain contact and distribution lists. Maintain administrative trackers for policy reviews, training activities, reporting deadlines, audit and regulatory requests, assigned corrective actions, and other Compliance Office commitments; monitor due dates and status; request updates from assigned owners; and elevate unresolved deadlines, dependencies, or barriers.
• Provide administrative support for committees, work-groups, and other governance activities supported or led by the CCO. Coordinate meetings, agendas, materials, attendance tracking, minutes, decision records, and action-item follow-up; and maintain governance documentation, records, and committee or work-group archives in accordance with applicable records-retention requirements.
• Maintain confidential Compliance Office records and administrative workflow documentation.
• Responsible for processing in-state and out-of-state travel requests for the Compliance Office. This includes submitting travel justifications for approval, processing the travel claims once travel is complete, and submitting for Director approval and financial reimbursement.
• Process and coordinate approved travel, registration, invoice, supply, and equipment requests.
• Support Compliance Office information, communication, executive reporting, and administrative continuity needs. Assemble routine status updates, dashboards, briefing materials, and executive reports using information supplied and validated by responsible owners; review materials for completeness, consistency, formatting, and timely submission; and highlight overdue items, unresolved dependencies, and decisions requiring the attention of the CCO or appropriate Compliance Office lead. Maintain approved communication materials, shared administrative resources, templates, and continuity documentation.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs):

Knowledge of:
• Executive-level office administration, calendar management, meeting coordination, and workflow tracking
• Business writing, correspondence preparation, proofreading, document formatting, and version control
• Data retention, records management, confidentiality, information security, and appropriate access practices
• Committee and meeting administration, including agendas, minutes, decision records, action items, accountable owners, deadlines, and follow-up

Skilled in:

• Document editing, proofreading, formatting, and quality control

Ability to:

• Work with confidential, sensitive, privileged, personnel-related, investigative, audit, risk, and executive information while maintaining confidentiality
• Work independently within established guidelines and seek direction when authority or responsibility is unclear

Qualifications:

Minimum:

Preferred:

Experience providing administrative support in a government, healthcare, Medicaid, regulatory, audit, legal, compliance, risk-management, or similarly sensitive environment. Experience managing complex executive calendars and preparing agendas, minutes, decision records, and action-item tracking. jobs.description:
Takeoff Assistant

  • Work Type: Full-time.

  • Schedule: Standard US business hours, with occasional overtime and weekend work required based on bid schedules and workload demands.

  • Location: 100% Remote.

Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Takeoff Assistant for a highly focused production role designed to increase the overall throughput and capacity of our estimating department. By performing detailed quantitative take-offs and compiling initial material quotes, you will allow Senior Estimators to focus on advanced scope compilation, margin strategy, and final verification. This role is ideal for a process-driven professional looking to minimize risk and accelerate bid output while advancing their estimating career based on demonstrated competency and growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Digital Quantification: Perform highly accurate, digital quantity takeoffs for various disciplines (including Low Slope, Steep Slope, Glazing, and Cladding) utilizing Bluebeam and Edge Estimating software.

  • Quote Compilation: Solicit, receive, and compile quotes from material suppliers and vendors, organizing them effectively for the Senior Estimator’s review.

  • Data Entry & Processing: Input foundational takeoff quantities and baseline material pricing into the designated estimating systems.

  • Project Handoff: Package the completed takeoff and compiled quotes cleanly, handing them off to the Senior Estimator for final compilation, verification, and pricing strategy.

  • Continuous Improvement: Meet established production metrics, actively apply coaching and feedback to reduce errors, and consistently develop your estimating skills and accuracy.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: Entry-level to 2 years of professional experience in construction, estimating, or a related field.

  • Technical Proficiency: Willingness and ability to learn industry estimating software (e.g., Bluebeam, Edge Estimating) and standard data entry tools.

  • Core Competencies: Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy. Strong ability to follow established processes, take direction, and reliably meet production metrics. Must be able to pass a pre-employment screening.

  • Remote Infrastructure: Must have a dedicated, noise-free home office setup equipped with a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a backup power source.

Preferred Qualifications (Bonus):

  • Basic familiarity with construction drawings, blueprints, and industry terminology.

Benefits of Working for Hyre

Nice to Have’s

jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Parexel FSP is looking for a Manager, Central Monitoring to join our team in Argentina!


Job Overview

The Manager, Central Monitoring is accountable for centralized monitoring activities for global and/or complex trials, analytical data review of key risk and/or operational performance data and presenting as an integral member of the Clinical Study team for clinical development studies. The reviews include interpretation of Key Risk Indicator (KRI) and/or Key Performance Indicator (KPI) data housed in an analytical tool as well as a comprehensive review of supplemental operational data/trends and issues to be interpreted, reported and presented to the study teams. The Manager, Central Monitoring, will be responsible for supporting several studies within a therapeutic area and program-level. They will work closely with other Central Monitors and Centralized Data Risk Analysts (CDRAs) to ensure effective identification, conduct and reporting of central monitoring activities. This role will contribute to continued process improvement and innovation activities, and industry collaborations in central monitoring capabilities.


Job Description

JOB DUTIES:

  • Collaborate on Study Quality Risk Assessment: Participate in the development and refinement of the Study Quality Risk Assessment and Control Tracker (QRACT) to identify and manage study risks.
  • Develop and Author the Central Monitoring Plan: Lead the creation of the Central Monitoring Plan, ensuring alignment with study-specific needs and Risk Based Quality Management (RBQM) methodologies.
  • Oversee Central Monitoring Execution: Work with data analysts to configure, implement, and execute the Central Monitoring RBQM system across assigned studies, ensuring effective signal detection.
  • Analyze and Interpret Data Trends: Conduct study-level Central Monitoring Reviews using data analysis tools, interpret KRIs/KPIs, and assess trends to identify areas requiring intervention.
  • Facilitate Study Team Decisions: Present findings to clinical study teams, support root cause analysis, and provide recommendations for follow-up actions to address identified risks.
  • Document and Track Actions: Document outputs from Central Monitoring Review meetings, track decisions, and ensure timely closure of actions.
  • Act as Central Monitoring subject matter expert. Represent Central Monitoring as a subject matter expert during audits, inspections, and within study teams on client processes.
  • Provide Oversight of Contract Research Organization (CRO) Activities: Partner with outsourcing management to align monitoring strategies and ensure CRO partners execute Central Monitoring activities according to the agreed standards.
  • Drive Process Improvements: Evaluate the effectiveness of Central Monitoring processes, identify areas for improvement, and recommend enhancements to tools, metrics, and methodologies.
  • Represent Central Monitoring in Initiatives: Represent the function in cross-functional process improvement initiatives and assess emerging technologies to enhance Central Monitoring capabilities.

Knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the job

  • Strong analytical problem-solving and critical thinking abilities, with experience troubleshooting data refreshes and resolving execution errors in analytical systems.
  • Working knowledge of the clinical drug development process, including ICH, GCP guidelines, and regulatory requirements
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills; ability to build relationships internally and externally
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and interpret current and future business trends and apply them to centralized monitoring practices
  • Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and analytical insights in a clear and concise manner
  • Aptitude for mathematical concepts, statistical methodologies, and data analytics, with a focus on interpreting KRIs and KPIs
  • Knowledge and experience with clinical databases, electronic data capture systems, quality control processes, and auditing procedures
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, with advanced skills in Excel for data manipulation and reporting
  • Preferred: Experience using CluePoints or similar centralized monitoring system.

Minimal educational requirements:

  • High School Diploma
  • Associates Degree
  • Bachelors Degree
  • Masters Degree
  • Ph.D.
  • PharmD
  • MD
  • Board Certified MD

Minimum Years of Experience:

At least 7 years of relevant experience in the biotechnology/pharmaceutical industry, with a minimum of 1 year with direct Central Monitoring experience. Site monitoring or data management experience a plus.

  • Own the complete operational lifecycle end-to-end - infrastructure, reliability, on-call, incident response, and blameless post-mortems - as one integrated engineering charter, not a separate function.

  • Drive developer delight and operational efficiency through automation, self-service tooling, and streamlined workflows for deploying and managing API gateways, while proactively preventing technical debt and reducing operational toil.

  • Define, track, and report on key SLOs and SLIs, and advocate for architectural best practices that keep Managed Gateways performant and resilient as it scales.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, engineering, and support teams to influence roadmap decisions and ensure operational readiness for new features.

What You'll Bring

The Toolkit:

  • Proven experience leading and managing software engineering teams responsible for infrastructure and reliability in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with a track record of staying technically hands-on rather than purely delegating.

  • Deep, current expertise in designing, deploying, and operating highly available distributed systems on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - this role needs someone who can still open a terminal and debug production, not just review architecture diagrams.

  • Proficiency in Golang or similar modern programming languages for infrastructure automation and service development.

  • Strong understanding of observability principles and experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage critical incidents personally when needed, perform root cause analysis, and implement effective preventative measures.

  • Familiarity with API gateway technologies, service mesh, or network proxies is a significant plus.

The Kong DNA:

  • Ownership: You take full responsibility for the reliability and performance of systems, driving initiatives from conception to completion.

  • Urgency: You thrive in dynamic environments, prioritizing critical issues and delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision.

  • Collaboration: You build strong relationships, foster open communication, and work effectively across global teams to achieve shared goals.

Bonus Points

jobs.title: Lecturers Talent Pool | Laba
jobs.excerpt: Laba to szkoła biznesowa dla ludzi, którzy nie chcą po prostu wiedzieć więcej.
jobs.description:
Laba to szkoła biznesowa dla ludzi, którzy nie chcą po prostu wiedzieć więcej. Chcą działać lepiej.

Dlatego naszych kursów nie budujemy na teorii z podręczników. Budujemy je na doświadczeniu ludzi, którzy podejmowali trudne decyzje, prowadzili zespoły, odpowiadali za budżety, projekty, strategie i wyniki.

Nie szukamy wykładowców, którzy znają wszystkie definicje. Szukamy ekspertów, którzy wiedzą, co dzieje się po slajdzie z definicją.

Ludzi, którzy potrafią powiedzieć nie tylko „jak powinno być”, ale też: „zrobiliśmy to tak, nie zadziałało, wyciągnęliśmy wnioski i następnym razem podjęliśmy inną decyzję”.

Jeśli masz za sobą doświadczenie, którym warto się podzielić, być może kolejny kurs Laby stworzymy właśnie z Tobą.

Ty wnosisz wiedzę, perspektywę i prawdziwe case'y. My pomagamy przełożyć je na kurs, z którego uczestnicy wychodzą z umiejętnościami, które mogą wykorzystać następnego dnia w pracy.

Requirements

Kogo szukamy?

  • Masz doświadczenie, które wykracza poza teorię.
    Nie chodzi nam o liczbę certyfikatów ani idealną ścieżkę kariery. Chcemy wiedzieć, za jakie projekty odpowiadałeś/aś, jakie problemy rozwiązywałeś/aś i czego nauczyła Cię praktyka.
  • Masz własną perspektywę.
    Najciekawsi eksperci nie powtarzają tego, co można znaleźć w pierwszych pięciu wynikach Google. Wiedzą, gdzie teoria zderza się z rzeczywistością i potrafią wyjaśnić, co zrobić wtedy.
  • Potrafisz mówić również o tym, co nie wyszło.
    Udane projekty są świetnymi case studies. Nieudane często jeszcze lepszymi. Decyzje, błędy, zmiana kierunku, trudne rozmowy i rzeczy, które dziś zrobiłbyś/zrobiłabyś inaczej, to wiedza, której nie da się znaleźć w podręczniku.
  • Chcesz rozwijać innych.
    Być może już mentorujesz ludzi w swoim zespole, występujesz na konferencjach, prowadzisz warsztaty albo jesteś osobą, do której inni przychodzą, kiedy problem robi się naprawdę skomplikowany. Nie musisz być zawodowym trenerem. Metodyki nauczymy Cię my.
  • Jesteś gotowy/a również samemu się uczyć.
    Dobry kurs nie powstaje przez skopiowanie prezentacji używanej od pięciu lat. Powstaje z pytań, dyskusji, porządkowania doświadczenia i spojrzenia na własną wiedzę z zupełnie nowej perspektywy.

Benefits

Co z tego masz?

  • Budujesz pozycję eksperta.
    Twoje nazwisko staje się częścią kursu Laby i dociera do profesjonalistów, którzy chcą rozwijać się właśnie w Twoim obszarze. To przestrzeń, w której możesz pokazać nie tylko stanowisko czy firmę w swoim CV, ale przede wszystkim sposób, w jaki myślisz i pracujesz.
  • Nie tworzysz kursu sam/a.
    Za każdym kursem stoi zespół. Pomagamy zbadać potrzeby rynku, uporządkować wiedzę, zaprojektować program i przygotować zajęcia tak, żeby Twoje doświadczenie naprawdę przełożyło się na rozwój uczestników. Ty jesteś ekspertem w swojej dziedzinie. My jesteśmy ekspertami od zamieniania wiedzy w edukację.
  • Porządkujesz lata własnego doświadczenia.
    To, co do tej pory było rozsiane między projektami, spotkaniami, prezentacjami, decyzjami i „po prostu wiem, bo robię to od lat”, zaczyna tworzyć spójny system. Czasem dopiero ucząc innych, odkrywasz, jak dużo naprawdę wiesz.
  • Poznajesz ludzi, którzy chcą iść dalej.
    Na kursy Laby przychodzą specjaliści, managerowie, liderzy i osoby, które chcą wejść na kolejny poziom zawodowy. Dla prowadzącego oznacza to nie tylko nauczanie, ale też rozmowy, pytania i perspektywy ludzi z różnych organizacji i branż.
  • Widzisz realny efekt swojej wiedzy.
    Ktoś dzięki Twoim zajęciom podejmuje lepszą decyzję. Zmienia sposób zarządzania zespołem. Wdraża proces. Dostaje awans. Podejmuje się projektu, na który wcześniej nie był gotowy.I właśnie wtedy wiedza przestaje być tylko doświadczeniem jednej osoby.

Nie widzisz teraz kursu ze swojego obszaru?

To nic.

Nie jest to rekrutacja do jednego konkretnego projektu. Budujemy społeczność ekspertów, z którymi chcielibyśmy tworzyć kolejne kursy Laby.

Opowiedz nam o swoim doświadczeniu, projektach, z których jesteś dumny/a, obszarach, w których naprawdę masz coś do powiedzenia, i wiedzy, którą chciałbyś/chciałabyś przekazać dalej.

Kiedy będziemy pracować nad tematem, do którego pasuje Twoje doświadczenie, wrócimy do Twojego zgłoszenia.

Bo następny ekspert Laby nie musi dziś szukać możliwości prowadzenia kursu. Może po prostu robić świetną robotę w swojej branży.

A my chcemy go znaleźć.

jobs.excerpt: Location: USA (East Coast), LATAM - Fully Remote Employment type: PART-TIMEAbout Bizmoni Corp.
jobs.description:
Location: USA (East Coast), LATAM - Fully Remote

Employment type: PART-TIME

About Bizmoni Corp.

Bizmoni is building an AI Business Network designed to help people and businesses connect, earn, learn, and grow in the AI era.

As a seed-stage, pre-revenue company, we are strengthening our platform, growing our global ecosystem, and laying the foundations for future funding and scale. This is an opportunity to join an entrepreneurial, international team and help shape both the product and the business.

About the Role

We're looking for a detail-driven QA Analyst to own manual testing across our web applications and APIs. You'll turn requirements into clear test cases, run structured test cycles, and give the team reliable reporting on release quality. You'll also bring a security mindset, checking for common vulnerabilities as part of everyday testing.

You'll work closely with Business Analysts, Product Owners and developers from refinement to release, and help shape how we document and evidence our testing.

What You'll Do:

  • Review user stories, specifications and acceptance criteria early, and raise gaps, ambiguities and risks before development starts.
  • Take part in backlog refinement and sprint ceremonies alongside BAs, Product Owners and developers.
  • Write clear test plans, test scenarios and detailed test cases with expected results and test data.
  • Maintain a requirements traceability matrix so every requirement has test coverage.

Test execution and defect management

  • Run manual functional, regression, integration, end-to-end and exploratory testing across web, mobile and API layers.
  • Test APIs manually using tools such as Postman or Swagger.
  • Log defects with clear steps to reproduce, expected and actual results, evidence and severity, and track them through to closure in [Jira / Azure DevOps].
  • Retest fixes and maintain regression test packs for each release.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by preparing scripts, guiding business users and capturing feedback.
  • Include basic security checks in your testing, such as access control, input validation, session handling and the OWASP Top 10, and escalate findings to the security team.

Reporting and documentation

  • Produce test progress, test summary and release readiness reports for engineering and business stakeholders.
  • Track and report on QA metrics such as test coverage, pass rates, defect trends and defect leakage.
  • Keep test documentation current in [TestRail / Xray / Zephyr / Confluence].
  • Contribute to QA processes and standards, and provide testing evidence for audits such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2.

What You'll Bring:

  • Manual testing experience. 3+ years in manual QA, testing web applications and APIs in an Agile environment.
  • Test case design. Strong at writing structured test cases using techniques such as boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning and state transition.
  • Requirements analysis. Proven ability to analyse user stories and acceptance criteria, identify gaps and turn them into testable scenarios.
  • Documentation. Experience creating and maintaining test plans, traceability matrices and test summary reports.
  • Tools. Hands-on with Jira or Azure DevOps and a test management tool (TestRail, Xray, Zephyr or similar), plus Postman for API testing.
  • Technical foundations. Good understanding of web technologies, HTTP and REST, and basic SQL for checking data.
  • Security awareness. Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and how to check for common issues during manual testing.
  • Clear reporting. You write precise defect reports and explain quality risks clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to Have:

  • ISTQB Foundation certification (Advanced Test Analyst a plus).
  • Hands-on use of Burp Suite or OWASP ZAP for basic security testing.
  • Some exposure to test automation (Playwright, Selenium or Cypress), even if it isn't your main focus.
  • Experience supporting UAT with business users.
  • Background in a regulated sector such as fintech, banking or healthcare.
  • Experience with accessibility testing against WCAG 2.2.

Who Thrives at Bizmoni?

We look for people who demonstrate:

  • Ownership – Taking responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks
  • Results Orientation – Focusing on quality, execution, and impact
  • Continuous Improvement – Always looking for better ways to work and improve quality
  • Collaboration – Partnering effectively across teams and functions
  • Adaptability – Thriving in a dynamic and evolving environment
  • Mission Alignment – Believing in what we're building and its future potential

Compensation & Commitment

Bizmoni currently offers ONLY an equity-based compensation model, aligned with global startup practices that enable early contributors to participate in the company's potential long-term value creation.

The role requires a flexible commitment of approximately 8–16 hours per week, with clear deliverables and results-driven accountability. Contributors may maintain a primary paid role alongside their engagement with Bizmoni. As Bizmoni is currently seed-stage, compensation is provided in company equity. Full terms and conditions will be discussed during the selection process and confirmed in the consulting agreement.

Requirements for Remote Engagement:

  • Personal computer with camera and reliable internet connection
  • Willingness to participate in Bizmoni's equity-based compensation model

Why You'll Love Working at Bizmoni

  • Design the core AI agents of an emerging AI Business Network from day one
  • Set the technical architecture and standards that the platform will scale on
  • Work directly with founders and a talented, globally distributed team
  • Gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge agentic AI, FinTech, and product initiatives
  • Contribute directly to Bizmoni's growth, scalability, and future funding readiness

Equal Opportunity Employer

Bizmoni is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive global environment where everyone is treated with dignity, fairness, and respect.

Engagement decisions are based on relevant skills, experience, potential, and business needs, without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable law. We believe diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences strengthen our culture, innovation, and global network.

Before Applying, Ask Yourself:

  • Are you open to ONLY equity-based compensation?
  • Are you open to dedicating a min. of 16 hrs weekly on our project?

If your answers are YES, then we are happy to meet you!

Recruitment Process:

Please send us your English CV stating the role you apply for. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview. Thank you.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join a high-performing data engineering team at a leading global company operating at the intersection of sports, technology, and digital commerce.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join a high-performing data engineering team at a leading global company operating at the intersection of sports, technology, and digital commerce.
In this role, you will take ownership of the systems responsible for ingesting, transforming, validating, and publishing data across a large-scale data ecosystem. You will work at the data ingestion boundary, where information from multiple internal and external sources enters the platform, ensuring it is accurate, reliable, and ready to power downstream products, analytics, and services.
You will be responsible for building and maintaining scalable data pipelines, solving complex identity and entity-matching challenges, identifying and addressing data-quality issues, and improving the reliability and observability of data flows across the organization.
This is a highly hands-on engineering role that combines AWS data engineering, Python, SQL, event-driven architectures, data quality, and identity resolution. You will work closely with engineering, product, analytics, and downstream platform teams to troubleshoot complex data challenges, improve existing systems, and build reliable solutions that support data-driven products at scale.

What You'll Do

  • Own and evolve data ingestion pipelines that bring data from multiple external and internal sources into the platform, including ingestion, cleaning, curation, entity resolution, and event-driven publishing.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable batch and event-driven data workflows using Python, SQL, and AWS.
  • Solve complex identity resolution, entity matching, and deduplication challenges across multiple data sources, ensuring reliable and consistent entity mappings.
  • Build and maintain data quality and validation frameworks, including freshness monitoring, null-rate and consistency checks, and schema-drift detection.
  • Monitor data at the ingestion boundary and proactively identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues before they impact downstream products and services.
  • Partner with engineering teams responsible for event infrastructure and downstream identity services to trace data and events end-to-end.
  • Collaborate with Product, Assessments, Analytics, and Engineering teams to understand how data is consumed downstream and ensure pipelines meet evolving product and business requirements.
  • Work with AWS services such as Glue, Athena, S3, and DynamoDB to build and operate reliable, scalable data infrastructure.
  • Automate infrastructure and pipeline changes using Infrastructure as Code, primarily Terraform or AWS CDK.
  • Participate in production incident response, quickly assessing impact, identifying root causes, and implementing effective remediation.
  • Continuously improve the reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability of data pipelines and platform infrastructure.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience building and operating production-grade data pipelines and data infrastructure.
  • Strong experience with both batch processing and event-driven architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Glue, Athena, and S3-based data lakes, including layered or medallion-style data transformations.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data processing, transformation, and analysis.
  • Experience solving identity resolution, entity matching, and deduplication problems, including exact and fuzzy matching approaches.
  • Understanding of durable identifiers and identity-mapping strategies, including the challenges associated with maintaining consistent first-seen or locked mappings over time.
  • Experience working with event schemas and schema-registry-backed contracts, such as Protobuf, and an understanding of the impact of schema evolution on downstream consumers.
  • Strong troubleshooting and production incident-response skills, with the ability to assess impact, identify root causes, and drive issues through resolution.
  • Ability to understand and debug code written in a functional or concurrent programming language, such as Elixir.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, analytics, and other technical teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Elixir/Phoenix or other BEAM-based concurrent processing frameworks.
  • Experience with DynamoDB-backed identity, lookup, or matching services.
  • Experience with the Snowflake ecosystem, including data modeling, Snowpipe, Streams, and Tasks.
  • Experience working with sports data providers, licensed data providers, or other complex external data ecosystems.
  • Experience implementing data observability, including freshness and staleness alerts, null-rate monitoring, schema-drift detection, and data-quality dashboards.
  • Experience managing infrastructure through Terraform or AWS CDK.

Technologies

Languages: Python, SQL, familiarity with Elixir
AWS: Glue, Athena, S3, DynamoDB
Data & Streaming: Data Lakes, Event-Driven Architecture, Protobuf, Schema Registries
Infrastructure: Terraform, AWS CDK
Data Platforms: Snowflake
Engineering Practices: Data Quality, Data Observability, Identity Resolution, Entity Matching, Incident Response

The company is moving into more technical customer segments, and API support volume is rising as a result. The support team runs a Tier 1 and Tier 2 structure. This hire will be the most technically capable member of Tier 1 and can grow into a more advanced role over time.

About the Role

Day-to-day, you will own customer tickets across all product areas, with a focus on API errors. You will request payloads, redact sensitive data, and reproduce issues in Postman. Then you will either resolve the ticket yourself or escalate it to Tier 2 with complete steps to reproduce. Success means fewer escalations, faster resolution of API tickets, and a growing internal knowledge base of troubleshooting workflows.

Core Responsibilities

API Troubleshooting & Deflection

  • Triage customer-reported API errors and decide whether to resolve at Tier 1 or escalate.

Tier 1 Technical Support

  • Own and resolve support tickets across all product areas within SLA targets.
  • Escalate issues outside Tier 1 scope with steps to reproduce, error messages, and tests already run.

Documentation & Knowledge Base

  • Document recurring API issues and troubleshooting workflows in the internal knowledge base.

Customer Communication

  • Ask targeted clarifying questions to collect all technical details in the first reply.
  • Set clear expectations on resolution timelines during troubleshooting.
  • Keep customers updated when their issue moves to Tier 2.

Requirements

Must-Have

  • 2+ years of technical support experience, including at least 1 year in a Tier 1 role at a SaaS or software company
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting customer-reported REST API errors
  • Proficiency in Postman (or cURL / Insomnia) to reproduce API issues, including requesting payloads and redacting sensitive data

This role supports the DoW ICAM mission by ensuring the accurate aggregation, correlation, synchronization, and distribution of identity and entitlement data across enterprise, mission‑partner, tactical, and edge environments.

This is a fully remote position.

As the Project Manager for MER, you will oversee delivery timelines, cross-team coordination, data-source onboarding efforts, and integration readiness to ensure MER services support Zero Trust, identity assurance, and enterprise governance requirements. You will work closely with engineering teams, cybersecurity, data owners, application stakeholders, and mission partners to ensure MER enhancements are executed effectively with strong operational alignment.

  • Facilitate requirement-gathering sessions with identity owners, data stewards, application teams, and mission partners to ensure MER accuracy and completeness.

  • Oversee onboarding of authoritative data sources, directory repositories, and systems requiring identity and entitlement data through the enterprise MER pipeline.

  • Support implementation of MER capabilities across disconnected, intermittent, and low-bandwidth (DDIL) environments where identity distribution and synchronization are critical.

  • Ensure project artifacts, documentation, SOPs, and operational readiness materials are updated in alignment with new MER capabilities.

  • Provide timely leadership updates on schedule progress, delivery risks, cross-team issues, and downstream dependency impacts.

  • Identify data governance gaps, correlation issues, quality risks, or emerging modernization needs and coordinate resolution paths with engineering and cybersecurity teams.

  • Support compliance, Zero Trust alignment, and identity-centric security objectives through reliable, authoritative MER data and entitlement accuracy.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience leading technical, cybersecurity, or identity-related projects in complex enterprise environments.

  • Strong understanding of Radiant Logic / RadiantOne FID, identity data virtualization, identity aggregation, and authoritative identity management.

  • Experience with identity correlation, reconciliation, entitlement modeling, and identity lifecycle processes (Joiner/Mover/Leaver).

jobs.description:
Computer World Services, Corp. (CWS) seeks a Field Operations Lead to oversee and coordinate field-support operations for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program, managing technician assignments, on-call coverage, outage-recovery support, site-support schedules, and equipment relocations at Military Entrance Processing Station (MEPS) locations.

The Field Operations Lead coordinates closely with the Outage Response Team (ORT), Service Desk, engineering teams, Government personnel, carriers, utilities, and vendors. During critical incidents, the Lead organizes field resources, maintains incident timelines, supports hourly Severity (SEV) 1 and SEV 2 status updates, and drives services toward restoration, while also coordinating cabling, installations, site surveys, and MEPS moves.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

    • Lead day-to-day field operations across USMEPCOM Headquarters and supported MEPS locations, assigning technicians based on site requirements, qualifications, workload, and geographic coverage.
    • Develop and maintain field-support schedules, rosters, escalation paths, and on-call coverage supporting the program’s 24/7/365 outage-response capability.
    • Coordinate field response to network, system, application, telecommunications, power, cabling, and equipment outages, dispatching personnel, vendors, or service providers.
    • Organize hourly status updates for SEV 1 and SEV 2 incidents and provide clear operational updates to the ORT Lead, Service Desk leadership, program management, and Government stakeholders.
    • Maintain incident timelines documenting notifications, dispatches, troubleshooting, decisions, workarounds, and restoration; escalate resource shortages, access problems, and vendor delays.
    • Verify that technicians follow approved troubleshooting, safety, security, change-control, and recovery procedures, and coordinate approved workarounds.
    • Gather field evidence for root-cause analysis and incident reports, and support quarterly review of outage-response procedures and the Incident Response Plan.
    • Plan and coordinate installations, refreshes, maintenance, MEPS relocations, site surveys, network-drop requirements, and cable-management activities.
    • Ensure field teams update site records, diagrams, equipment information, and tickets after work, and track assignments, arrival and departure times, and completion evidence.
    • Maintain contact lists, field guides, SOPs, checklists, call trees, and dispatch instructions; identify readiness gaps in coverage, tools, spares, and access.
    • Provide field-operations status, outage statistics, risks, and corrective actions for program reporting, and participate in readiness and after-action reviews.

Education & Experience

    Required:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
    • Six (6) or more years of experience supporting enterprise IT operations, including at least two (2) years leading technical teams or coordinating outage-response activities.
    • Experience coordinating technician assignments, schedules, incident response, or field support with network, systems, telecommunications, or infrastructure teams.
    • Ability to coordinate multiple teams and service providers during time-sensitive events and to produce clear incident documentation and status reports.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including during critical incidents.

      • Preferred:

      • Experience supporting federal or DoD enterprise IT environments and coordinating 24/7/365 outage-response or NOC coverage.
      • Experience supporting SEV 1 and SEV 2 incident response, escalation, and communications with a Service Desk or Outage Response Team.
      • Experience coordinating geographically dispersed teams, carriers, utilities, and vendors.
      • Experience supporting site relocations, refreshes, installations, or network cutovers, and knowledge of structured cabling and telecommunications components.
      • Familiarity with ServiceNow and ITIL incident, problem, change, and continual-improvement practices.

Certifications

    • Required: None.
    • Preferred: ITIL 4 Foundation, Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), or CompTIA Network+.

Security Clearance

  • Active Secret clearance or higher is required.

Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)

    Work Environment / Travel:

    • Remote position; Chicago, IL–area candidates preferred.
    • Travel to USMEPCOM Headquarters and geographically dispersed MEPS locations is required as operational needs dictate.
    • Participation in an on-call environment and incident response outside normal business hours is required.

jobs.description:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Credit Cards

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer.

You’ll build features on iwoca’s business credit card and own each one from the first line of code to the moment a customer makes their first spend.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

iwoca launched its business credit card in 2026. It gives small businesses a fast, flexible way to pay for what they need and control their cash flow, alongside iwoca’s loans. The card is a core part of iwoca’s long-term growth.

The Credit Cards team builds what business owners use to sign up, get their card, and manage it, on the web and in the iwoca Mobile App. It’s cross-functional – engineers collaborate with product and design.

The role

As a senior full-stack engineer, you’ll work mostly on the backend, and build the frontend for your features too.

  • Ownership. You’ll shape what the team builds next, starting from what customers need. You’ll decide how each of your features works, from the data model and API to how you test, release, and monitor it.

  • Impact. Business owners use your work every time they check their cashback, set spend controls, or freeze a lost card. The team releases often, and your changes reach them quickly.

  • Variation. You’ll write Python and FastAPI services backed by PostgreSQL, and React and TypeScript for the web. You’ll also work in React Native on the iwoca Mobile App, and on the Credit Cards CRM that operations staff use, when a feature needs it.

  • Card expertise. You’ll learn how card transactions work – from the card processor to the card scheme – alongside the engineers who build iwoca’s payments platform.

  • AI-first engineering. You’ll build with AI coding tools as standard. On the iwoca Mobile App, for example, the team writes a spec for each feature and reviews it before building it with Claude Code.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Backend engineering. You've built well-tested Python services for customer-facing products, and kept them working once people relied on them.

  • Data models and APIs. You've designed relational data models, ideally in PostgreSQL, and built and integrated APIs.

  • Frontend. You've written enough React and TypeScript to build and ship customer-facing features.

  • Product ownership. You've taken features from an idea to production and owned them once they were live. You've challenged a plan when it didn't meet a customer need, and offered a better one.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone, at work or in your own projects. You judge when to use it and when not to, and you check its output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Mobile. You've developed iOS or Android app features, ideally in React Native.

  • Fintech. You've worked on financial products, especially card payments.

  • FastAPI. You've built and run production services with FastAPI.

  • Internal tools. You've written software for operations or support staff.

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £90,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack (TAP)

Compensation Range: £80K - £90K

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product engineer to own product areas within BJAK's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Poland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Poland.

Language

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

This role offers the opportunity to lead key lifecycle initiatives—implementations, upgrades, cloud transitions, and modernization projects—while helping build a resilient enterprise platform that supports long‑term organizational success.

  • Manage SAP Transport Management System (TMS), including sequencing and migrations across all environments.
  • Coordinate maintenance windows, technical deployments, and outage communications to minimize disruption.
  • Support SAP High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) design, testing, and execution.
  • Perform SAP user administration and work with security teams on technical authorization requirements.
  • Conduct system housekeeping tasks such as background job monitoring, spool management, interface checks, and log reviews.
  • Collaborate with DBAs on SAP HANA backup, recovery, tuning, and optimization activities.
  • Support integrations with middleware, identity management, authentication platforms, and external systems.
  • Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, SOPs, and configuration baselines.
  • Assist with ATO, RMF, STIG compliance, vulnerability remediation, and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Participate in root cause analysis and corrective action planning for production incidents.
  • Support cloud‑based SAP environments including SAP RISE and hybrid architecture deployments.
  • Provide technical assistance during new deployments, releases, and ongoing sustainment operations.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • An active DoD Secret clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
  • Hands-on experience administering SAP Basis in enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, or similar SAP platforms.
  • Proven experience with SAP installations, upgrades, patches, and technical migrations.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP Transport Management System (TMS).
  • Experience supporting SAP HANA databases.
  • Working knowledge of Linux and/or Windows systems running SAP applications.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve SAP performance and availability issues.
  • Solid understanding of SAP architecture and technical landscape design.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and documentation skills.

Desired:

  • SAP Certified Technology Associate – System Administration (SAP S/4HANA).
  • Experience with SAP Solution Manager, including Focused Run.
  • Experience administering SAP Fiori.
  • Experience supporting SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).
  • Experience working with SAP cloud environments.

About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

As Principal Software Engineer, AI Email App, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales.

What You'll Own

  • Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.

  • Design reliable systems for AI-powered workflows, including state, orchestration, tool use, retries, fallbacks, and failure handling.

  • Build the APIs and abstractions that connect AI systems to real-world product experiences.

  • Lead a small, senior engineering team and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship.

  • Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience.

  • Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

  • Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

  • A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage.

  • High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals.

Outcomes

  • Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load.

  • Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience.

  • Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

  • Latency and reliability improve measurably over time.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

SLSQ327R349

Databricks is seeking a Lakebase Sales Specialist to help customers modernise their operational data foundation with Databricks Lakebase, our fully-managed Postgres offering for intelligent applications. Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications, helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity.

The impact you will have:

  • Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and driving Lakebase activations and consumption within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team
  • Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas, including platform teams and developers, data teams, and central IT, articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency
  • Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences
  • Run complex sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders
  • Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists
  • Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references
  • Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs
  • Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organisation

What success looks like in this role:

This role requires the ability to operate across two key motions simultaneously:

  • Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase
  • Drive longer-term Postgres standardisation and migration within Databricks' most strategic accounts

Success in this role requires strength in four areas:

  1. Business ownership: Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support.
  2. Strategic account engagement: Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes.
  3. Field, account, & customer enablement: Align customers and the field on the value of Lakebase by equipping AEs and SAs with the messaging and execution motions needed to confidently own accounts without specialist intervention.
  4. Market voice and thought leadership: Develop an internal and external presence, and by representing Databricks at key first- and third-party events.

The interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across all four of these dimensions.

What we look for:

  • Relevant enterprise sales experience, consistently exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder deals
  • Proven success selling data platforms, operational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, cloud-native DBaaS), or adjacent data/AI infrastructure to technical buyers and business leaders
  • Strong understanding of modern data and application architectures, including cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven systems, and how operational data underpins AI and analytics strategies
  • Ability to sell to both technical stakeholders (developers, architects, data engineers) and business stakeholders (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners)
  • Demonstrated experience leading specialist or overlay motions, working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities
  • Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures, lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers
  • Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills, with comfort presenting to both large and small audiences
  • Bachelor’s degree

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience selling Postgres, operational databases, OLTP workloads, or transactional cloud database services, ideally within large or strategic accounts
  • Familiarity with data platforms, lakehouse architectures, and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP), including how operational databases fit within broader data and AI strategies
  • Understanding of reverse ETL, real-time decisioning, and operational analytics use cases, and how they drive value for customer-facing and internal applications
  • Exposure to AI-native and agent-driven applications that depend on low-latency, highly scalable operational data services
  • Prior experience in a high-growth, category-creating environment, helping shape new plays, messaging, and customer narratives
  • Experience collaborating with partners and ISVs to drive joint pipeline and co-sell motions

This description is intended to outline the core responsibilities and qualifications for the Lakebase Sales Specialist role. Actual responsibilities may evolve as the Lakebase product and go-to-market motions continue to grow and mature.

More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents.
