About Refold

Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it.

Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves.

Traction: 30+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500+ active users, 10M+ API calls processed daily, seven-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time-to-go-live by 70% and recovered 8,000+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5-month builds to 90% faster delivery.

Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30. We've raised $6.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating.

We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. This is the second AE seat in the US and the first hired to build the motion, not inherit it.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the technical win: Lead discovery, demos, and architecture conversations from first call to signature. When a deal is won or lost on technical confidence, that outcome is yours

  • Build the proof, don't slide it: Stand up working prototypes against the customer's actual systems and messy data — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce. Our product is the demo; a deck is a fallback, not a strategy

  • Run crisp POCs: Design focused evaluations with explicit success criteria, timelines, and exit conditions. We're deliberately moving away from 4-week POCs — help us prove value in days

  • Speak both languages: Translate schema mapping, auth flows, multi-tenancy, and in-tenant deployment into terms a CTO trusts and a VP of Professional Services can build a business case on

  • Clear security and procurement: Own architecture reviews, security questionnaires, and RFP/RFI responses. Air-gapped, in-tenant deployment is one of our strongest cards — know how to play it

  • Hand off clean: Partner with Delivery and our Forward Deployed Engineers so every go-live starts from a real technical plan, not a rediscovery exercise

  • Feed the platform: You'll be one of our highest-signal sources of product truth. Surface the gaps and friction you hit in the field and push them into the roadmap

  • Build the SE motion: Turn what works into a demo library, discovery framework, POC playbook, reference architectures, and competitive teardowns against iPaaS incumbents

Role Information:

  • Partners with: The founding AE team and the founders directly; backed by Forward Deployed Engineers and Delivery

  • Average deal size: $50–100K land / $200–300K expand

  • Average deal cycle: 3–6 months

  • Technical buyers you'll face: CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product, VPs of Professional Services / Delivery, plus platform architects and security reviewers

  • Ideal customer: Sales-led with an integrations page, an internal PS team or SI dependency, and enterprise deals that hinge on connectors

  • Competitive set: iPaaS and middleware incumbents (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, SnapLogic) and in-house build

  • Current growth team: 1 BDR, 1 AE, 2 Marketing, 4 Post-Sale, plus a 20-person engineering and delivery org

Required Skills & Abilities

  • Proven SE: 5–8 years in solutions engineering, pre-sales, or technical consulting at a SaaS, data, or AI company. This is a hard requirement — we're not training someone into the seat

  • Builder, not just a presenter: Hands-on with APIs and data integration, and fluent enough in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript to build a working prototype yourself over a weekend

  • Enterprise systems fluency: Real experience with systems of record — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Dynamics — and the messy parts: custom fields, schema mapping, OAuth, retries, idempotency, why an integration broke at 2 am

  • Sales instinct: You've sold to or with product and professional services teams at software companies and understand what changes when your buyer's customer is the end user

  • Room-ready: You can hold a CTO's attention, survive a security review, and be the calm one when the demo environment misbehaves

  • High ownership in ambiguity: No playbook exists yet. You'll write it while running live deals, and you'll be comfortable doing both at once

Nice to Have

  • Background in iPaaS, middleware, integration, or data infrastructure — or a track record of selling against MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or SnapLogic

  • Hands-on with LLMs and agentic frameworks, not just familiar with the concepts

  • Experience with air-gapped, in-tenant, or customer-VPC deployments and the security conversations that come with them

  • Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes)

  • First-SE or early-stage experience where you built the function, not joined one

  • Worked day-to-day with an offshore engineering or delivery team

About Wunderkind:

Wunderkind ads are 'behaviorally triggered', meaning that ads are served on a premium list of publishers only when a user is done consuming content. Our proprietary tag is integrated directly on the publisher page to track on-site user behavior - making 'net new' ad placements. How we serve the ad is why we are different from our competitors in-market.

Rather than placing an ad in front of someone while they're actively trying to read content, our technology patiently waits until a visitor has stopped reading before rendering our ad on the page. And that patience pays off -- it turns out that when an ad experience respects the user's reason for visiting a page, the user respects the ad experience in return. This unique, brand safe approach to ad experience gives an advertiser's message more attention and greater engagement.

About the Role:

Here at Wunderkind, we have an innovative and truly differentiated enterprise product that fundamentally changes how publishers monetize their websites and you can play a key part in leading that shift.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

About this role:

You will set the security direction for the whole platform and build much of it with your own hands. This is a hands-on Staff+ role: you write code, review designs, and lead incidents, not only policy.

Your mandate covers four things:

  1. Protect customer credentials and data across a multi-tenant platform and every deployment model we ship.

  2. Make AI agents safe to connect to enterprise systems, from prompt injection to tool-permission scope.

  3. Harden how we build and ship, from the monorepo and CI to the images and Helm charts customers run in their own clusters.

  4. Turn security into a sales advantage by owning the technical side of enterprise security reviews and our compliance program.

You will work across every engineering team, partner with product and go-to-market, and help hire and grow the security function.

What you'll do:

Cloud and infrastructure security

  • Harden our GCP and GKE footprint: IAM, workload identity, network policy, egress control and private control planes.

  • Own secrets and key management end to end, including rotation, short-lived credentials and KMS-backed encryption.

  • Build runtime security for containers and nodes, so a compromised workload is detected and contained fast.

Product and application security

  • Threat-model the integration engine, credential vault, workflow runtime and webhook surface, and drive the fixes.

  • Guarantee tenant isolation across shared data stores, queues and workflow engines.

  • Design safe execution for customer-authored code and custom actions.

  • Raise the bar on authentication and access: SSO, SCIM, RBAC, API keys and OAuth flows.

AI and agent security

  • Define how AI agents get scoped, auditable access to enterprise systems through our MCP servers and AI gateway.

  • Defend against prompt injection, tool misuse and data exfiltration through agents.

Software supply chain

  • Secure the monorepo, CI pipelines and release process: branch protection, signed and provenance-attested images, SBOMs and dependency scanning.

  • Make the images and Helm charts that customers install in their own clusters trustworthy and easy to verify.

Detection and incident response

  • Build logging, detection and alerting that catch real attacks, with low noise.

  • Lead security incidents end to end: triage, forensics, containment, customer communication and the post-incident fix.

Customer trust and compliance

  • Be the senior technical voice in enterprise security reviews, questionnaires and customer calls.

  • Run SOC 2 and ISO 27001 as engineering work: automate evidence, own pen-test scoping and drive remediation.

  • Publish hardening guidance for customers who self-host or run Refold in their own cloud.

Leadership

  • Build paved roads so the secure way is the easy way for every engineer.

  • Mentor engineers, run a security-champions program, and help hire the security team.

What we're looking for:

  • Typically 8+ years in security or software engineering, including several years as the senior security engineer for a multi-tenant SaaS platform.

  • Deep cloud and Kubernetes security experience. GCP and GKE preferred; strong AWS or Azure depth is fine.

  • Strong application security: threat modelling, secure design review, and code review in at least one of TypeScript/Node.js, Python or Go.

  • Fluency with OAuth 2.0, OIDC and SAML, secrets management, key management and encryption design.

  • You have led real production security incidents, including forensics and customer communication.

  • Hands-on software supply chain work: CI/CD hardening, artefact signing, SBOMs and dependency risk.

  • You write production-quality code and ship tooling, not only recommendations.

  • You have represented a company's security in front of enterprise security teams, and won their trust.

  • You can turn SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls into engineering systems instead of spreadsheets.

  • Clear, direct writing. You explain risk to engineers, executives and customers in their own terms.

Bonus points:

  • Security work on LLM and agent systems: OWASP Top 10 for LLM applications, MCP, tool-use permissions.

  • Sandboxing and isolation for untrusted code, such as gVisor, Firecracker or V8 isolates.

  • Shipping software that customers run in their own environments: BYOC, on-prem, air-gapped.

  • Securing workflow engines and data stores such as Temporal, MongoDB, Redis and PostgreSQL.

  • Background in integration platforms, iPaaS, or enterprise systems like SAP, Workday or Salesforce.

  • Offensive security experience, published research, CVEs or open-source security tooling.

  • HIPAA or other regulated-data experience.

  • You have built a security team from the first hire.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Configuration Support Specialist to support enterprise configuration baselines, change records, CMDB reconciliation, version descriptions, and configuration reporting for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Configuration Support Specialist to support enterprise configuration baselines, change records, CMDB reconciliation, version descriptions, and configuration reporting for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This junior role helps ensure that application components, interfaces, infrastructure dependencies, documentation, and configuration records remain accurate, current, and traceable.

The Configuration Support Specialist works under the direction of configuration and release leadership and coordinates with software teams, testers, cybersecurity personnel, infrastructure teams, service-management personnel, operations staff, and Government stakeholders. The position maintains configuration evidence, assists with discrepancy resolution, and supports audits, reviews, releases, and operational handovers.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Configuration Support Specialist will:

  • Support the establishment and maintenance of approved enterprise configuration baselines.
  • Maintain configuration-item records, versions, relationships, dependencies, ownership information, and status data.
  • Enter, update, and validate configuration information in the approved configuration management database (CMDB).
  • Support reconciliation among CMDB records, source repositories, deployment records, inventories, and approved baselines.
  • Collect and organize CMDB reconciliation evidence.
  • Identify missing, incomplete, outdated, or inconsistent configuration records and route discrepancies for resolution.
  • Track discrepancy corrections and retain supporting evidence of completed updates.
  • Create, update, and maintain change records in approved tools and repositories.
  • Ensure change records contain required descriptions, approvals, implementation details, affected configuration items, and completion evidence.
  • Support traceability from approved changes to implementation, validation, and baseline updates.
  • Prepare and maintain source and version descriptions for software and supporting components.
  • Assist with configuration summaries identifying current baselines, approved versions, changes, discrepancies, and open actions.
  • Maintain configuration logs, change logs, version histories, action trackers, and evidence repositories.
  • Collect and organize build documentation, installation procedures, release information, known-defect lists, and other configuration artifacts.
  • Verify that configuration documents use approved templates, naming conventions, version numbers, and repositories.
  • Support configuration-control and change-control reviews by preparing documentation and status information.
  • Assist with configuration audits, release-readiness reviews, assessments, inspections, and evidence requests.
  • Record meeting decisions, approvals, action items, and required configuration updates.
  • Support release-package preparation and confirm that required configuration artifacts are present and correctly versioned.
  • Assist with operational handover by organizing configuration information, procedures, known issues, contacts, and supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate with developers, testers, cybersecurity personnel, infrastructure teams, and operations personnel to obtain missing or corrected information.
  • Generate standard CMDB, change, baseline, and configuration-status reports.
  • Maintain accurate records in accordance with applicable federal, DoD, program, records-management, and configuration-management requirements.
  • Protect sensitive program information and follow approved access, handling, and repository procedures.
  • Support continuous improvement of configuration templates, checklists, standard operating procedures, and evidence-management practices.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must possess all the following:

  • An active Secret clearance or higher.
  • A bachelor’s degree in information technology, information systems, or a related field, or an equivalent permitted by the applicable labor category.
  • At least two years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience supporting configuration baselines or configuration-item records.
  • Experience creating, updating, tracking, or maintaining change records.
  • Experience supporting CMDB updates, reconciliation, validation, or evidence collection.
  • Experience preparing or maintaining version descriptions and configuration summaries.
  • Ability to maintain accurate technical records, logs, trackers, and supporting evidence.
  • Ability to identify incomplete or inconsistent configuration information and coordinate corrections.
  • Ability to follow established configuration-management processes, standard operating procedures, templates, and approval workflows.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word and Excel.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, documentation, and follow-through.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with configuration managers, developers, testers, infrastructure personnel, operations teams, and Government stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred:

  • ITIL 4 Foundation or another relevant IT service-management certification.
  • An entry-level configuration-management certification or formal configuration-management training.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense information-technology programs.
  • Experience with ServiceNow CMDB, BMC Helix, Jira Service Management, or a comparable configuration-management platform.
  • Experience using SharePoint, Confluence, or another document and evidence repository.
  • Experience with source-code or artifact-management platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Artifactory, Nexus, or comparable tools.
  • Familiarity with software configuration items, infrastructure configuration items, interfaces, dependencies, and application releases.
  • Familiarity with change-control boards, change-advisory boards, configuration audits, or release-readiness reviews.
  • Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, release-management, and secure software-development environments.
  • Experience supporting audits, assessments, inspections, or formal evidence requests.
  • Experience developing or maintaining templates, checklists, standard operating procedures, and process documentation.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

Job Requisition ID #

26WD101729

The Senior Manager, Labor Relations Lead is a senior individual contributor responsible for providing expert guidance on global labor relations matters, supporting consistent and compliant practices across all regions. The role partners with People Experience, Legal, business leaders, and employee representative bodies to manage complex labor-related issues and strengthen organizational capability in collective consultation, employee representation, workplace change, labor risk, and manager enablement in a global operating environment.


Scope and Impact

This role operates as a trusted subject matter expert within a global People Experience environment. The P5 Global Labor Relations Lead influences outcomes across multiple regions, supports high-confidentiality matters, and helps ensure that labor relations activity is aligned with legal requirements, company values, operational priorities, and employee trust. The role requires strong judgment, structured thinking, and the ability to balance risk, consistency, empathy, and business practicality. The role supports labor relations activity across key jurisdictions in AMER, EMEA, and APAC, including countries with employee representation, works council, collective consultation, or union-related obligations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide senior-level labor relations expertise and practical guidance to People Experience partners, business leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders on complex labor matters
  • Lead and coordinate the planning and execution of collective consultation and employee representative processes, including Works Council engagement, union interactions and collective bargaining processes
  • Build and maintain constructive, credible relationships with Works Councils, unions, and other employee representative bodies
  • Advise on labor relations implications of organizational change, workforce planning, restructuring, policy implementation, and business transformation initiatives

  • Partner closely with Legal, People Business Partners, Employee Relations, Total Rewards, Communications, and regional People teams to assess labor risk and develop consistent, compliant approaches
  • Prepare clear, accurate, and audience-appropriate materials for consultation processes, leadership briefings, employee representative discussions, and governance forums

  • Coach and enable managers and People partners to understand labor relations obligations, employee voice mechanisms, consultation expectations, and escalation pathways

Required Qualifications

  • Significant experience in labor relations, employee relations, human resources, employment law, or a closely related People function, preferably in a global or matrixed organization

  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, stakeholders, and jurisdictional requirements
  • Ability to interpret policy, process, and legal guidance and translate it into practical, manager-friendly advice
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, exercising discretion, and escalating appropriately when risk, precedent, or reputational considerations are present

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting labor relations activity across multiple countries or regions, with an understanding of regional nuance and local consultation requirements
  • Experience in technology, professional services, or another fast-moving global business environment
  • Familiarity with HR case management systems, data reporting, documentation standards, and governance controls
  • Experience creating playbooks, toolkits, manager guidance, training, or enablement materials related to labor relations or employee relations topics
  • Fluency in English and proficiency in a second language
  • Experience leveraging AI to identify practical use cases and automation opportunities that improve process efficiency, consistency, and scalability
  • Ability to use data, trends, benchmarking, and external insights to inform labor relations strategy and proactive risk management

Leadership Expectations

  • Acts as a trusted advisor who brings clarity, structure, and calm to sensitive and high-impact labor relations matters
  • Builds credibility with senior stakeholders through balanced judgment, practical recommendations, and strong preparation
  • Promotes consistency, fairness, and employee trust while supporting business needs and legal compliance
  • Collaborates across functions and regions to create scalable solutions that improve quality, speed, and confidence in labor relations work
  • Demonstrates inclusive leadership through respectful engagement with employee representatives, managers, employees, and cross-functional partners

Success Measures

  • Labor relations matters are managed consistently, compliantly, and with clear documentation and governance
  • Consultation and representative engagement processes are well planned, timely, and supported by high-quality materials
  • People partners and managers feel better equipped to identify labor relations considerations and follow appropriate escalation pathways

jobs.excerpt: Lyntris is a defense technology company that connects sensing to action across the connected battlespace.
jobs.description:
Lyntris is a defense technology company that connects sensing to action across the connected battlespace. Lyntris brings together the talents of Accelint and Vitesse teams under one mission, with each contributing deep expertise within their domain. Combining differentiated hardware, software and mission expertise, Lyntris helps customers sense threats, make sense of complex conditions and act with greater speed, precision and confidence in contested environments.

Lyntris supports U.S. and allied defense organizations across every branch — including Navy, Army, Air Force, Space Force and allied partners — spanning strategic, operational and tactical missions and every domain: Space, Air, Land, Sea and Cyber. With more than 200 active defense programs, Lyntris works at every level of the mission, from national command authority to the tactical edge.

Solutions are designed by operators who understand the mission, engineered for the conditions that degrade or defeat standard systems, and built on an open, modular architecture that integrates into existing programs without requiring them to start over. Lyntris moves faster than the traditional defense cycle — with integrated design, build and test capabilities in-house — and delivers systems that sustain and endure long after initial fielding.

We are seeking an experienced Technical Debt Engineer/Software Sustainment Engineer to improve, modernize, and sustain complex software systems supporting defense and mission-critical environments. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience debugging production software, performing root cause analysis, refactoring legacy code, and reducing technical debt while preserving functional behavior and delivery schedules. This role will collaborate closely with software developers, systems engineers, architects, and government stakeholders to improve software quality, maintainability, performance, and interoperability through modern engineering and DevOps practices.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Debug, analyze, and resolve complex software defects across large-scale, distributed software systems.
  • Perform root cause analysis to identify software defects, performance bottlenecks, integration issues, and reliability concerns.
  • Refactor legacy software to improve maintainability, modularity, extensibility, testability, and long-term sustainability while preserving existing functionality.
  • Identify, prioritize, and remediate technical debt in collaboration with engineering teams and program leadership.
  • Improve software quality through static analysis, automated testing, code reviews, performance optimization, and modern software engineering practices.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines and automated build, test, and deployment processes.
  • Utilize DevOps tools such as SonarQube, GitLab CI/CD, automated testing frameworks, and containerized development environments to support continuous software improvement.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot multi-language build environments using tools such as CMake, Conan, Maven, Poetry, and NPM.
  • Debug and resolve interoperability and integration issues across distributed software systems utilizing standards-based APIs, messaging frameworks, and communication protocols.
  • Collaborate with software developers, systems engineers, architects, and government stakeholders to implement sustainable software improvements while minimizing program risk and maintaining delivery schedules.
  • Support software integration, verification, validation, configuration management, and release activities.
  • Document software changes, technical debt remediation efforts, and engineering recommendations.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 5+ years of experience debugging, refactoring, and sustaining complex software systems supporting defense, aerospace, or other mission-critical environments.
  • Strong proficiency in software debugging, root cause analysis, performance optimization, and code quality improvement using modern software development tools, including AI-assisted development tools where appropriate.
  • Experience refactoring legacy codebases to improve maintainability, modularity, extensibility, and testability.
  • Strong proficiency with DevOps tools and practices, including SonarQube, GitLab CI/CD, automated testing, and containerized development environments.
  • Strong proficiency with multi-language build tools such as CMake, Conan, Maven, Poetry, and NPM.
  • Experience developing or sustaining large-scale distributed software systems utilizing messaging technologies such as ActiveMQ, DDS, ZeroMQ, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience diagnosing and resolving software integration and interoperability issues across distributed systems using standards-based interfaces and APIs.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with software developers, systems engineers, architects, and government stakeholders to reduce technical debt while maintaining program schedules.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Department of Defense (DOD) Security Clearance.

Preferred Qualifications (Not Required)

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience identifying, prioritizing, and systematically resolving technical debt while preserving functional behavior and architectural compliance.
  • Knowledge of autonomy and robotics integration, mission planning, task allocation, and command-and-control architectures.
  • Experience debugging, refactoring, and sustaining software implementations aligned with SysML architecture models, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and software requirements.
  • Experience working with rootless Podman container environments.
  • Strong proficiency in C++ software development.
  • Proficiency in additional programming languages such as Java, Python, and TypeScript.
  • Experience using Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and containerized software development environments.
  • Experience supporting defense, aerospace, or other highly regulated software development programs.
  • Active-duty military experience.
  • Currently holds an active U.S. national security clearance.

Physical Requirements

  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them.

If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us.

THE ROLE

We're building an AI-powered entertainment studio producing addictive vertical micro-drama series for US audiences, primarily women aged 35–55.

We're looking for a creative director with exceptional storytelling instincts, strong cinematic taste, and a deep understanding of human emotions.

Your mission is simple: turn good scripts into emotionally powerful episodes that people can't stop watching.

You'll work with screenwriters, AI video creators, and editors, taking creative ownership from script review to the final finished episode.

You won't need to write the scripts or generate every video yourself. Your role is to guide the creative execution, identify what needs improvement, and ensure every episode meets our standards.

No AI experience? No problem. We’re looking for exceptional storytellers and filmmakers, not AI experts. If you’re a talented screenwriter or director, we’ll teach you everything you need to know about AI filmmaking technologies.

We believe AI is opening up incredible new opportunities for creative professionals, allowing them to bring their ideas to life faster and with fewer traditional production limitations. You’ll have the opportunity to learn cutting-edge tools, develop valuable new skills, and become part of the next generation of filmmaking.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

1. Script Review & Creative Direction

  • Review season storylines and individual episode screenplays.

  • Evaluate storytelling, emotional impact, character motivations, hooks, and cliffhangers.

  • Approve scripts or provide specific, actionable feedback to screenwriters.

  • Add directing instructions only when necessary. If the script is already strong and production-ready, approve it without unnecessary changes.

2. Direct AI Video Production

  • Establish the visual style and creative standards for each series.

  • Guide AI video creators on cinematography, framing, character performance, lighting, and emotional delivery.

  • Review generated footage and identify scenes or shots that need improvement.

  • Maintain visual consistency and quality across episodes.

3. Editing & Final Approval

  • Review episode edits for pacing, tension, emotional impact, music, sound design, and visual storytelling.

  • Give clear, prioritized feedback to editors.

  • Approve final episodes before release.

  • Ensure the finished video delivers the intended emotional experience.

4. Production Quality & Efficiency

  • Work with multiple AI video creators and editors.

  • Help the team increase production speed without sacrificing creative quality.

  • Identify recurring production problems and improve workflows.

  • Use audience feedback and retention data to improve future episodes.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Exceptional storytelling instincts – you understand why audiences feel anger, excitement, suspense, satisfaction, and anticipation.

  • Strong cinematic judgment – you know how camera angles, acting, editing, lighting, and sound influence emotions.

  • Experience in directing or filmmaking – ideally film, television, serialized drama, or narrative short-form video.

  • Understanding of AI filmmaking – you know the capabilities and limitations of AI video generation and how they affect production decisions.

  • Strong attention to detail – you easily spot continuity errors, weak performances, awkward cuts, or emotional moments that don't work.

  • Clear communicator – you can explain exactly what's wrong, why it matters, and how to fix it.

  • Pragmatic – you don't make changes just to make changes. You know when something is good enough to approve.

  • Comfortable with fast-paced production – you can make strong creative decisions quickly.

  • Excellent English communication skills.

BIG PLUS

  • Experience directing drama, romance, thrillers, soap operas, or telenovelas.

  • Experience with AI filmmaking tools such as Kling, Runway, Seedance, or similar.

  • Experience leading creative production teams.

  • Understanding of audience retention and performance-driven storytelling.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Episodes consistently deliver strong emotional impact, hooks, and cliffhangers.

  • Screenwriters and AI creators receive clear, useful feedback without unnecessary revisions.

  • The team produces more high-quality episodes while keeping production costs under control.

  • Finished episodes maintain consistent cinematic quality and improve based on audience feedback.

Apply - A simple form that helps us know who’s stepping into our world.
Ribbon AI Interview - Ribbon is a short, guided video step that helps us understand your thinking style in a calm, private space.
Interview -A conversation with your manager to feel the work chemistry, get to know each other, and explore what we could build together.

FIXED SERVICE FEE

€2,000–5,000 monthly service fee, depending on experience.

❕Please note that this role is based on a contract/freelance agreement.


LOCATION

Remote, hiring across selected European countries and South Africa.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

  1. Application and portfolio review.

  2. AI interview.

  3. Practical creative directing test.

  4. Interview and trial period.

PERKS & BENEFITS

  • Full flexibility with your schedule in a fully remote setting, while Apploye ensures transparency and fairness.

  • Complimentary gym memberships and company-sponsored outdoor adventures for your strength and to keep your physical well-being in check.

  • A personal development budget is at your disposal for your personal and professional growth to ensure you keep growing continuously.

  • Generous paid time off, including parental leave and vacation days, to recharge and rejuvenate and ensure you’re well-rested.

  • A budget for your home office setup so you’re comfortable working how you like and where you like.

  • Strong company culture and a network of unique individuals that celebrate you.

ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Our tribe works primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET — UTC+2/UTC+3). We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported.

Location: Remote, must be based in Panama

About WebRTC.ventures

WebRTC.ventures is one of the few software development agencies in the world dedicated exclusively to real-time applications. Originally founded as AgilityFeat in 2010, we began specializing in WebRTC in 2015. About the Role

We are looking for an experienced mid-to-senior Functional QA Tester to help ensure our applications meet business requirements, deliver a reliable user experience, and maintain high quality standards. This role focuses on manual and exploratory testing, test planning, API testing, and collaboration with developers and project stakeholders. You should be comfortable taking ownership of QA activities, making informed testing decisions, and managing your work independently with minimal day-to-day supervision.

Test automation experience is an advantage, but it is not required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to identify gaps, clarify expected behavior, and define test coverage.
  • Create and maintain test plans, test cases, checklists, and test data.

  • Validate user workflows, edge cases, error handling, and compatibility across browsers and devices.
  • Document defects with reproduction steps, expected and actual results, and supporting evidence.
  • Investigate issues using available tools, logs, and network information to help developers identify their causes.
  • Collaborate with developers, project leads, and stakeholders to clarify issues, verify fixes, and assess release readiness.
  • Prioritize testing based on business impact, product risk, and delivery timelines.
  • Communicate testing progress, blockers, coverage gaps, and unresolved risks clearly and promptly.
  • Manage QA responsibilities across multiple projects while maintaining quality and meeting agreed deadlines.
  • Recommend practical improvements to testing processes, documentation, and product usability.

Required Qualifications

  • At least three years of professional QA experience, with a strong focus on manual and functional testing.
  • Advanced or fluent English (C1 or higher), with the ability to participate confidently in meetings and communicate clearly with international clients and teammates.
  • Must be based in Panama and eligible for full-time employment in Panama.
  • Demonstrated experience testing web applications, including complex workflows and business rules. Mobile or desktop testing experience is an advantage.
  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle.
  • Experience testing REST APIs using Postman or similar tools, including validating responses, status codes, authentication, and error handling.
  • Ability to use browser developer tools to inspect network requests, console errors, and application behavior.
  • Experience using issue-tracking and test-management tools such as Jira, Linear, TestRail, TestLink, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience working in Agile teams and collaborating throughout the development process.
  • A track record of independently managing testing activities and following issues through to resolution.
  • Experience with cross-browser and cross-device testing tools such as BrowserStack.
  • Basic programming or scripting knowledge.

Professional and Collaboration Skills

  • Organize and complete work with minimal day-to-day supervision.
  • Raise questions, blockers, and quality risks early, with clear context and practical recommendations.
  • Identify subtle issues while keeping business priorities and the overall user experience in view.
  • Balance competing priorities, provide realistic estimates, and communicate changes that may affect delivery.
  • Maintain reliable communication, follow through on commitments, and keep progress visible to the team.

jobs.description:
ICF seeks a Technical Project Specialist (Technical Writer) to support our important work in Child Care and Development Technical Assistance (CDTA) Projects. The Technical Project Specialist will work with project teams supporting ICF’s work in the field of early childhood education in the federal, state, and private sectors. This role supports CDTA projects by developing, editing, and reviewing clear, audience‑focused written products that translate complex early childhood and Child Care and Development Fund (CCDF) topics into practical, accessible resources. The Technical Writer collaborates with subject matter experts and project teams to ensure content quality, consistency, plain language, and adherence to established editorial and quality assurance standards.

Bilingual technical writers may be asked to provide translation of project resources.


Ideal Candidate Description

The ideal candidate will have experience in the field of child development or early childhood education and care, and experience developing engaging content and resources that clarify and convey complex topics and facilitate application of the information shared. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience working in a government context, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams or multiple projects to develop resources to meet the informational needs of specific audiences.

The ideal candidate will excel at writing and editing, as well as reviewing written materials to ensure consistent voice, format, and adherence to various protocols. Additionally, the ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, organized, adaptable, and capable of managing multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Job Responsibilities – Product Development and TA Delivery

  • Ensure quality control for written deliverables and products by consistently implementing established quality assurance protocols and procedures.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in child development, early childhood education, public policy, administration, human development, psychology, or related field directly relevant to early childhood systems

Experience working in early care and education programs or systems, public policy implementation, administration, or grants management for programs that support children and families.

5+ years of experience as a technical writer and editor, developing resources for public dissemination in various formats.

3+ years of experience:

  • developing and tracking project plans, milestones, and timelines for project deliverables.
  • translating complex technical language into content that is easy to read, understand and apply and meets the informational needs of specific audiences.

2+ years of experience:

Proficient in MS Office Applications (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Excel, SharePoint, Teams).


Experience with using e-learning, webinar, or virtual meeting platforms, basic design tools (such as Canva) and digital work management tools (such as Smartsheet and Mural).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in child development, early childhood education, public policy, management, or related field.

Professional Skills

jobs.description:
Ми розширюємо команду й шукаємо супервайзера, який очолить групу до 10 операторів, що працюють із польськомовними клієнтами. Ваше завдання: побудувати стабільну, сильну команду, яка вчасно обробляє ліди та показує результат за ключовими метриками.

Чим займатиметесь

  • Керувати командою: ставити SMART-цілі, розподіляти задачі, контролювати виконання

  • Проводити регулярні 1:1, підтримувати мотивацію й залученість команди

  • Проводити онбординг новачків і супроводжувати їх під час адаптації

  • Контролювати виконання планів продажів, KPI та ключових метрик

  • Аналізувати результати, визначати зони росту, складати плани дій та індивідуальні плани розвитку

  • Проводити мікронавчання, коучинги, зустрічі з розвитку

  • Стежити за якістю продажів і сервісу, виправляти помилки операторів

  • Розбирати складні та конфліктні кейси

  • Складати графіки змін і контролювати навантаження команди

  • Готувати регулярні звіти, аналізувати тенденції та ризики, пропонувати покращення

  • Взаємодіяти зі суміжними підрозділами

Ми чекаємо від вас

  • Вільної польської мови [рівень: B2 / C1 / вільно].

  • Досвіду керування командою або роботи тімлідом, наставником чи сейлз-тренером

  • Досвіду в продажах і розуміння технік продажів, роботи з запереченнями

  • Досвіду роботи в динамічному операційному середовищі: швидкі рішення, великий обсяг інформації, пріоритизація

  • Досвіду роботи з KPI та метриками, вміння аналізувати результати

  • Бажано: досвід навчання та адаптації персоналу

  • Навичок конструктивного фідбеку, розуміння основ конфліктології та емоційного інтелекту

  • Стресостійкості, відповідальності, уваги до деталей, орієнтації на результат

Ключові показники, за якими оцінюватиметься робота

  • Score Performance (апрув, середній чек)

  • Paid Performance (викуп замовлень)

  • Утримання сильних співробітників

  • Результати проходження випробувального терміну новачками

Ми пропонуємо

  • Ставку 1200 $ + бонуси до 800 $

  • Графік: 5/2

  • Роботу в окремому підрозділі: додаткові продажі та пост сейл

  • Менторську підтримку від досвідченого супервайзера на старті

  • Випробувальний період 3 місяці

  • Перегляд зарплати раз на рік з орієнтацією на ринок

  • Кар'єрне зростання до керівника підрозділу чи інших управлінських ролей

  • Оплачувані відпустки 20 робочих днів/рік, оплачувані лікарняні. Покриття витрат на навчання, курси, вивченні іноземних мов. Медичні чекапи/ покриття моб. зв’язку, інтернету + маса приємних бенефітів.

  • Вихідні у свята та День народження, подарунки на річницю роботи та дітям співробітників на Новий рік.

jobs.title: Service Provider Network Manager
jobs.excerpt: About BedrockBedrock Facility Solutions helps companies with multiple locations manage repairs, maintenance, service providers, assets, and facility activity across their properties.
jobs.description:
About Bedrock

Bedrock Facility Solutions helps companies with multiple locations manage repairs, maintenance, service providers, assets, and facility activity across their properties. Pebble, our facility management platform, keeps work orders, communication, estimates, invoices, response times, and location history organized.

Bedrock works with licensed and insured service providers to complete the trade work requested by our clients.

The Role

We are hiring a Service Provider Network Manager to build and maintain strong service coverage throughout Florida.

When a client needs an electrician in Jacksonville, an HVAC company in Miami, or an urgent plumber in Tampa, the service team needs a qualified company ready to respond. This role makes sure that coverage is in place before a request arrives.

Finding a company name online is not enough. You will learn what each service provider does, where they work, whether their documentation is current, how quickly they respond, and whether they meet Bedrock’s service expectations.

You will work closely with operations, billing, customer success, and Bedrock leadership.

What You Will Do

  • Build and maintain service provider coverage across Florida
  • Track coverage by trade, county, service area, and availability
  • Identify markets or trades where Bedrock needs additional coverage
  • Find qualified service providers through referrals, industry relationships, associations, research, and direct outreach
  • Speak with service providers about their capabilities, service areas, hours, response times, pricing, and capacity
  • Collect and maintain W9 forms, certificates of insurance, trade licenses, workers compensation documentation, service agreements, and other required records
  • Monitor expiration dates and follow up before documentation becomes outdated
  • Coordinate service provider onboarding and setup inside Pebble
  • Train service providers on how Bedrock handles work orders, estimates, approvals, updates, photos, and invoices
  • Maintain accurate records for service areas, trades, contacts, rates, and availability
  • Review response times, work acceptance, communication, documentation, service quality, repeat work, and client complaints
  • Address performance concerns directly and document agreed next steps
  • Recommend when a service provider should be placed on hold or removed from future assignments
  • Build backup coverage so operations is not dependent on one company in a market
  • Help operations find coverage for urgent or unusual requests
  • Coordinate with billing when pricing, invoice, or documentation issues arise
  • Review network performance and coverage information with Bedrock leadership
  • Recommend improvements to provider onboarding and management inside Pebble
  • Travel within Florida to meet service providers or review capabilities when needed

What We Are Looking For

  • At least five years of experience in facility services, service provider management, supplier relationships, procurement, field services, construction services, or a similar role
  • Experience finding and onboarding service companies across several trades or markets
  • Familiarity with certificates of insurance, trade licenses, W9 forms, workers compensation documentation, and service agreements
  • Experience discussing pricing, service expectations, response times, and performance concerns
  • Working knowledge of commercial HVAC, plumbing, electrical, locksmith, janitorial, landscaping, and general maintenance services
  • Strong relationship management and negotiation skills
  • The ability to have direct but respectful conversations when service quality falls short
  • Strong organization and attention to expiration dates and documentation
  • Experience using a CRM, CMMS, work order system, provider management system, or similar software
  • Comfort using spreadsheets and performance reports to identify coverage gaps and service problems
  • Ability to work remotely and travel within Florida when needed

A college degree is not required.

What Matters at Bedrock

Build relationships that last. Set clear expectations. Be fair, be honest, and address problems directly. Follow through with both clients and service providers.

This is a full time W2 position with a base salary and performance based bonus.

Bedrock Facility Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, performance, and business needs without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.excerpt: Job OverviewThe Technical Support Coordinator serves as a trusted first point of contact for customers experiencing technical issues, combining thoughtful analysis, structured troubleshooting, and clear communication to move each case toward resolution.
jobs.description:
Job OverviewThe Technical Support Coordinator serves as a trusted first point of contact for customers experiencing technical issues, combining thoughtful analysis, structured troubleshooting, and clear communication to move each case toward resolution. The position takes ownership of gathering evidence, identifying root causes for routine issues, documenting findings, and coordinating effective escalations when deeper expertise is required. By keeping customers informed and partnering closely with Technical Support and cross-functional teams, the coordinator helps restore service, build customer confidence, and protect the value customers receive from Marchex solutions.
Job ImpactThe Technical Support Coordinator helps protect customer relationships and revenue by combining disciplined technical analysis with responsive, accurate communication. The role improves issue resolution through complete case documentation, effective troubleshooting, appropriate escalation, and consistent follow-through from initial contact through closure.
TeamThe Technical Support team serves as the central point for investigating and resolving customer-reported product and service issues. The team analyzes configurations, data, integrations, reports, call flows, and system activity; resolves issues within its scope; and coordinates escalations to Product, Engineering, Telecom, and other specialists. Through clear customer communication, accurate case management, trend analysis, and knowledge sharing, Technical Support improves service reliability and the overall customer experience.
Outline of Duties and Responsibilities
Technical Issue Analysis = 45%
  • Review incoming support cases and gather the details needed to reproduce and understand reported issues.
  • Perform initial troubleshooting using approved tools, product documentation, logs, reports, and established diagnostic steps.
  • Identify patterns, document findings, and resolve routine product, configuration, data, and integration issues within assigned permissions.
  • Escalate complex or high-impact issues with clear evidence, troubleshooting history, customer impact, and recommended next steps.
Customer Communication = 35%
  • Communicate with customers by service tickets and phone using clear, professional, and empathetic language.
  • Ask effective clarifying questions, set expectations, and provide timely status updates through resolution.
  • Translate technical findings into customer-friendly explanations and practical next steps.
  • Confirm resolution and customer understanding before closing cases.
Case Management and Collaboration = 20%
  • Maintain accurate case notes, categorization, severity, ownership, and resolution details in the support system.
  • Follow service-level targets, escalation procedures, security requirements, and documented support processes.
  • Partner with senior support staff and teams across Customer Revenue & Operations, Product, Engineering, Telecom, and other functions as needed.
  • Contribute to knowledge resources and participate in coaching, training, and team meetings.

Experience, Skills and Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; post-secondary coursework or relevant customer service or technical experience is a plus.
  • Interest in technology and ability to learn software products, support tools, and structured troubleshooting methods.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a methodical approach.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and comfort communicating with customers.
  • Ability to document work accurately, manage multiple cases, follow established procedures, and meet response expectations.
  • Basic proficiency with web applications and Microsoft Office; exposure to ticketing systems, reporting tools, APIs, SQL, or log analysis is helpful but not required.
  • Reliable attendance and ability to work scheduled business hours, including occasional adjusted coverage as business needs require.

Working Conditions

This is a part-time, non-exempt hourly position scheduled for approximately 25 hours per week. The work schedule will be set during business hours, Monday through Friday, between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. in the employee’s local U.S. time zone. Schedules are flexible and may consist of shorter shifts across five days (for example, 5 hours per day) or longer shifts on fewer days (for example, three or four days per week). The specific schedule will be determined at the time of hire based on business needs and candidate availability, and may be adjusted over time with advance notice.
The role requires reliable availability during assigned shifts. Occasional schedule adjustments or additional hours may be requested based on operational needs and in accordance with applicable law.
Location: This is a remote position open to candidates residing in eligible U.S. states. Eligible states are listed in the online application. Candidates must have a quiet, private, and distraction-free workspace suitable for customer phone calls, along with reliable high-speed internet. Marchex will provide a laptop.
Work Environment: The employee regularly uses a computer, support systems, phone, email, and chat throughout each shift. The role requires extended periods of computer work and phone communication, including the use of a headset.

Benefits & Compensation

Benefits This part-time hourly role is eligible for paid sick leave in accordance with applicable state and local law, and participation in the company 401(k) plan, subject to plan eligibility requirements.

Job Description (Applies to All Levels)

The Mobile Inspector functions as a key member of the Manheim Mobile Inspections team, responsible for conducting on‑site vehicle condition inspections for dealer clients within an assigned territory. This role provides accurate, detailed, and timely documentation of vehicle condition in accordance with Manheim inspection standards, supporting client trust, marketplace transparency, and inventory flow.

Mobile Inspectors build strong relationships with dealer clients by delivering consistent, high‑quality inspections, acting as brand ambassadors for Cox Automotive, and actively engaging dealers to grow participation in Manheim’s mobile inspection services.

This role requires the ability to work with minimal supervision while demonstrating increasing independence, sound judgment, and problem‑solving skills.


Primary Responsibilities & Essential Functions

Vehicle Inspection & Documentation

Conduct thorough vehicle inspections in accordance with Manheim inspection standards.

Locate, start, move, inspect, and return vehicles safely on dealer client lots.

Verify vehicle identification, VINs, mileage, sub‑series, and options; ensure accurate system entry.

Inspect and document vehicle exterior condition, including tires, frame, glass, panels, and mechanical components. Inspect and document interior condition, including seating, dashboard, and installed options.

Perform basic mechanical checks across powertrain, drivetrain, and electrical components.

Identify and document damage, missing components, or inoperable features.

Client Engagement & Territory Management

Build trust with dealer clients through consistent quality, professionalism, and responsiveness.

Educate clients on the value of Manheim Marketplace and mobile inspection services.

Proactively engage with dealers to increase inspection volume and maintain active participation.

Leverage data, insights, and partner input to maximize inspection efficiency and territory productivity.

Adapt to changes in daily appointments and schedules to ensure effective dealer coverage.

Reporting, Tools & Collaboration

Prepare and submit daily activity and production reports.

Utilize Salesforce.com for reporting, lead management, and customer performance tracking.

Collaborate closely with Wholesale Specialists, peers, and other Manheim teams to support client success.

Work effectively within a continuous improvement and Lean environment, contributing to process enhancement.

Safety, Compliance & Standards

Maintain production expectations as established by leadership.

Demonstrate a visible commitment to safety by following all safety and health procedures.

Participate actively in Safety Excellence initiatives.

Comply with Manheim inspection standards, including the NAAA Frame/Structure Damage Policy.

Perform other duties as assigned.


Role‑Specific Requirements


Mobile Inspector – Level 1

Summary
Entry‑level role responsible for conducting vehicle inspections under established processes while learning Manheim inspection standards, tools, and client engagement practices.

Minimum Qualifications

High School Diploma or GED required

Minimal automotive knowledge preferred (body and mechanical)

0–1 years of automotive‑related experience preferred

Valid driver’s license with a safe driving record required

Ability to meet physical and mental demands of the role within required timeframes

Key Responsibilities

Conduct basic vehicle inspections with accuracy and attention to detail

Safely move and handle vehicles on dealer lots

Accurately document vehicle condition and data in inspection systems

Develop working knowledge of inspection standards and client expectations


Mobile Inspector – Level 2

Summary
Intermediate role responsible for independently managing assigned inspection activity, delivering high‑quality inspections, and supporting growth within the assigned territory.

Minimum Qualifications

High School Diploma or GED plus 3+ years of experience in a related field. The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as any level degree/certification beyond a HS diploma/GED; or 5 years’ experience in a related field.

1–2 years of automotive‑related experience preferred

Valid driver’s license with a safe driving record required

Ability to meet physical and mental demands of the role within required timeframes

Key Responsibilities

Independently conduct detailed and complex vehicle inspections

Manage daily inspection schedules efficiently across dealer locations

Build strong working relationships with dealer clients

Utilize data and insights to expand inspection volume and efficiency

Support continuous improvement initiatives and team collaboration


Mobile Inspector – Senior Level

Summary
Senior role responsible for advanced vehicle inspections, mentoring peers, and serving as a trusted inspection professional within the assigned territory.

Minimum Qualifications

High School Diploma/GED plus 5 years’ experience in a related field.  The right candidate could also have a different combination, such as any level degree/certification beyond a HS diploma/GED and 3 years’ experience; or 7 years’ experience in related field.

Previous vehicle inspection experience required

Strong automotive knowledge (body and mechanical) required

2–3 years of automotive‑related experience strongly preferred

1 year of service with Manheim Inspections recommended

Valid driver’s license with a safe driving record required

Ability to meet physical and mental demands of the role within required timeframes

Key Responsibilities

Perform advanced and high‑complexity vehicle inspections

Serve as a subject matter resource for inspection standards and best practices

Support onboarding and development of less experienced Mobile Inspectors

Maintain strong dealer relationships and inspection quality standards

Model safety, professionalism, and operational excellence

Drug Testing

To be employed in this role, you’ll need to clear a pre-employment drug test. Cox Automotive does not currently administer a pre-employment drug test for marijuana for this position. However, we are a drug-free workplace, so the possession, use or being under the influence of drugs illegal under federal or state law during work hours, on company property and/or in company vehicles is prohibited.

Benefits

Employees are eligible to receive a minimum of sixteen hours of paid time off every month and seven paid holidays throughout the calendar year. Employees are also eligible for additional paid time off in the form of bereavement leave, time off to vote, jury duty leave, volunteer time off, military leave, and parental leave.

About Us

Through groundbreaking technology and a commitment to stellar experiences for drivers and dealers alike, Cox Automotive employees are transforming the way the world buys, owns, sells – or simply uses – cars. Cox Automotive employees get to work on iconic consumer brands like Autotrader and Kelley Blue Book and industry-leading dealer-facing companies like vAuto and Manheim, all while enjoying the people-centered atmosphere that is central to our life at Cox. jobs.description:
Season: Spring 2027 (January 2027 - April 2027)

This internship is part of Eide Bailly's Transfer Pricing practice and reports to a Senior Associate. You will work as part of a collaborative team supporting multinational clients on transfer pricing documentation, planning, economic analysis, and implementation. The role combines accounting and financial analysis, business research, technical writing, and hands-on project support.

Who We Are

Eide Bailly is a top advisory firm with over 50 offices in the U.S. and India. Since 1917, we’ve built our firm around one thing: people. We believe meaningful work starts with meaningful relationships, with our clients, our communities, and each other. That’s why we focus on creating an environment where you feel supported, connected, and empowered to grow. You’ll be part of a team that values authenticity, fosters trust, and provides you with the tools to thrive.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • You’ll belong. We foster an inclusive, supportive environment where people look out for each other. You’re a valued part of the team from day one.
  • You’ll grow. You’ll get hands-on experience with a variety of clients and industries or projects, all while working directly with experienced professionals who want you to succeed.
  • You’ll be supported. Whether it’s your Welcome Guide, Career Advisor, or a co-worker you meet at lunch, you’ll always have someone available to answer questions and help you navigate your career.
  • You’ll have balance. Meaningful work is only one part of a meaningful life. We offer flexibility and benefits designed to support your well-being, inside and outside of work.
  • You’ll have fun. Yes, we’re accountants and business advisors, but we also like to celebrate, connect, and have a good time. Office events, volunteer opportunities, and casual team activities are all part of the experience.

What You'll Do

You will contribute across the transfer pricing engagement lifecycle, from understanding a client's business and organizing source data through economic analysis, documentation, and implementation support. Your work may include:

  • Learning the client's business by reviewing financial statements, organizational charts, intercompany agreements, transaction data, prior-year reports, and other background materials.
  • Organizing and analyzing financial and transactional data in Excel, including intercompany revenue and expenses, cost pools, allocation keys, profitability, and transfer pricing calculations.
  • Supporting functional and value-chain analyses by documenting the functions performed, assets used, and risks assumed by related entities.
  • Performing company, industry, and economic research and assisting with benchmarking analyses for intercompany services, product transactions, royalties, financing, and other controlled transactions.
  • Preparing clear workpapers, calculations, charts, presentations, and draft sections of transfer pricing reports, master files, local files, policy documents, and planning analyses.
  • Assisting with operational transfer pricing, including calculation models, true-ups, invoicing support, process documentation, and alignment between intercompany agreements and the intended policy.
  • Supporting due diligence, audit-readiness, and controversy matters by organizing facts, checking calculations, and preparing supporting analyses and response materials.
  • Participating in team planning and review discussions, communicating status and open items, incorporating feedback, and coordinating with tax, valuation, customs, and other specialists when needed.

How You'll Work and Grow

You will work directly with experienced transfer pricing professionals who will provide guidance, feedback, and coaching as you take ownership of defined workstreams. Assignments will start with foundational research, data organization, and analysis, then build toward client-ready workpapers, documentation, and drafting.

You will gain exposure to projects across industries, transaction types, and jurisdictions while contributing as part of a small, collaborative team. Along the way, you will strengthen practical skills in Excel-based analysis, financial review, economic research, technical writing, and project management.

You will also learn how transfer pricing analysis is translated into documentation, calculations, agreements, invoicing, and year-end adjustments. As you grow, you will build professional judgment by documenting assumptions, checking your work, asking questions early, and incorporating review comments thoughtfully.

Who You Are

  • You are working toward a bachelor's or master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business, Data Analytics, or another relevant discipline.
  • You are comfortable working with data and have strong Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint skills; experience with data tools or financial databases is a plus.
  • You are curious about how multinational businesses operate and interested in applying financial, economic, accounting, and tax concepts to real client issues.
  • You are detail-oriented and take ownership of assigned tasks, including documenting assumptions, checking your work, and raising issues early.
  • You can manage multiple priorities, incorporate feedback, and work effectively in a collaborative, deadline-driven environment.
  • You communicate clearly, ask thoughtful questions, and can explain your work in a concise and organized manner.
  • You demonstrate sound judgment and professionalism when handling client information.

Must be authorized to work in the United States now or in the future without visa sponsorship.

We are excited to share that intern positions across our firm are paid between $25.00-$32.00/hour and are eligible for overtime. If you are offered an intern position with Eide Bailly, your pay rate will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education and/or experience. Interns are eligible for health insurance and 401(k) Profit Sharing.

Eide Bailly is proud to be an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer.   • Develop scalable playbooks for inbound conversion, outbound reply handling, AI-assisted outreach responses, lead recycling, and supplemental prospecting during non-peak periods.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of Eventeny's platform and model customer empathy, ethical selling, and clear communication in every interaction.

This is a full-time position with a base salary of $85,000. Commissions are paid quarterly and are uncapped for all reps . This is a remote position in the US only.

Job Description (Applies to All Levels)

The Mobile Inspector functions as a key member of the Manheim Mobile Inspections team, responsible for conducting on‑site vehicle condition inspections for dealer clients within an assigned territory. This role provides accurate, detailed, and timely documentation of vehicle condition in accordance with Manheim inspection standards, supporting client trust, marketplace transparency, and inventory flow.

Mobile Inspectors build strong relationships with dealer clients by delivering consistent, high‑quality inspections, acting as brand ambassadors for Cox Automotive, and actively engaging dealers to grow participation in Manheim’s mobile inspection services.

This role requires the ability to work with minimal supervision while demonstrating increasing independence, sound judgment, and problem‑solving skills.

Primary Responsibilities & Essential Functions

Vehicle Inspection & Documentation

  • Conduct thorough vehicle inspections in accordance with Manheim inspection standards.
  • Locate, start, move, inspect, and return vehicles safely on dealer client lots.
  • Verify vehicle identification, VINs, mileage, sub‑series, and options; ensure accurate system entry.
  • Inspect and document vehicle exterior condition, including tires, frame, glass, panels, and mechanical components.
  • Inspect and document interior condition, including seating, dashboard, and installed options.
  • Perform basic mechanical checks across powertrain, drivetrain, and electrical components.
  • Identify and document damage, missing components, or inoperable features.

Client Engagement & Territory Management

  • Educate clients on the value of Manheim Marketplace and mobile inspection services.
  • Proactively engage with dealers to increase inspection volume and maintain active participation.
  • Leverage data, insights, and partner input to maximize inspection efficiency and territory productivity.
  • Adapt to changes in daily appointments and schedules to ensure effective dealer coverage.

Reporting, Tools & Collaboration

  • Utilize Salesforce.com for reporting, lead management, and customer performance tracking.
  • Collaborate closely with Wholesale Specialists, peers, and other Manheim teams to support client success.

Safety, Compliance & Standards

  • Participate actively in Safety Excellence initiatives.
  • Comply with Manheim inspection standards, including the NAAA Frame/Structure Damage Policy.

Entry‑level role responsible for conducting vehicle inspections under established processes while learning Manheim inspection standards, tools, and client engagement practices.

  • Minimal automotive knowledge preferred (body and mechanical)

Key Responsibilities

Mobile Inspector – Senior Level

  • Previous vehicle inspection experience required
