Overview

Lumicera Health Services is seeking a Sr. Analyst, Health System Pharmacy Financial Performance to join our team!

The Sr. Analyst, Health System Pharmacy Performance serves as a senior individual contributor responsible for financial analysis and insights supporting specialty pharmacy and health system pharmacy performance. The role works closely with Finance, Pharmacy Operations, Contracting, Analytics, Account Management, 340B, and health system partners to evaluate complex financial, reimbursement, claims, purchasing, inventory, payer, drug, and operational data.

The role advances pharmacy revenue integrity, organizational growth, and profitability by delivering actionable insights that improve reimbursement and margin performance, identify financial risks and opportunities, inform strategic decisions, and support health system pharmacy initiatives. The analyst independently determines analytical approaches, develops recommendations, and provides leaders with clear financial narratives and decision-ready materials.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Lead the preparation of financial analyses and performance review materials used in monthly and periodic health system pharmacy business reviews; identify key drivers, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions for business leaders.
  • Analyze actual financial and operational performance against budgets, forecasts, and other appropriate benchmarks to explain variances and inform corrective action.
  • Identify and explain drivers affecting prescription volume, revenue, reimbursement, drug acquisition cost, cost of goods sold (COGS), gross margin, operating expenses, and net operating income.
  • Independently identify emerging financial risks and opportunities and recommend actions to pharmacy and finance leadership; escalate significant risks, data limitations, or control concerns when appropriate.
  • Determine analytical approaches and perform drug-, payer-, clinic-, market-, disease-state-, claim-, and therapy-level analyses to explain performance and investigate complex financial issues.
  • Analyze pharmacy reimbursement and negative margin claims to identify actionable opportunities that improve margin performance and reduce avoidable losses.
  • Evaluate purchasing, inventory, replenishment, inflation, price, volume, and therapy-mix impacts on pharmacy financial performance and recommend opportunities to improve results.
  • Quantify the financial impact of operational changes, contracting decisions, payer access, limited-distribution drug access, referral capture, network integrity, 340B activity, rebate performance (MFP, GPO, etc.), and other revenue integrity initiatives.
  • Develop financial forecasts, budget models, scenario analyses, variance bridges, return-on-investment models, and planning assumptions supporting annual budgeting, recurring forecasts, strategic planning, and long-range planning.
  • Influence strategic decisions by translating advanced financial modeling and scenario analysis into clear alternatives, risks, and recommendations.
  • Prepare concise, executive-ready analyses and data stories that describe what occurred, why it occurred, its financial impact, whether the drivers are expected to continue, and what actions or decisions required.
  • Provide financial guidance to Finance, Pharmacy Operations, Account Management, Analytics, Contracting, 340B, and health system stakeholders; gather context, validate conclusions, and align recommendations with business needs.
  • Use Microsoft Excel, QlikView, Qlik Sense, Power BI, SQL, and other analytical tools to develop models, metrics, visualizations, dashboards, recurring reports, and ad hoc analyses.
  • Own validation and reconciliation of financial and operational analyses to applicable source systems, financial statements, and supporting data to improve reporting accuracy and decision confidence.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Analytics, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field or equivalent work experience, required. Master's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Healthcare Administration, Analytics, or a related field, preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience with a bachelor’s degree or 3+ years of experience with a master’s degree in financial analysis, healthcare finance, pharmacy finance, revenue integrity, financial planning and analysis, business analytics, or a related field, required.
  • Experience interpreting financial statements and performing budget-to-actual, forecast, variance, margin, rate, volume, and mix analysis, required.
  • Experience developing financial models, forecasts, scenario analyses, and executive-level financial reporting, required.
  • Advanced experience using Microsoft Excel to perform financial analysis, including PivotTables, lookups, complex formulas, data validation, reconciliation, and financial modeling, required.
  • Experience communicating complex financial findings and recommendations to operational and executive audiences, required.
  • Experience with pharmacy, specialty pharmacy, health system pharmacy, pharmacy benefit management, healthcare reimbursement, or pharmacy claims, strongly preferred.
  • Experience analyzing drug-level reimbursement, payer performance, pharmacy purchasing, inventory economics, COGS, or negative margin claims, preferred.
  • Experience with business intelligence tools such as QlikView, Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau, SAS, or other reporting and visualization platforms, preferred.
  • Experience with SQL, Python, R, or other data analysis tools, preferred.
  • Participate in, adhere to, and support compliance program objectives.
  • The ability to consistently interact cooperatively and respectfully with other employees.

What can you expect from Lumicera?

  • 401K company match of up to 5% - No vesting requirement

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Payments Gateway
jobs.excerpt: About Versapay 🚀Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage.
jobs.description:
About Versapay 🚀

Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage.
Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum — giving finance leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward.
Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually.
Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!

Your Impact at Versapay:

Product management at Versapay is a craft that blends strategic thinking, customer empathy, and strong execution. As Senior Product Manager, Payments Gateway, you will own Versapay’s payment gateways: the platform every Versapay payment flows through, from authorization to settlement.

You will set the vision and roadmap for a modular, scalable, multi-tenant gateway that connects Versapay’saccounts receivable products to processors, acquirers, and card & bank networks. You ownboth the product and business outcomes for the gateways; authorization and payment success rates, uptime and latency, downgrades, cost per transaction, and more.

This is a platform role. Your customers are Versapay’s product teams, our core processing partners, the developers and ERP partners who integrate with us, and the ledger and finance teams who depend on every payment landing correctly. You will partner directly with engineering on architecture and delivery, work with go-to-market teams on positioning and regularly represent gateway strategy and performance to senior leadership, influencing direction and investment.

This is an opportunity for a product leader who has built/scaled a payment gateway and is ready to grow and modernize a global B2B payments platform.

What You'll Do:

    • Own the gateway strategy and roadmap. Set the multi-year vision for Versapay’s owned gateways across card, bank, and alternative payment methods in every market we serve. Balance near-term improvements with long-term platform investments and make the trade-offs explicit.

    • Drive payment performance. Own the gateway’s core KPIs: authorization and payment success rates, decline and retry performance, uptime, latency, and processing cost. Improve them through connection optimization, failover, smart retries, network tokenization, account updater, 3DS and authentication flows, and B2B card data (Level 2/3).

    • Build the platform others build on. Define the gateway’s APIs, SDKs, hosted payment pages, webhooks, and merchant and MID configuration so Versapay product teams and partners can launch new payment experiences in days, not quarters.

    • Own processor, acquirer, and network connectivity. Lead the evaluation, certification, and launch of processor and acquirer integrations and new network capabilities. Translate network specs and mandates into clear requirements, and keep the gateway compliant with card brand rules, PCI DSS, and regional regulations.

    • Own the transaction lifecycle end to end. Authorization, capture, refunds, voids, disputes and chargebacks, and settlement, including the clean handoff of transaction data to ledger and reconciliation. Partner with risk, compliance, and payment operations to keep money moving safely.

    • Lead engineering teams to deliver. Lead engineering team(s) and oversee execution across pods, from writing requirements to measuring success. Drive trade-off decisions on architecture, reliability, and platform design while keeping the team unblocked and managing the SDLC.

    • Use AI to compound platform value. Apply ML and agentic approaches to retry optimization, decline analysis, anomaly detection, incident triage, and partner integration support. Versapay is rebuilding for an AI-native operating model, and the gateway is core to that.

    • Be the in-house expert. Serve as Versapay’s authority on gateway architecture, payment processing, and network rules. Educate product and engineering teams, brief executives, and represent the platform externally with partners and customers.

What You Bring to the Team:

    • 6+ years in payments or fintech product management, with at least 3 years owning a payment gateway, processing, orchestration, or PSP platform end to end. Senior IC who has driven a roadmap, not just contributed to one.

    • Built or significantly scaled a gateway. You have shipped gateway capabilities in production — not just integrated a third-party gateway — and can speak to what changed and why.

    • Deep transaction lifecycle expertise. You understand authorization flows, network messaging (ISO 8583), tokenization, capture and settlement, chargebacks, interchange, and failover, and how each affects merchants and cost.

    • A record of moving payment performance metrics. You have measurably improved authorization rates, processing cost, uptime, or latency, and can show the data.

    • Global payments expertise. Experience across North America and international markets, including multi-currency processing, local payment methods, and the regimes that govern them (PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, card brand rules).

    • Track record of leading engineering teams in execution. You have overseen engineering pods or squads as the product owner, setting priorities, removing blockers, making architectural trade-offs alongside engineering leadership, and shipping on commitment.

    • AI fluency. Hands-on experience applying LLMs, ML, or agentic systems to payment workflows. You have a clear, defensible point of view on where AI belongs in a gateway and where it must not.

    • Builder mentality. Entrepreneurial, biased to action, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by net-new initiatives where the path is not yet drawn.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product engineer to own product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Australia. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Australia.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
Simplex Health is seeking a Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) to provide telehealth outpatient medical nutrition therapy using an integrative and functional nutrition approach. This is a fully remote, full-time role offering a consistent schedule and the opportunity to build deep, ongoing relationships with patients.

Unlike many outpatient roles, this position offers a full-time, salaried structure with benefits, providing stability and consistency in your schedule and income—while giving you the flexibility to choose a schedule that fits your lifestyle.

The ideal candidate has experience in clinical or outpatient nutrition counseling, is licensed (or eligible for licensure) in Pennsylvania, and is passionate about delivering personalized, root-cause care to support long-term health outcomes.

Our Mission: Radically improve the health of Humankind—one person, one appointment, one connection at a time.

At Simplex Health, we do things differently. Our insurance-funded medical nutrition therapy goes beyond symptom management to improve — and in many cases reverse — chronic conditions. We partner with hospitals, healthcare practices, and individuals to provide personalized, root-cause nutrition care across a wide range of conditions, including metabolic health, digestive disorders, hormonal imbalances, and chronic disease.

Our approach is grounded in prevention, root-cause resolution, and sustainable lifestyle change, supporting patients throughout their health journey. Through a fully virtual, telehealth model, we meet patients where they are, delivering accessible, high-quality care.

Our evidence-based, progressive nutrition interventions are tailored to each patient’s unique biochemistry. Through nutrition counseling, education, and health coaching, we empower patients to improve their health, build lasting habits, and achieve meaningful, long-term outcomes.

Role details:

  • Location: Telehealth
  • Schedule Options: Choose between a 4-day (32-hour) or 5-day (40-hour) work week, with flexibility to design a schedule that fits both your preferences and your patients’ needs.
  • Reports to: Clinical Manager
  • Compensation:
    • 32 hours/week (4-day work week): $44,000–$59,000 annually
    • 40 hours/week (5-day work week): $55,000–$70,000 annually
    • Final schedule and compensation are aligned based on candidate preference, experience, and availability

You love helping people heal. You just don’t love doing it all alone.

If you’ve ever run (or dreamed of running) your own private practice, you know what it takes — the marketing, the scheduling, the billing, the insurance headaches, the empty calendar days, the tech issues, the isolation…

At Simplex Health, you get the best parts of private practice — the autonomy, the flexibility, the deep 1:1 relationships with patients — without the burnout or business stress.

Here, you get to focus on what you do best: helping patients transform their health through integrative and functional nutrition.

What we are looking for:

  • Are passionate about integrative and functional nutrition
  • Thrive in a collaborative, growth-minded environment
  • Have at least 2 years of experience in outpatient or clinical care

Preferred:

PA license and completion of major insurance credentialing required before start; this process may take 3–6 months.

Role Responsibilities (including but not limited to):

  • Provide telehealth medical nutrition therapy using a functional and integrative approach
  • Implement Simplex Health protocols, tools, and educational materials in patient care
  • Assess the nutritional health of patients/clients and develop personalized, root-cause care plans
  • Create and modify individualized nutrition interventions based on patient needs and goals
  • Document all new and follow-up appointments in the Healthie platform with strong attention to detail
  • Respond to patient communications in a timely, professional, and supportive manner
  • Collaborate with team members through case discussions, meetings, and shared learning opportunities
  • Communicate openly and effectively to resolve work-related issues and support team outcomes
  • Contribute to a positive, collaborative team environment and ongoing clinical initiatives
  • Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and clinical standards
  • Stay current with emerging research and best practices in nutrition and health
  • Manage a full and consistent patient caseload, ensuring timely follow-ups, continuity of care, and optimal patient outcomes

What to expect:

At Simplex Health, you’ll have access to:

  • Structured onboarding and training
  • Regular case reviews and clinical collaboration
  • Real-time support via team chat and peer connection
  • Team meetings and shared learning opportunities
  • Opportunities to contribute to committees, resources, and clinical initiatives
  • Credentialing: If you’re not yet in-network, our team fully manages the insurance credentialing process on your behalf, including covering all associated fees and handling the paperwork.
  • Ramp-Up To Full-Time: This role begins in a ramp-up phase with variable hours as your patient caseload grows, transitioning into a full-time, salaried schedule once full-time metrics are met. Our team provides consistent referrals and support to help you build a full and sustainable schedule as quickly as possible.

Benefits

Called: A passion for our mission and a sense that this role and company are a strong fit for the blessings of your gifts, talents, passions, and experiences.. Must be mission-motivated with a resolve to overcome obstacles, anchored in a sense of purpose in this work.

This person will have to have an open mind and good resolve, whether it’s looping in other people, finding answers online, or seeking best practices.

Organizational Skills: Being or becoming a constant organizational force. It will require a capacity for being open to change, discerning better processes, and prioritizing for improved outcomes.

Chemistry Fit: We have a unique and fun culture—we laugh, press in, work hard, and jump in to figure things out. Fitting into the team chemistry is essential.

High Character: We operate with a high trust culture. Personal values must fuel our work. Integrity, honesty, compassion, reconciliation, and diligence are all things this person must possess to flourish.

Energy & Enthusiasm: This person must bring joy and passion for work to the job. Encouraging and spurring on others on the mission while being self-motivated and positive is essential.

Multitasking: This is not a steady-state or static environment. Workflow will cycle, and interruptions are normal, so this person must be able to juggle and adjust on the fly.

Project Management: While multitasking, this person must be able to keep an eye on deadlines and critical dependencies, working to preserve them or source support proactively.

Because great clinicians deserve great support.

Leaders who listen, and a clinical community that truly supports one another.

Even in a virtual environment, you’ll feel connected, encouraged, and supported.

If you’ve ever wished you could combine the freedom of private practice with the camaraderie and stability of a larger organization, this is where you belong.

Apply today and rediscover the joy of patient care without the grind of running a business.

Simplex Health Core Values:

Simplex Health strives to embody the following values and to apply them to every aspect of how we run our business, including how we interact with each other as teammates and leaders. These values also apply to how we interact with and continue to inspire our clients and strategic partners:

We Inspire Each Other

Through cultivating genuine, transparent, relationships, we create an environment that encourages individuals to dream big, take risks, and be bold. We aim to inspire and commit to everyone we touch. This sense of commitment and care sets the stage for a culture of accountability, where we hold ourselves and each other to the same high standards, taking the ownership necessary for achieving our goals.
Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.
1 Thessalonians 5:11

We at Simplex Health strive to be continual learners and to expand our abilities as people and as an organization. We educate ourselves, remain curious, and use evidence-based research to challenge our current understanding. We see mistakes and failure as great teachers and learning opportunities. When we stay engaged in the world with a growth mindset, it creates the right environment for us to thrive and make a meaningful impact on each other and on the world.
Let the wise hear and increase in learning, and the one who understands obtain guidance.
Proverbs 1:5

Before making any major decision, ask yourself:

Now we see things imperfectly, like puzzling reflections in a mirror, but then we will see everything with perfect clarity. All that I know now is partial and incomplete, but then I will know everything completely, just as God now knows me completely.
I Corinthians 13:12

We are inquisitive by nature. We are courageous! We are not afraid to go against the grain in our search for truth. We always question conventional wisdom- it’s how Simplex Health started- it’s what we do.
Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will. Romans 12:2

We Cultivate Health and Vitality:
Being alive in a body is an incredible, temporary experience. Even though at times we feel pain and face challenges, our next breath is not guaranteed and is a HUGE gift. We see health and vitality as the foundation for living a life that is happy, fulfilled, present, and productive.
Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well.

We Embody Integrity:

We do this with the understanding that we respect each other and recognize that we are on the same team working toward a unified noble mission with shared goals. We don’t compromise our morals or integrity no matter the context. When challenging scenarios arise, we approach them with honesty and trust that we are all holding the highest intentions, are committed to our values, and are making best efforts.
Do to others as you would have them do to you.
Luke 6:31

We Simplify the Complicated:
We believe that complex problems don’t always require complex solutions. By simplifying the complicated and offering digestible, scalable solutions, we can pay more attention to the things that matter most. Simplicity- it’s the word that inspired our name - we make cultivating health and vitality simple.

Philippians 4:6

jobs.excerpt: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Observability team builds the platform every Affirm engineer relies on to understand the behavior and performance of our systems. Our platform ingests 200+ TB/day of metrics, logs, and traces from hundreds of services across 80+ Kubernetes clusters, and when a user's checkout fails, our data is how engineers find out why. Over the next year, we’re moving to wide events, with one context-rich event per request, improving the signal-to-noise ratio to make debugging faster. We’re also introducing log sampling and building observability best practices into agentic development and code review, so that AI-assisted code is well instrumented by default.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical lead for Observability. You’ll spend most of your time hands-on while defining the roadmap, driving cross-functional projects, mentoring a team of six engineers, and partnering closely with infrastructure and product teams.


What You'll Do

· You will own the architecture of Affirm’s telemetry pipeline, balancing reliability, query performance, and cost at 200+ TB/day.
· You will design log sampling strategies that significantly reduce volume and cost without losing the signal engineers need during incidents.
· You will shape how observability fits into agentic development, so that AI coding agents and code review catch instrumentation gaps before code ships.
· You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.
· You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.
· You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.
· You take ownership of your team’s operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, polcities, testing and alerting in place to support “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
· You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
· You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.


What We Look For

· You have 8+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
· You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Flink and Kubernetes.
· You have built or operated high-volume telemetry systems (metrics, logs, and/or traces) using technologies like OpenTelemetry, Kafka, and Terraform.
· You have a well-informed point of view on modern observability practices such as structured and wide events, sampling, cardinality management, and SLOs.
· You have driven adoption of a platform standard across many engineering teams, through both tooling and engagement.
· You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
· You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work.
· Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross-functional peers.
· You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
· This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Equity Grade - 13

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states): $204,000 - $264,000

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

As Staff Software Engineer, AI Email App, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales.

What You'll Own

  • Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.

  • Design reliable systems for AI-powered workflows, including state, orchestration, tool use, retries, fallbacks, and failure handling.

  • Build the APIs and abstractions that connect AI systems to real-world product experiences.

  • Lead a small, senior engineering team and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship.

  • Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience.

  • Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

  • Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

  • A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage.

  • High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals.

Outcomes

  • Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load.

  • Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience.

  • Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

jobs.description:
Democrats for Education reform (DFER) is seeking a Vice President, Advocacy to execute our state-based advocacy function to ensure DFER advances a systematic, state-by-state advocacy program aligned with our executive engagement strategy. The Vice President, Advocacy will build and lead this national Advocacy function, taking ownership of state policy strategy — partnering with governors and their senior teams, executive branch leaders, legislative leaders, and in-state advocates to move DFER’s priorities through whichever levers fit: executive action, the state budget, legislation, and regulation. This person will build on DFER’s existing gubernatorial relationships and drive our policy commitments from inception through implementation. The VP, Advocacy will operate at a national scale and lead deep, multi-lever campaigns in two to three priority states each year while maintaining relationships with governors and their teams in several additional states — a tiered model that lets DFER go deep where opportunities are ripest and stay ready to move elsewhere as windows open. The role will shift across regions and markets as political conditions change.

Requirements

State Advocacy Strategy

  • Stand up and oversee DFER's new Advocacy function, including:
  • Aligning state-based advocacy with DFER's executive engagement strategy, leveraging existing political capital and relationships;
  • Establishing clear ownership and accountability for moving campaign commitments to enacted policy through executive, budgetary, legislative and regulatory channels in target states;
  • Mapping and identifying “emerging market” states that may have new opportunity for legislation, in alignment with our policy agenda;
  • Developing state-by-state advocacy plans in 5 - 7 states, aligned with DFER's executive strategy and Policy Framework;
  • Coordinating with the Policy Team on relevant and timely policy strategy memos for governors and their teams that map the right levers (executive orders, budget proposals, legislation, agency rules) for each priority;
  • Leading DFER’s post-election engagement with newly-elected governors, serving as the administration’s policy partner through the first legislative session and budget cycle.

Relationship Management & Lobbying

  • Develop and maintain relationships with governors’ senior staff, cabinet and agency leaders, legislative leaders and staff, and in-state advocacy partners.
  • Meet regularly - both in person and remotely - with senior sitting governors and state legislative staff on time-sensitive, relevant policy priorities, in collaboration with our Campaigns and Policy teams.
  • Partner with the Policy team to track and draft legislation in target states.
  • Manage lobbying contracts and oversee 4-6 active lobbying efforts to execute state-based advocacy strategies.

Coalitions & Communications

  • Coordinate with in-state coalitions and advocates to build support for priority policies across executive and legislative branches.
  • In states without an established coalition, evaluate the local partner landscape for coalition potential and, where feasible, support on-the-ground partners in forming one.
  • Partner with the Communications team on earned media, op-eds and public campaigns that build momentum for state priorities.
  • Work with the Research team to deploy state polling and data in advocacy plans.
  • Represent DFER in state and national convening's, building visibility for DFER’s state wins.

Function Leadership & Operations

  • Build the Advocacy function’s structure, processes and tools, including state tracking systems, playbooks and reporting templates.
  • Manage the Advocacy budget, including lobbying contracts, consultants and state-based vendors.
  • Set annual goals and OKRs for state policy wins, and report progress to leadership and the board.
  • Ensure compliance with state lobbying registration and reporting requirements, in partnership with Finance and compliance counsel.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in public policy, political science, or related field a plus (not required with equivalent experience)
  • State Policy and/or Legislative Experience: 8-10+ years of experience in state government, state legislative affairs, campaigns, or political advocacy, including senior-level roles. Deep, working knowledge of state legislative processes, procedures, and calendars, ideally across multiple states.
  • Executive Branch Experience: Experience working in or alongside a governor’s office or state agency, including on budget development, executive actions or policy implementation, strongly preferred.
  • Relationship Management: Established relationships with, or demonstrated ability to quickly build relationships with, state legislators, governors' offices, and legislative staff.
  • Lobbying Expertise: Direct experience lobbying or directing lobbying efforts on specific pieces of legislation, with a track record of bills advanced or passed. Experience overseeing external lobbyists or vendors, including contract management and performance accountability.
  • Collaboration: Expert collaborator, adept at identifying stakeholders and partners, both internally and externally, to align our policy efforts and advance legislation, building on our existing relationships and expertise.
  • Sound Political Judgment & Adaptability: Sound political judgment, including the ability to read shifting legislative dynamics and adjust strategy in real time.
  • Professionalism: Ability to work collaboratively within a team, manage confidential information with discretion, and remain resilient in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to Equity: A demonstrated commitment to advancing educational equity and excellence for all students.

Reports To: President, and requires 30% travel.

Benefits

The salary for this position is $185,000 - $200,000. DFER is proud to offer excellent benefits: health, vision, and dental coverage; flexible spending plan; life insurance; short- and long-term disability insurance; 401K plan with a match plan; flexible spending/benefits plan; paid family leave; paid time off (vacation, sick time, and all National holidays) and paid vacation.

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

Democrats for Education Reform welcomes applications from all, and strongly encourages women, people of color, people with disabilities, immigrants, refugees & LGBTQ people to apply for this position. We are committed to maximizing the diversity of our organization and recruiting a team that reflects the diversity of students living in the communities we serve.

As a forward-deployed engineer, you’ll work on-site with customers — writing code, integrating systems, and solving hard problems in the field. You’re part engineer, part technical advisor, and wholly accountable for making the mission succeed. The position requires a current or active U.S. TS/SCI clearance.

Spear AI is a growing defense contracting company dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions that support our nation’s security. As we expand, we’re building a culture where innovation meets mission-critical work. We operate with a flat organizational structure that empowers every team member to make an impact, collaborate directly with leadership, and contribute to projects that matter. Whether you’re joining our Hardware, Software, or Services division, you’ll work alongside talented professionals who are committed to excellence and advancing the capabilities that keep our nation safe and secure.

Spear AI builds sonobuoy sensors that are deployed into the water and collect edge data. We also work with the U.S. Navy to collect and process their SONAR data. You’ll have an opportunity to work on real-world projects that directly impact warfighter capabilities and mission success.

What you’ll do

We’re a small team wearing many hats, and you’d have a wide variety of responsibilities that include:

  • Design and implement cloud architecture.

  • Develop Infrastructure as Code using Pulumi.

  • Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD and DevSecOps pipelines.

  • Continuously deploy to AWS cloud and air-gapped environments.

  • Monitor applications/services with OpenTelemetry, Sentry, and SigNoz.

  • Enforce CMMC compliance policies and rules.

  • Manage secrets and configuration.

  • Deploy, configure, and troubleshoot infrastructure within customer and air-gapped environments.

  • Support RHEL/Linux-based platforms using Kubernetes, Podman, Docker, and Helm in operational environments.

  • Partner directly with customer engineering teams to integrate, test, and resolve infrastructure issues.

  • Travel to customer sites as needed to support deployments, upgrades, and mission execution.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone with strong Software Engineering skills who shares our most important values:

  • You’re fanatical about polish. Every detail matters. You love to make sure your code is linted, formatted, fully typed, and has 100% test coverage.

  • You care about correctness. You take pride in the fact that downstream consumers trust libraries and services you build.

  • You obsess over performance. You daydream about Lighthouse scores and query speed.

  • You dive deep. It’s important for you to really know how things work. You’re always building prototypes and setting up experiments to reinforce your understanding.

  • You live on the bleeding edge. You’ve got a long list of upcoming platform features you’re excited about and can’t wait for the next nightly to drop.

  • You’re a great teacher. You know how to break down a concept for a specific audience and make it click with them in a way that gets them excited.

Why work with us

  • We ship — We don’t work on 18-month projects that are irrelevant before they’re even finished.

  • Our work has impact — We build products that are deployed to U.S. submarines and integrate with the sonobuoys we manufacture.

  • We’re growing responsibly — We have the resources to hire a lot more people, but we don’t want to build a massive team of people who don’t share our values.

  • We’re profitable — We aren’t burning through cash trying to make the business work. But we also have investors who believe in us and are committed to our success.

  • We care about doing great work — You don’t need permission to sweat the details here.

  • We don’t take ourselves too seriously — We’re building products that make the world safer. But we don’t let that get to our heads.

Important skills

  • Expert in Infrastructure as Code using Pulumi or Terraform.

  • Expert in Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Linux system administration, and Podman.

  • Experience deploying and managing containerized environments using Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and Podman.

  • Expert in CI/CD and DevSecOps, including GitLab CI/CD and GitHub Actions.

  • Proficiency in AWS and/or other cloud services.

  • Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, Python, Go, or TypeScript.

  • Proficiency with networking.

  • Familiar with cybersecurity compliance frameworks like CMMC, PCI, or SOC.

  • Familiar with Single Sign-on and Identity Providers (IdP) like Authentik and Keycloak.

  • Experience deploying to air-gapped environments.

  • Experience self-hosting on bare metal servers.

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting classified DoD or Navy environments.

  • Experience deploying infrastructure to air-gapped environments.

  • Familiarity with observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Sentry, or SigNoz.

  • Experience supporting edge computing, maritime systems, or sensor platforms.

  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or other secure cloud environments.

  • Experience working directly with government customers in operational environments.

What we offer

  • Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need to recharge and maintain work-life balance.

  • Dedicated sick time — Your health and well-being come first.

  • Comprehensive health and benefits – Medical, dental, and vision coverage to keep you and your family protected.

  • 11 Paid Holidays — Enjoy time off throughout the year to celebrate and spend time with loved ones.

  • Professional development — Educational opportunities and resources to help you grow your skills and advance your career.

  • Collaborative environment — Work directly with leadership in our flat organizational structure, where your ideas and contributions matter.

  • Mission-driven work — Contribute to projects that directly support national security and make a real-world impact.

  • Growth opportunities — Join us during an exciting expansion phase where you can help shape our future.

Additional benefit opportunities when you choose Spear AI:

  • 401(k) with company match.

  • Onsite / Remote / Flexible work arrangements or hybrid options (position dependent).

  • Relocation assistance (position dependent).

  • Referral bonuses.

  • Performance bonuses.

  • Life insurance and disability coverage.

  • Technology home office setup stipend.

  • Professional certification reimbursement (position dependent).

We offer competitive compensation tailored to your experience, location, and the impact you’ll make. We’re committed to equitable pay and will share a range aligned to your level and geography during the hiring process. In accordance with state law, candidates in jurisdictions such as CA, CO, WA, NY, and others, where applicable, will be provided a good-faith salary range upon request and throughout the hiring process. This is a full-time, exempt position under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and is not eligible for overtime pay.

Compensation for this position is provided on a salaried basis and is not subject to reduction based on hours worked. At Spear AI, you’ll find more than just a job; you’ll join a mission-driven team where your work directly contributes to national security. Our flat organizational structure means your voice matters, your ideas reach leadership, and your impact is visible. As we grow, we’re committed to building robust processes and infrastructure that support both our mission and our people. We value collaboration, continuous improvement, and the expertise each team member brings to the table. If you’re looking for a place to grow professionally while working on projects that truly matter, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description

Required Certificates and Licenses: Valid Texas Special Education certification and Principal certification


Residency Requirements: This position is virtual and open to residents of Texas


Start Date: Immediate


K12, a Stride Company, believes in Education for ANYONE. We provide families with an online option for a high-quality, personalized education experience. Students can thrive, find their passion, and learn in an environment that encourages discovery at their own pace.


Passionate Educators are needed at Stride K12 Texas partner schools, (TXSS). We want you to be a part of our talented team!


The mission of Stride K12 Texas partner schools, (TXSS) is to provide an exemplary individualized and engaging educational experience for students by incorporating school and community/family partnerships coupled with a rigorous curriculum along with a data-driven and student-centered instructional model. Student success will be measured by valid and reliable assessment data, parent and student satisfaction, and continued institutional growth within the academic community. Join us!


The Assistant Manager, Special Education TEALS Program is responsible for supporting the implementation and oversight of self-contained special education programs that provide academic and functional instruction aligned to students' individual needs. This role supports compliance with federal, state, and local special education requirements, including IEP implementation, service delivery, progress monitoring, and evaluations. The position partners with school leaders, instructional staff, and related service providers to promote high-quality, compliant, and student-centered programming. Additionally, the Assistant Manager provides staff supervision, training, and guidance to improve outcomes for students with disabilities.


This is a full-time position. Ability to work independently, typically 40+ hours per week is required. Ability to maintain a professional home office without distraction during workday, typically 9-5 (or 8-4) or as defined by the school.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • Support the implementation of TEALS special education programs and ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, including IDEA requirements.
  • Develop, implement, and communicate special education policies, procedures, and best practices in collaboration with school leadership.
  • Support and train staff to ensure compliance with special education requirements, timelines, and department expectations.
  • Oversee the development, implementation, and maintenance of REEDs, FIEs, IEPs, progress monitoring, and special education documentation.
  • Collaborate with related service providers and internal teams to ensure students receive required services and that service delivery is accurately tracked and reported.
  • Coordinate special education assessment activities, including STAAR Alternate 2 eligibility review, planning, and administration.
  • Analyze student and program data to support compliance, improve instructional practices, and drive positive student outcomes.
  • Supervise staff and foster collaboration among school leaders, general education staff, special education staff, and families to ensure high-quality, student-centered programming.

Supervisory Responsibilities: Directly supervises 20-25 Full-time Equivalent (FTE) regular employees and/or contractors. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

  • Master’s degree and three (3) years of special education teaching experience.
  • Knowledge of special education laws, regulations, compliance requirements, and instructional practices.
  • Strong leadership, communication, project management, and staff development skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
  • Ability to travel up to 20% of the time
  • Successfully complete required background checks.

  • Three (3) years of special education administration experience.
  • Experience supporting self-contained special education programs.
  • Experience with IDEA compliance, special education audits, and program monitoring.

    This is a full-cycle role - you run kickoff calls, handle day-to-day support, and build long-term customer relationships. You'll be part of our scaled success motion: ~80% async communication (Slack responses, documentation) with targeted calls for high-impact moments.

Position Type: Full-Time
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are looking for an exceptionally organized and process-driven Project Manager to manage commercial and industrial ERRCS (Emergency Responder Radio Coverage Systems) projects from bid through final closeout. You will coordinate project documentation, construction requirements, contractors, vendors, customers, engineers, and Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs). You will manage multiple projects simultaneously, track deadlines and requirements, prepare and submit documentation, and ensure each project progresses smoothly from quote through completion. This role is ideal for someone with U.S. commercial construction project management experience who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with construction documents, permits, contractors, and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Pre-Contract & Estimating

  • Review and log incoming bid requests in the project management/CRM system.
  • Review construction plans, drawings, specifications, and project manuals.
  • Research and document project requirements, including construction type, square footage, stories, taxes, warranties, maintenance agreements, insurance, bonds, and other requirements.
  • Research local AHJ requirements, fire codes, ERRCS policies, radio systems, frequencies, and permit requirements.
  • Coordinate with AHJs to confirm enforcement, testing, plan review, permitting, and inspection requirements.
  • Research contractor licensing and registration requirements.
  • Support budgetary pricing and prepare project quotes.
  • Maintain accurate project information and documentation in CRM and shared systems.

Contract Award & Vendor Coordination

  • Review contracts and identify unusual or inconsistent requirements.
  • Coordinate RFQs with RF engineers, installers, equipment distributors, and other vendors.
  • Review system designs, vendor quotes, and Bills of Materials for accuracy and completeness.
  • Coordinate pricing for equipment, electrical, fire alarm, roofing, and other project requirements.
  • Track sales tax, shipping, warranties, maintenance agreements, and other project costs.
  • Maintain executed contracts and project records.

Pre-Installation Documentation

  • Prepare, format, organize, and distribute project submittals to customers, installers, and AHJs.
  • Coordinate building plans, certifications, permits, equipment documentation, system designs, reports, and trade coordination documents.
  • Prepare and maintain installer work orders and project documentation.
  • Collect and verify vendor W-9s, COIs, OSHA certifications, and other required credentials.
  • Coordinate customer-specific requirements such as insurance, background checks, drug testing, badging, and certifications.
  • Confirm project and contractor licensing or permit requirements.

AHJ & Permit Coordination

  • Submit project documentation to AHJs for formal plan review when required.
  • Coordinate BDA transmission requests with applicable radio system administrators.
  • Apply for required fire or building permits.
  • Track plan reviews, radio approvals, permits, and inspections.
  • Follow up with AHJs and relevant authorities to keep approvals moving.
  • Maintain accurate records of regulatory and permitting requirements.

Installation & Project Coordination

  • Coordinate with technical services, installers, trades, customers, and vendors throughout the project.
  • Track equipment orders and delivery schedules.
  • Coordinate responses to changes in building plans, construction timelines, and project requirements.
  • Follow up on outstanding tasks, approvals, documents, and deliverables.
  • Maintain project timelines and ensure stakeholders remain informed.
  • Identify and resolve project issues before they impact deadlines.

Post-Installation & Closeout

  • Prepare and distribute final project closeout documentation.
  • Maintain system manuals and post-installation documentation.
  • Coordinate commissioning reports, signal test reports, warranties, installation photos, and as-built system designs.
  • Confirm completion of installer and trade coordination requirements.
  • Coordinate project invoicing and supporting documentation.
  • Follow up on lien waivers from installers and suppliers when required.
  • Ensure projects are fully documented and properly closed.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Maintain and improve standardized project management processes, templates, and systems.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve project workflows.
  • Build and maintain organized documentation systems.
  • Support automation initiatives to improve project tracking, reporting, and communication.
  • Continuously identify ways to improve efficiency and accountability.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience managing commercial or industrial construction projects.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, budgets, timelines, contractors, and resources simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. construction project workflows.
  • Familiarity with International Building Code (IBC) and International Fire Code (IFC).
  • Strong project documentation and coordination experience.
  • Experience working with contractors, vendors, customers, engineers, and regulatory authorities.
  • Expert-level proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and SharePoint.
  • Strong experience with project management systems and/or CRM platforms.
  • Excellent professional English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Exceptional organization, follow-up, and attention to detail.
  • Strong ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
  • Self-starter with the ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.
  • Continuous-improvement mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with ERRCS, PS-DAS, BDA, RF systems, fire alarm systems, or public safety communications.
  • Experience with Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, or similar construction management platforms.
  • Experience coordinating with Fire Departments, Building Departments, Fire Marshals, Building Inspectors, or other AHJs.
  • Experience with construction permitting and plan review processes.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based commercial construction companies.

Typical Day

A typical day may include reviewing new bid requests, researching project and AHJ requirements, updating project records, following up with contractors and vendors, coordinating RFQs and submittals, tracking permits and approvals, reviewing project documentation, communicating with customers, and updating project timelines and action items.

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.  

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.  

We deliver with agility.   

We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.  

United by respect.   

Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.  

Teams make “it” happen.  

Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.

The Accounts Payable Analyst reports to the Manager, Accounts Payable and supports day-to-day AP operations across more than 10 entities in the U.S. and EU. The Analyst is responsible for vendor management, payment preparation, reconciliations, close support, and vendor and internal inquiry resolution.

The Analyst is the day-to-day face of AP for our vendor community and internal stakeholders, and must communicate clearly, respond with empathy and urgency, and build confidence and trust, while exercising sound judgment on when to resolve an issue independently and when to escalate. Vendor Management and Payments

  • Support vendor onboarding by collecting and validating tax forms, banking information, contact details, and other required documentation.

  • Prepare domestic and international vendor payments through ACH, check, wire transfer, virtual card, or other approved payment methods, and support weekly pay cycles and urgent payment requests.

Reconciliations, Close, and Reporting

  • Support AP month-end and year-end close activities, including accrual support and follow-up on outstanding invoices and credits.

  • Prepare reports on outstanding invoices, upcoming payments, unapplied vendor credits, and payment exceptions, and support Finance with research into vendor costs by entity, cost center, and expense category.
  • Assist with audit requests and provide supporting documentation as needed.

Process Improvement

  • Maintain and follow documented AP procedures, and flag opportunities to improve accuracy, efficiency, and controls.
  • Support AP projects, training, and automation initiatives.

 

Required Education and Experience:

Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related field preferred; an associate degree with equivalent relevant experience will be considered.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • 3+ years of accounts payable experience, including invoice processing, discrepancy resolution, payment preparation, and vendor communication.
  • Experience in a multi-entity environment; exposure to international AP, multi-currency transactions, and VAT strongly preferred.
  • Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP required.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to work with large volumes of transactional data and support reconciliations and reporting.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy, timeliness, and confidentiality.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills and a professional, service-oriented approach, with the ability to build and maintain positive relationships with vendors and internal stakeholders.

 

Best-in-Class Benefits and Perks 

We value the time, talent, and dedication our employees bring to START. Our commitment to your well-being and growth is reflected in a competitive compensation package—based on experience—along with comprehensive benefits designed to support you both personally and professionally: 

 

  • 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match 
  • Eligibility for an annual performance bonus, based on role and company results 
  • Generous paid time off and paid holidays 
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage and optional insurance options 
  • Company paid life and disability insurance for added financial protection

More About START 

START clinical trial sites have conducted more than 1,000 early-phase clinical trials, including dozens of therapies that were approved by the FDA or EMA. START represents the world’s largest roster of early-phase principal investigators across its Network of clinical trial sites. Committed to accelerating passage from trials to treatments, START delivers hope to patients, families, and physicians around the world via our mission of “Hope Through Access”.

Kolsquareis the #1 Influencer Marketing software solution in Europe, used by marketing professionals for managing KOL Marketing campaigns (K.O.L for Key Opinion Leaders, aka Influencers), and designed to optimize brand communication strategies in response to new digital challenges.
Using our technology, professionals can identify the best KOL profiles, fully manage their KOL Marketing campaigns and measure their results and performances.

In 2024, Kolsquare joined the team.blue group, one of the largest private tech companies in Europe, with a culture of innovation and excellence, to further fuel its impressive track record of outstanding profitable growth.

KOLSQUARE MISSION

Kolsquare is a Benefit Company, certified B-Corp in 2024.

Kolsquare exists to help you reach your greatest potential. And positively impact the world.

Influencer Marketing is today described as a revolution, a 30B$ market that is a major transformation in the media and digital world. It has also become a real gold mine, creating high hopes but also bringing its share of myths and legends. Everyone knows it works and can have an amazing impact on brand awareness or customer acquisition, but not everyone knows exactly how to do it. At Kolsquare, we firmly believe in this new media and are convinced that it's the best way for ideas, people and organisations to grow and reach their greatest potential. We also believe that it's a great way to create positive impacts for a better world. Our mission is therefore to give everyone access to the power of KOL Marketing.

KOLSQUARE CULTURE & VALUES

  • Deliver WOW

  • Be Responsible in your actions

  • Pursue Growth & Learning

  • Be passionate and determined

  • Share your Power, Knowledge & Wealth

  • Build Authentic relationships

We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.

📌 More info about culture here in our Culture Book.

THE ROLE

In 2024, Kolsquare joined theteam.bluegroup, one of the largest private tech companies in Europe,. Since then, Kolsquare has grown through acquisition, welcoming Storyclash in Austria and Inflead in Italy in 2025.
Today, Kolsquare is also partnering with helloCash, another well-established Austrian SaaS company withinteam.blue, to help professionalize its People function as it scales.

Kolsquare and helloCash together represent 160+ people, mainly across Austria, France, Spain, Italy and other European entities.
You'll split your time 4 days/week with Kolsquare and 1 day/week with helloCash, supporting a population of around 35 people managers group-wide.

You'll report to Tatiana, VP People at Kolsquare, and work closely with Larissa, our People & Culture Manager already on the ground in Austria with Kolsquare & Hellocash, bringing seniority and support on the more complex topics (employee relations, works council, manager coaching).

Much of the HRBP function doesn't exist yet in its target form here. In year one, your main focus will be the Kolsquare–Storyclash integration, and alongside it, making visible progress on a few foundational areas (performance management, manager coaching and succession planning for critical roles).

What success looks like in year one:

  • a performance management cycle with manager accountability, and clear development paths across the team

  • measurable progress on engagement and retention

  • the Storyclash integration meaningfully advanced

  • constructive social dialogue with employee representative bodies where they apply

YOUR MISSIONS

1) Strategic HR Partnership & Org Design

  • Act as a trusted advisor to managers and leadership, translating business needs into HR initiatives, org design, and workforce planning

  • Support workforce planning and advise on headcount decisions with Finance and Talent Acquisition

2) Change Management & Integration

  • Lead the people's side of the Kolsquare–Storyclash integration and future group-wide change initiatives

  • Assess organizational readiness for change and design communication and adoption plans

  • Help employees and managers navigate change with structure and empathy

  • Spot friction early — between teams, processes, and ways of working — and address it before it compounds

3) Performance, Talent & Succession

  • Build and drive the performance management cycle (goal-setting, calibration, ratings consistency)

  • Coach managers on feedback, underperformance, and team development

  • Facilitate talent reviews and succession planning for critical roles

  • Partner on retention strategies for critical talent, using turnover and risk analysis to target interventions

4) Employee Relations & Works Council

  • Advise managers on complex employee-relations matters, conflict resolution, and sensitive conversations

  • Serve as the main HR contact for the Austrian Works Council (Betriebsrat) and other employee representative bodies where they apply

  • Balance business needs, fairness, and legal risk, partnering with external counsel where needed

5) Engagement & People Data

  • Interpret engagement survey results and co-create action plans with managers, tailored to each company

  • Use people data (engagement, turnover, performance) to diagnose issues and shape recommendations for leaders

6) Talent Acquisition Support (helloCash)

  • Open and coordinate helloCash role openings (on average 3 job openings per year) in collaboration withteam.blue's central Talent Acquisition team, who lead full-cycle recruiting

  • Partner with hiring managers to define profiles and provide input throughout the process

YOUR PROFILE

Must-haves 🫵

  • 5+ years of HRBP experience, ideally in a fast-growing tech or SaaS environment (50-150 employees a strong plus)

  • A generalist grounding across talent, employee relations, performance, and engagement, with experience advising and influencing senior leaders

  • Strong knowledge of Austrian labor law; experience with collective agreements and works councils

  • Comfortable building HR processes and tools from the ground up, not just running an established framework

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management, high emotional intelligence, and real conflict-navigation skills

  • Fluent in German and English (written and spoken); French/spanish is a plus

Nice-to-haves ✌️

  • Experience partnering across a multi-entity or multi-brand group, or in a post-acquisition/integration context

  • Data-driven mindset with experience in HR reporting and people analytics; familiarity with HRIS platforms (e.g. HiBob) and engagement tools (e.g. Culture Amp) is a plus

  • Proven experience managing full-cycle recruiting and supporting hiring managers in defining role profiles

WHAT WE OFFER?

  • Full flexibility: full remote work with European hubs and 400+ coworking spaces worldwide.

  • Monthly and quarterly highlights in person to get together with other Kolsquarians for great team-building events.

  • The stability and resources of a profitable group, with the agility of a scale-up.

  • Continuous training opportunities and career development support.

THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

Our hiring process consists of 6 steps:

  1. Talent Acquisition interview – 30 min

  2. Tatiana, VP People at Kolsquare – 45 min

  3. Annamarie Zalesak, People Lead at helloCash – 45 min

  4. Alexis, CFO – 30 min

  5. Julia, External Coach – 30 min

  6. Quentin, CEO – 30 min

The process is designed to give you the opportunity to meet key stakeholders across Kolsquare and helloCash and get a good understanding of the role, the team and the broader context.

LOCATION

Remote first in Europe, preferably residing in Spain or Austria.

Our purpose, to improve customers’ lives by making healthcare work better, is far from ordinary. And so are our employees. Working at Premera means you have the opportunity to drive real change by transforming healthcare.

Join the Provider Contact Center Quality Program as a Quality Specialist II and help shape quality across our offshore operations. You’ll partner with teams to identify opportunities, strengthen quality practices, and drive improvements that make a measurable difference. The Quality Specialist II is responsible for overseeing Premera's compliance with corporate audit programs such as the Blue Cross Blue Shield Association (BCBSA) Member Touchpoint Measures (MTM) and Licensee Desk Level Audit (LDLA) and the Federal Employee Program (FEP) audit, along with ensuring compliance with state and federal laws, contracts and the achievement of corporate objectives. The Quality Specialist II performs daily examination and verification of Premera transactions, such as claims processing, customer inquiries, group and member enrollment and electronic data exchange. The Quality Specialist II monitors all quality standards for selected claims, inquiries, enrollments and/or electronic transactions for accuracy, completeness and timeliness to judge the degree of adherence to the criteria set forth by the BCBSA, FEP and corporate policy requirements. The Quality Specialist II will work in conjunction with stakeholders to identify opportunities for quality improvement throughout the company.

What you will do:

· Conduct audits in a professional, ethical and objective manner using and interpreting applicable standards/requirements.

· Effectively plan, develop, and communicate an audit within a defined scope, including resource scheduling. Conduct necessary meetings in performance of the audit.

· Maintain in-depth working knowledge of procedural changes, audit techniques, and plan automated systems, subsystems, and reference materials for assigned audit functions.

· Responsible for a wide variety of quality auditing tools and techniques. Verify, document and communicate audit results, develop an audit report, and evaluate the effectiveness of corrective action/follow-up.

· Resolve conflict directly and respectfully, engaging in challenging and important conversations to resolve audit findings.

· Identify trends and the root cause of errors and recommend improved procedures/guidelines to Operations proactively.

· Assist in consulting with external departments to help resolve high impact key business issues surrounding quality assurance.

· Help individuals and the team become stronger by actively participating, leading and facilitating team meetings and work groups regarding Quality Review & Reporting initiatives and incentives.

· Understand quality principles as they relate to business processes and explain the importance of aligning the audit function to the organization.

· Other duties as assigned.

What you will bring:

· High school diploma or GED. (Required)

· Three (3) years of claims, customer service or enrollment work experience, which includes one (1) year of quality audit, quality control, or quality assurance experience. (Required)

· May require bilingual proficiency in a particular language (English/Spanish) with the ability to articulate messages and information clearly and accurately. (Preferred)

· Quality 101 certification. (Preferred)

What you will gain:

· Build expertise in quality auditing and compliance standards.

· Strengthen data analysis and root-cause problem-solving skills.

· Partner across teams to drive quality improvements.

· Gain experience communicating audit findings and recommendations.

Physical Requirements:
The following have been identified as essential physical requirements of this job and must be performed with or without an accommodation: This is primarily a sedentary role, which requires the ability to exert up to 10 lbs. of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects, including the human body. This role requires the ability to keyboard and to communicate clearly and understandably in person, and over the telephone.

Our comprehensive total rewards package provides support, resources, and opportunities to help employees thrive and grow. Our total rewards are more than a collection of perks, they're a reflection of our commitment to your health and well-being. We offer a broad array of rewards including physical, financial, emotional, and community benefits, including:

  • Medical, vision, and dental coverage with low employee premiums.

  • Life and disability insurance.

  • Retirement programs, including a 401K employer match and, believe it or not, a pension plan that is vested after 3 years of service.

For our hybrid employees, our on-campus model provides flexibility to create your own routine with access to on-site resources, networking opportunities, and team engagement.

  • Free convenient on-site parking.
