Overview

The DFES Consultant leads, conducts, and assists in data preservation and digital investigations in complex litigation cases by leveraging knowledge of digital forensic tools, technology and protocols related to the collection and management of electronically stored information (ESI) from a wide variety of data sources. The Consultant is part of our Digital Forensics and Expert Services team and performs investigative work and data collections as part of a team with Consilio’s external clients.

Responsibilities

· Works internally with colleagues and with clients in the planning and execution of data preservation using the most appropriate and legally defensible solutions

· Performs investigative analysis activities for a variety of digital devices, computers, storage media, servers, networks, and cloud-based services, including seizure and retention of mobile phones and handheld devices

· Performs data restoration and data conversion to prepare data for processing and hosting

· Leverages experience with forensic tools, including Encase, FTK, Axiom, and Cellebrite to carry out forensic investigations

· Displays sound knowledge and expertise of common operating systems and applications and exhibits an aptitude for problem solving in a methodical manner consistent with forensic protocols

· Follows Digital Forensic good practice methodologies (ISO17025 standard and ACPO Principles of Digital Evidence) in all aspects of the forensic and eDiscovery workflow

· Assists with and independently conducts the forensic examination of data and prepares expert reports and other expert witness documentation related to investigations

· Displays competence in oral delivery of complex technical information to non-technical clients

· Travels to onsite locations with a team or independently to perform data collections when safe and feasible

· Displays high degree of comfort operating in a client-facing environment and meeting the needs of clients

· Ability to be responsive to internal and external communications

· Has the ability to make well-reasoned decisions “on the spot” and execute on the plan

Qualifications

Minimum Education Requirements:

· Bachelor’s degree in forensic computing or equivalent relevant experience

Minimum Experience Requirements:

· 1 to 3 years of progressively responsible experience in related roles

Other Requirements:

· Excellent communication skills – both written and verbal

· Ability to thrive in a highly collaborative team environment

· Ability to work on multiple projects concurrently

· Demonstrate working knowledge and understanding of evidence management

· Proficient in the usage of forensic acquisition tools and working with various file formats

· Ability to collect data from a wide array of ESI, including: computers, mobile devices, media storage devices, servers, networks, social media, and cloud-based services.

· Familiarity with rules of evidence, ACPO guidelines, ISO17025 and Chain of Custody

· Good understanding of computer networking in corporate environments

· Availability for short notice or weekend travel when necessary

Preferred Attributes:

· EDiscovery experience with relevant forensic collection and analysis software

· Certifications in EnCase, FTK, Cellebrite, Nuix, CFE or similar

· SQL or scripting

Consilio’s True North Values

  • Client Experience | Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
  • Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
  • Innovation | Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.
  • Grit | Focus on what matters. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner. Deliver results you’re proud of.

The Integration/Test Automation Engineer works with software developers, API and integration engineers, functional testers, architects, cybersecurity personnel, CI/CD engineers, operations teams, and Government stakeholders. Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, execute, maintain, and improve automated software tests.
  • Build automated regression suites covering critical application capabilities and mission workflows.

  • Develop integration tests that validate interfaces, adapters, services, data exchanges, dependencies, and end-to-end processing.

Own Your Catalog Like a Business, and Win on Amazon.

Hadley Designs is seeking an Amazon Brand Manager to take full ownership of a multi-million dollar group of our products on Amazon, as the product manager, the merchandiser, and the CEO of that catalog. You bring the judgment. We bring the brand, the catalog, and the team.

  • Run your catalog as its CEO. Make the calls on pricing, listings, imagery, promotions, and inventory, and own the net profit that results.

Apply Now

Job Title: Medical Virtual Assistant (Athena EMR & Concierge Primary Care)

Position type: Part-Time

Work hours: 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM Eastern Time (5 hours per day)

Work days: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday

Salary: $6 - $7 per hour

Workplace: Remote

Preferred Candidate Location: Philippines

Our client is a U.S.-based concierge primary care practice dedicated to delivering personalized, high-quality healthcare and exceptional patient experiences. We are seeking a highly experienced, tech-savvy, and dependable Medical Virtual Assistant (Athena EMR & Concierge Primary Care) to provide comprehensive administrative support, optimize clinical workflows, and enhance daily practice operations.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced healthcare professional who thrives in a patient-centered environment, enjoys working with technology, and can independently manage complex administrative responsibilities.

As a Medical Virtual Assistant, you will play an essential role in patient scheduling, call management, laboratory result workflows, insurance verification, prior authorizations, and electronic health record management.

You will work closely with the physician, nurse, and receptionist to streamline administrative processes, maintain accurate patient records, and ensure patients receive the responsive, personalized service expected in a concierge medical practice.

The ideal candidate has advanced hands-on proficiency in Athena EMR (AthenaHealth), experience supporting U.S.-based healthcare or concierge primary care practices, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

This is a strictly administrative support role focused on improving clinical and operational efficiency. You will not be responsible for making independent clinical decisions.

If you're an experienced Medical VA who enjoys solving problems, improving healthcare workflows, and making a meaningful impact on patient care, we'd love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

Patient Scheduling & Call Management (Top Priority)

  • Independently manage the physician's appointment schedule according to established scheduling preferences and practice-specific guidelines.
  • Ensure appointments are scheduled accurately, respecting the practice's limited daily patient volume and strict no-overbooking requirements.
  • Understand and follow concierge primary care scheduling workflows and patient service expectations.
  • Answer and manage inbound patient calls, including appointment requests, scheduling inquiries, and general administrative concerns.
  • Provide call overflow support during busy periods or when the in-office receptionist is unavailable.
  • Handle outbound calls, appointment confirmations, rescheduling requests, and patient callbacks.
  • Respond promptly to patient inquiries, maintaining the practice's expectation of callbacks within approximately 20 minutes.
  • Prioritize time-sensitive patient requests and coordinate appropriate follow-up.
  • Manage patient communications through designated phone, email, text, and internal messaging channels.
  • Maintain accurate scheduling records and document patient communications.
  • Coordinate with existing staff to prevent duplicate callbacks, scheduling conflicts, or unnecessary communication.
  • Escalate urgent concerns or matters requiring physician input according to established protocols.
  • Deliver professional, empathetic, and personalized service to patients with high expectations.

Laboratory Result Management & Athena EMR Workflows (Top Priority)

  • Manage and organize incoming laboratory results and outstanding result-related tasks within Athena EMR.
  • Review laboratory result queues and categorize tasks according to established physician-approved protocols.
  • Identify results requiring routine processing, physician review, or urgent escalation based on approved workflows.
  • Process and close normal laboratory result tasks using pre-approved templates and authorized procedures.
  • Send physician-approved templated communications to patients regarding normal laboratory results when authorized.
  • Flag abnormal, urgent, unclear, or potentially concerning results for physician review and appropriate follow-up.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of laboratory result communications, completed tasks, and pending actions.
  • Monitor outstanding result-related tasks to prevent unnecessary backlogs.
  • Help streamline laboratory result workflows and reduce administrative bottlenecks.
  • Support the physician's goal of completing clinical notes and documentation on the same day.
  • Follow HIPAA requirements and established protocols when handling sensitive clinical information.

EHR Documentation, Insurance & Prior Authorizations (Top Priority)

  • Maintain accurate, complete, and organized patient records within Athena EMR /AthenaHealth.
  • Create appropriate labels and categories for clinical documents.
  • Upload, organize, and file clinical documents into the correct patient charts.
  • Verify that insurance documents are uploaded correctly and stored in the appropriate sections of Athena.
  • Ensure insurance information is accurate, current, and properly reflected in the patient's electronic record.
  • Assist with insurance eligibility and benefits verification as needed.
  • Manage administrative aspects of prior authorization requests, including collecting required information, preparing submissions, tracking authorization status, and following up with insurance providers.
  • Identify missing or inconsistent insurance information and coordinate necessary corrections.
  • Support medical billing-related administrative workflows and insurance inquiries.
  • Review patient charts for missing, duplicated, incorrectly filed, or incomplete documentation.
  • Maintain organized electronic records and ensure outstanding documentation tasks are addressed.
  • Assist with reducing existing administrative backlogs and preventing new ones from accumulating.
  • Identify opportunities to replace manual or paper-based processes with more efficient digital workflows.

Patient Check-In & Chart Reconciliation

  • Assist with patient check-in and pre-appointment preparation workflows.
  • Review and verify patient demographic information and social history updates.
  • Ensure medication lists, allergies, and vaccination records are accurately documented in Athena.
  • Support medication and vaccination reconciliation by comparing available records, identifying discrepancies, and routing items requiring clinical review.
  • Verify that patient-provided information is accurately imported or reflected in the appropriate chart sections.
  • Identify incomplete, outdated, or inconsistent patient information and coordinate corrections with authorized clinical staff.
  • Maintain organized and accurate patient records to support efficient appointments and continuity of care.

External Communication & Administrative Support

  • Contact specialists, referring providers, and other medical offices on behalf of the physician when authorized.
  • Coordinate administrative inquiries, documentation requests, referrals, and follow-up communications.
  • Track outstanding requests and document communication outcomes.
  • Provide additional back-end administrative support as needed.
  • Assist with organizing high-volume administrative tasks and outstanding EHR work queues.
  • Identify workflow inefficiencies and recommend practical improvements.
  • Help modernize administrative processes through improved digital documentation, task organization, and workflow standardization.
  • Maintain accurate records and communicate relevant updates to the appropriate team members.
  • Work independently while following established procedures and physician-specific preferences.

Team Collaboration & Workflow Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with the existing nurse, receptionist, and physician to support smooth daily operations.
  • Complement the in-office team's responsibilities by providing additional administrative and technical support.
  • Coordinate patient communications and scheduling activities to prevent duplicate work or unnecessary follow-ups.
  • Follow clear communication and escalation protocols to minimize interruptions to clinical operations.
  • Independently resolve routine administrative concerns within the scope of established procedures.
  • Escalate urgent, unclear, or clinically sensitive matters to the appropriate team member.
  • Provide concise, organized updates rather than requiring frequent supervision or check-ins.
  • Respect established team workflows while proactively identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • Maintain a collaborative, respectful, and solutions-oriented approach when supporting existing staff.

Top 3 Priorities

1. Precise Scheduling Management & Responsive Patient Communication

Take ownership of the physician's schedule by following specific appointment preferences, respecting limited patient volume, and preventing overbooking. Manage incoming calls, call overflow, and patient callbacks while maintaining the prompt, personalized service expected in concierge primary care.

2. Laboratory Result Management & Accurate Clinical Documentation

Efficiently manage Athena laboratory result queues, process routine results through physician-approved workflows, and escalate abnormal or urgent findings for clinical review. Ensure clinical documents are accurately labeled, organized, and filed in the correct patient charts.

3. Insurance, Prior Authorizations & EHR Organization

Maintain accurate insurance documentation within Athena, assist with insurance verification and prior authorizations, and ensure patient records are complete, current, and properly organized. Help reduce administrative backlogs and improve documentation efficiency.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Medical Virtual Assistant consistently demonstrates:

  • Accurate scheduling that follows the physician's specific preferences without overbooking.
  • Prompt handling of incoming calls, appointment requests, and patient callbacks.
  • Consistent adherence to the practice's approximately 20-minute callback expectation.
  • Efficient organization and management of laboratory result queues in Athena.
  • Accurate use of physician-approved templates and timely escalation of abnormal results.
  • Proper labeling, filing, and maintenance of clinical documents.
  • Accurate insurance records, prior authorization tracking, and administrative follow-ups.
  • Organized and updated medication, allergy, vaccination, and patient history information.
  • Reduced administrative backlogs and improved EHR workflows.
  • Strong independence and proactive problem-solving with minimal supervision.
  • Effective collaboration with existing staff without creating duplicate tasks or unnecessary communication.
  • Professional and composed interactions with patients who expect highly responsive service.
  • Consistent adherence to HIPAA requirements and patient confidentiality.
  • Administrative efficiency that allows the physician to focus on patient care and complete documentation more effectively.

Tools & Platforms

Athena EMR / AthenaHealth (Mandatory)

Advanced hands-on experience is required. The successful candidate must be able to navigate patient scheduling, clinical documentation, laboratory result workflows, insurance records, and administrative task management efficiently.

Comcast Internet-Based Phone System

Must be comfortable using an internet-based phone system for inbound calls, outbound calls, and call overflow coverage. Phone forwarding and system integration will be coordinated during setup.

Communication Platforms

  • Google Chat
  • Email
  • Text messaging
  • Other practice-approved communication tools

The selected candidate will be provided with appropriate system access and individual Athena login credentials as part of onboarding.

Requirements

Athena EMR & Healthcare Systems Expertise

  • Advanced hands-on proficiency with Athena EMR / AthenaHealth (non-negotiable).
  • Proven ability to navigate Athena independently without extensive platform training.
  • Experience with patient scheduling, electronic charting, clinical documentation, and EHR task management.
  • Familiarity with laboratory result queues, chart organization, document labeling, and administrative workflows.
  • Experience with insurance verification, medical billing-related administrative processes, and prior authorizations.
  • Ability to upload, review, organize, and maintain accurate insurance and clinical documentation.
  • Strong computer literacy and confidence using modern healthcare technology.
  • Ability to troubleshoot routine technical or workflow issues and adapt to new digital systems.

U.S. Healthcare & Concierge Practice Experience

  • Previous experience supporting U.S.-based healthcare practices (mandatory).
  • Experience working in concierge primary care or a similar patient-centered healthcare environment.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. healthcare administrative workflows, patient scheduling, and insurance processes.
  • Familiarity with medical terminology, clinical documentation, and patient record management.
  • Understanding of concierge healthcare expectations, including personalized service and prompt patient communication.
  • Experience communicating with physicians, specialists, insurance providers, and other healthcare offices.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA requirements and patient confidentiality standards.

Patient Communication & Professional Resilience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Proven experience handling inbound and outbound patient calls.
  • Ability to communicate professionally and confidently with patients who have high service expectations.
  • Strong patience, emotional resilience, and composure when handling challenging or demanding interactions.
  • Ability to remain calm, courteous, and solution-focused under pressure.
  • Strong active listening skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage time-sensitive patient requests and callback expectations.
  • Professional demeanor appropriate for a concierge primary care practice.
  • Ability to establish trust and maintain positive patient relationships.

Independence, Collaboration & Problem-Solving

  • Proven ability to work independently with minimal supervision or micromanagement.
  • Strong accountability, reliability, and ownership of assigned responsibilities.

Payroll Accountant – Remote

Payroll | Accounting | U.S. Payroll Compliance | Financial Operations

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Flexible, aligned with U.S. Client Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Payroll Accountant to manage end-to-end payroll operations while ensuring employees are paid accurately, on time, and in compliance with U.S. payroll regulations.

This is a highly detail-oriented role that combines payroll processing, accounting, tax compliance, reconciliations, and financial reporting. You’ll be responsible for maintaining accurate payroll records, integrating payroll with accounting systems, resolving discrepancies, and supporting audits while ensuring compliance across all payroll processes.

The ideal candidate has strong payroll expertise, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to manage confidential information with accuracy and professionalism.

What You’ll Own

Payroll Processing

  • Process bi-weekly, semi-monthly, and monthly payrolls for organizations ranging from 50–500 employees.
  • Validate employee time entries, overtime, bonuses, commissions, and deductions prior to payroll processing.
  • Administer payroll using platforms such as ADP, Paychex, Gusto, QuickBooks Payroll, BambooHR, or similar systems.
  • Ensure payroll is processed accurately and delivered on schedule.

Accounting & Reconciliations

  • Record payroll journal entries within accounting systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero.
  • Reconcile payroll clearing accounts and payroll-related bank transactions.
  • Record employer contributions, benefit deductions, and payroll liabilities accurately.
  • Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies promptly.

Payroll Tax & Compliance

  • Prepare and submit federal, state, and local payroll tax payments.
  • File payroll tax forms including 941, W-2, 1099, and applicable state filings.
  • Monitor changes in payroll tax laws and labor regulations.
  • Ensure payroll processes remain compliant and audit-ready.

Benefits Administration

  • Reconcile healthcare, retirement, and employee benefit contributions.
  • Verify employee deductions align with benefit elections.
  • Coordinate with benefit providers regarding payroll-related discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate payroll deduction records.

Employee Payroll Support

  • Respond to employee payroll inquiries regarding paychecks, direct deposits, tax withholding, and payroll documentation.
  • Support payroll setup for new hires and employee updates.
  • Maintain professionalism and confidentiality when handling employee information.

Reporting & Financial Analysis

  • Prepare recurring payroll, headcount, and labor cost reports.
  • Support audits with organized payroll documentation.
  • Perform payroll variance analysis against budgets and forecasts.
  • Provide payroll insights to finance and HR leadership.

Process Improvement

  • Improve payroll workflows using Excel automation, payroll integrations, or APIs.
  • Develop and maintain payroll SOPs and documentation.
  • Recommend process improvements that increase efficiency and reduce errors.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • 2+ years of payroll processing experience.
  • Hands-on experience using at least one payroll platform such as ADP, Paychex, QuickBooks Payroll, Gusto, or BambooHR.
  • Experience supporting payroll accounting and reconciliations.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. payroll tax regulations and compliance requirements.

Technical Skills

  • Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, reconciliations).
  • Strong understanding of payroll accounting principles.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • High attention to detail and confidentiality.

Nice-to-Have

  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC).
  • Multi-state or international payroll experience.
  • Experience reconciling payroll with accounting systems.
  • Familiarity with HRIS integrations including BambooHR, Zenefits, or Workday.
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance reviews.

Tools & Platforms

  • ADP
  • Paychex
  • Gusto
  • QuickBooks Payroll
  • BambooHR
  • QuickBooks
  • NetSuite
  • Xero
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Google Sheets

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Highly detail-oriented with exceptional numerical accuracy.
  • Strong understanding of payroll compliance and accounting processes.
  • Able to troubleshoot discrepancies under tight deadlines.
  • Professional and discreet when handling confidential information.
  • Organized with strong documentation habits.
  • Proactive in identifying process improvements and ensuring compliance.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review employee timecards and payroll changes.
  • Process payroll and verify payroll accuracy.
  • Reconcile payroll accounts and journal entries.
  • Respond to employee payroll inquiries.
  • File payroll tax payments and maintain compliance.
  • Reconcile employee benefit deductions.
  • Prepare payroll reports and financial summaries.
  • Update payroll documentation and SOPs.

In short: You ensure payroll is processed accurately, accounting records remain balanced, employees are paid on time, and payroll operations stay compliant with all applicable regulations.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • 100% on-time payroll processing
  • Payroll error rate below 1%
  • Timely payroll tax filings
  • Payroll discrepancies resolved within two business days
  • Accuracy of payroll reconciliations and journal entries
  • Audit readiness and compliance standards maintained

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Fully remote opportunity supporting U.S.-based organizations.
  • High-impact role within finance and accounting operations.
  • Exposure to payroll, tax compliance, HR, and financial reporting.
  • Opportunity to improve payroll systems and operational efficiency.
  • Career growth into Senior Payroll Accountant, Payroll Manager, or Accounting leadership roles.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Practical Assessment (Payroll Reconciliation & Discrepancy Resolution)
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Payroll Accountant who enjoys ensuring accuracy, maintaining compliance, and supporting efficient payroll operations, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become a key contributor to a growing finance team.

About Darkroom

Darkroom (Darkroom Digital, Inc.) is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

Darkroom is hiring an FP&A Analyst to join the Finance team. You'll own financial modeling, performance reporting, compensation reporting, and utilization and capacity analysis, the numbers behind how and when we hire. You'll report to the SVP of Finance and work closely with the Finance Operations Manager, the AR & Billing Specialist, and our department Managing Directors, turning complex operating and financial data into clear recommendations that drive forecasting, planning, and decision-making across the company.

You'll own your work end to end, from weekly pacing to the monthly and quarterly reports that go to the CEO. Teammates peer-check each other's work, and the SVP of Finance approves what goes to the CEO.

This role is built for someone who sees AI as a core part of how finance gets done. You'll use tools like Claude to sharpen analysis, automate repetitive work, and build workflows that raise both the speed and quality of our financial output.

This is a fully remote role from Brazil or Portugal supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).

What You'll Do

  • Build, maintain, and enhance our unified financial model, including the P&L, budgets, forecasts, headcount plan, scenario analyses, and unit economics.

  • Prepare the weekly pacing report, tracking MRR, bookings, and revenue against target.

  • Prepare the revenue, EBITDA, year-to-date, MRR, and outlook sections of the monthly report, and the quarterly performance report.

  • Explain the numbers: break every variance against budget into its drivers, and recommend changes to model assumptions when actuals move away from them.

  • Own the utilization model by department, role, and person, including Shadow FTEs (the capacity our AI platform adds), and connect it directly to gross margin and unit economics.

  • Work with Managing Directors on every hiring request, building the case for hiring now or waiting based on utilization, pipeline, and margin impact.

  • Build and maintain the department-head compensation dashboard, and prepare the quarterly KPI figures behind our incentive plans.

  • Run cohort analysis: retention, expansion, and lifetime value by client cohort.

  • Analyze our media mix and profitability by client and service line, and recommend pricing, scope, and staffing changes.

  • Peer-check teammates' work, including budget vs. actual, model changes, payout calculations, and vendor payments against budget.

  • Use AI tools like Claude to enhance analysis, automate repetitive tasks, and build more efficient workflows.

  • Identify and implement improvements to the accuracy, consistency, and efficiency of financial processes and reporting.

  • Take on ad hoc analysis and special projects as the business needs them.

You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You

  • You have 2–4 years of professional experience in FP&A, private equity, investment banking, transaction services, or consulting.

  • You've built and maintained complex financial models, not just updated them.

  • You're advanced in Google Sheets or Excel, including lookups, pivot tables, dynamic formulas, and scenario analysis. Our model runs in Google Sheets.

  • You understand unit economics in a services business (capacity, utilization, billable rates, and margin), or you can learn them fast.

  • You write clear management reporting: you can explain what changed, why, and what to do about it in a few sentences.

  • You already use Claude or similar AI tools in your work and can point to real examples of AI-driven analysis, automation, or workflow improvements.

  • You form a view and defend it with data. You bring recommendations, not just numbers.

  • You're analytical, organized, and a strong problem-solver with a high bar for accuracy and detail.

  • You work independently, juggle multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

  • You're fluent in written and spoken English.

  • Experience in an agency or professional services firm is a plus.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership, but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape, just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + local holidays (relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace. We are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Simplex Health is seeking a Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) to provide telehealth outpatient medical nutrition therapy using an integrative and functional nutrition approach. This is a fully remote, full-time role offering a consistent schedule and the opportunity to build deep, ongoing relationships with patients.

Unlike many outpatient roles, this position offers a full-time, salaried structure with benefits, providing stability and consistency in your schedule and income—while giving you the flexibility to choose a schedule that fits your lifestyle.

The ideal candidate has experience in clinical or outpatient nutrition counseling, is licensed (or eligible for licensure) in Pennsylvania, and is passionate about delivering personalized, root-cause care to support long-term health outcomes.

Our Mission: Radically improve the health of Humankind—one person, one appointment, one connection at a time.

At Simplex Health, we do things differently. Our insurance-funded medical nutrition therapy goes beyond symptom management to improve — and in many cases reverse — chronic conditions. We partner with hospitals, healthcare practices, and individuals to provide personalized, root-cause nutrition care across a wide range of conditions, including metabolic health, digestive disorders, hormonal imbalances, and chronic disease.

Our approach is grounded in prevention, root-cause resolution, and sustainable lifestyle change, supporting patients throughout their health journey. Through a fully virtual, telehealth model, we meet patients where they are, delivering accessible, high-quality care.

Our evidence-based, progressive nutrition interventions are tailored to each patient’s unique biochemistry. Through nutrition counseling, education, and health coaching, we empower patients to improve their health, build lasting habits, and achieve meaningful, long-term outcomes.

Role details:

  • Location: Telehealth
  • Schedule Options: Choose between a 4-day (32-hour) or 5-day (40-hour) work week, with flexibility to design a schedule that fits both your preferences and your patients’ needs.
  • Reports to: Clinical Manager
  • Compensation:
    • 32 hours/week (4-day work week): $44,000–$59,000 annually
    • 40 hours/week (5-day work week): $55,000–$70,000 annually
    • Final schedule and compensation are aligned based on candidate preference, experience, and availability

You love helping people heal. You just don’t love doing it all alone.

If you’ve ever run (or dreamed of running) your own private practice, you know what it takes — the marketing, the scheduling, the billing, the insurance headaches, the empty calendar days, the tech issues, the isolation…

At Simplex Health, you get the best parts of private practice — the autonomy, the flexibility, the deep 1:1 relationships with patients — without the burnout or business stress.

Here, you get to focus on what you do best: helping patients transform their health through integrative and functional nutrition.

What we are looking for:
We are seeking mission-driven dietitians (RD/RDN) who:

  • Are passionate about integrative and functional nutrition
  • Thrive in a collaborative, growth-minded environment
  • Have at least 2 years of experience in outpatient or clinical care

  • IFNA Certified (IFNCP credential a plus); candidates actively enrolled in IFNA training welcome

  • Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and clinical standards
  • Stay current with emerging research and best practices in nutrition and health
  • Manage a full and consistent patient caseload, ensuring timely follow-ups, continuity of care, and optimal patient outcomes

What to expect:

  • Regular case reviews and clinical collaboration
  • Real-time support via team chat and peer connection
  • Team meetings and shared learning opportunities
  • Opportunities to contribute to committees, resources, and clinical initiatives

Our team provides consistent referrals and support to help you build a full and sustainable schedule as quickly as possible.

Benefits

Please note that administrative support is available from 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM EST, and while live attendance at team meetings is encouraged, recordings will be provided for those unable to join due to time zone differences.

Get involved with social media, engagement projects, or hosting lunch & learns.

🌎 Broad Range of Clients, Deep Skill Development

Even in a virtual environment, you’ll feel connected, encouraged, and supported.

If you’ve ever wished you could combine the freedom of private practice with the camaraderie and stability of a larger organization, this is where you belong.

Apply today and rediscover the joy of patient care without the grind of running a business.

Simplex Health Core Values:

Simplex Health strives to embody the following values and to apply them to every aspect of how we run our business, including how we interact with each other as teammates and leaders. These values also apply to how we interact with and continue to inspire our clients and strategic partners:

We Inspire Each Other

Through cultivating genuine, transparent, relationships, we create an environment that encourages individuals to dream big, take risks, and be bold. We aim to inspire and commit to everyone we touch. This sense of commitment and care sets the stage for a culture of accountability, where we hold ourselves and each other to the same high standards, taking the ownership necessary for achieving our goals.
Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.
1 Thessalonians 5:11

We Always Learn and Grow
We at Simplex Health strive to be continual learners and to expand our abilities as people and as an organization. We educate ourselves, remain curious, and use evidence-based research to challenge our current understanding. We see mistakes and failure as great teachers and learning opportunities. When we stay engaged in the world with a growth mindset, it creates the right environment for us to thrive and make a meaningful impact on each other and on the world.
Let the wise hear and increase in learning, and the one who understands obtain guidance.
Proverbs 1:5

Now we see things imperfectly, like puzzling reflections in a mirror, but then we will see everything with perfect clarity. All that I know now is partial and incomplete, but then I will know everything completely, just as God now knows me completely.
I Corinthians 13:12

Creator Coordinator

Function: Creator Sourcing | Influencer & UGC Partnerships | Creator Operations
Reports to: Creator Operations Lead
Location: Remote
Job Type: Full-Time, Contractor
Seniority Level: Mid Level
Fee: $2,000 – $2,500 USD

The Role:

We’re looking for a Creator Coordinator to join one of the UK’s leading agencies and become the driving force behind our creator sourcing operation.

This role is responsible for building and managing a consistent pipeline of high-quality UGC creators across multiple client accounts. You’ll identify new creator talent, vet creators against our internal quality standards, coordinate creator onboarding, build relationships and ensure our wider team always has access to the right creators for every campaign.

If you’re highly organised, proactive and passionate about creators, this is an opportunity to build your career within one of the fastest-growing agencies.

About Soar Group

The Soar Group is one of the UK's fastest-growing performance agency groups, built around a specialist paid media core — with Meta as our primary growth channel — backed by an in-house creative execution arm and a dedicated TikTok Shop implementation capability.

With over £100M+ in annual ad spend under management and a team of 130+, we partner with ambitious 7-9 figure DTC and eCommerce brands, with Meta as our primary growth channel, alongside TikTok and Google.

Our capabilities include:

  • Performance Media – Full-funnel paid media and growth strategy across Meta, Google, and TikTok, with Meta as our primary growth channel.
  • Creative Execution – An in-house creative execution arm delivering high-production creative, UGC, and static content at scale.
  • TikTok Shop & Social Commerce – A dedicated TikTok Shop implementation and creator-led growth capability.

We were nominated for Meta's Creative Diversity Award 2025 and recognised by Meta as the UK's #1 independent Meta agency group.

Our culture is built around four core values: Extreme Ownership, Radical Curiosity, Kind Candour, Outcome Obsessed.

Requirements

Comprehensive training will be provided across all aspects of the role, including our creator sourcing processes, internal systems and creator ecosystem.

  • Launch UGC creator casting calls across in our creator community. Source externally on social media platforms to build a consistent pipeline of high-quality creators.
  • Source and identify creators that align with each client’s brand, audience and campaign objectives.
  • Vet and review UGC creators based on content quality, performance, audience fit and brand suitability to ensure only the strongest creators are recommended.
  • Maintain a curated, engaged creator network, ensuring all creators are contractually bound and compliant before any assignment begins.
  • Execute multi-platform creator outreach using tools including TikTok Creator Marketplace, Insense, X (formerly Twitter) and other relevant sourcing platforms.
  • Coordinate creator communications throughout the onboarding process, acting as a professional point of contact.
  • Support the wider team with administrative tasks, campaign coordination and creator operations.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve creator sourcing processes and expand the quality and scale of our creator network.
  • Act as an external ambassador for the agency in all creator-facing interactions, representing the agency with professionalism, empathy, and clarity. Strong creator relationships protect the agency's reputation, drive long-term partnerships, and reduce the risk of negative sentiment.
  • Maintain strong relationships internally and externally.

Who You Are:

We’re looking for someone who is organised, proactive and excited by the world of creator marketing. You don’t need years of experience-we’re looking for potential, curiosity and a willingness to learn.

You’ll ideally have:

  • 1+ years’ experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, social media, affiliate marketing or a related field.
  • A Strong understanding of social media (Meta, TikTok etc) and creator culture
  • Excellent organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong written communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Confidence in managing multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
  • A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership.
  • The ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.
  • A genuine interest in eCommerce, content creation and creator marketing.
  • Empathy, with a genuine ability to understand creator and client needs.
  • Creative thinking, with the ability to spot fresh ideas and creator talent.
  • Critical thinking, to evaluate creator quality and campaign fit with sound judgement.
  • Experience using TikTok Creator Marketplace and Meta Creator Marketplace.
  • Experience sourcing UGC creators or influencers.

Success in the first 6 months:

  • Built a reliable pipeline of high-quality creators across multiple industries.
  • Own creator briefing from start to finish.
  • Become a trusted partner to our team for creator sourcing and coordination.
  • Helped launch successful creator campaigns that generate measurable commercial results.
  • Build strong relationships with creators that lead to repeat collaborations and long-term partnerships.

Benefits

Access to ongoing training, development, and progression opportunities across the Soar Group.

Soar Group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment, where all of our employees have equal access to opportunities and everyone’s voices are heard. We respect and value all differences (seen and unseen) and strongly encourage applications from all backgrounds, which will be considered regardless of race, colour, religion or belief, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, pregnancy and maternity, disability, or age.

Due to the evolving nature of the business, the job holder may be required to carry out duties that are not detailed within this job description.

jobs.title: Head Psychologist: Autism & Developmental Diagnostics
jobs.excerpt: Frontera is reimagining how children with autism and other behavioral health needs get the care they deserve.
jobs.description:
Frontera is reimagining how children with autism and other behavioral health needs get the care they deserve. We bring together world-class clinicians, technologists, and autism specialists to build cutting-edge AI tools that help care teams work smarter and spend more time with the children and families who need them most.

Our platform is HIPAA-compliant and designed for the real-world needs of behavioral health teams — from psychologists to ABA therapists. By combining evidence-based care with powerful technology, we're expanding access to high-quality services for families everywhere.

Our Mission

Frontera exists to close the care gap: every child, no matter where they live, should be able to access effective behavioral healthcare.

Why Join Us

At Frontera, you'll join a team driven by impact. We're growing quickly, backed by leading investors, and united by a shared belief that innovation and equity can change lives. If you're excited to build the future of pediatric healthcare, we'd love to meet you.

Role Overview

As Lead Psychologist, Autism & Developmental Diagnostics, you'll be the clinical and operational anchor for Frontera's telehealth diagnostic team. You'll ensure every autism and developmental evaluation meets a consistently high bar for quality, while helping your team find smarter, more efficient ways to work, because time saved without sacrificing quality means another child gets answers sooner. You'll carry a small evaluation caseload of your own, and spend the rest of your time developing your team, strengthening clinical standards, and partnering closely with Operations, Intake, and Product to build a diagnostic program that's both excellent and built to scale.

This is a role for someone who can hold two things in tension: the clinical rigor and individualized care every family deserves, and the efficiency Frontera needs to reach more of the families who need us. You'll set the standard for what “good” looks like on both fronts and you'll be comfortable making real tradeoffs, and helping your team make them too.

What You'll Do

Clinical Leadership & Quality

  • Serve as the go-to resource for clinical questions, screener guidance, and evaluation standards across the diagnostics team

  • Set and uphold consistent standards for clinical quality, complex case decision-making, report writing, and neuroaffirming language

  • Review evaluations and consult on complex or atypical cases

  • Define best practices for accessible, high-quality telehealth autism and developmental evaluation

  • Carry a modest caseload of your own (about two evaluations per week) to stay grounded in the work

  • Set clear, explicit guidance on where the line is between more time meaning more quality, and more time meaning a family waits longer for a diagnosis and help your team make that call with confidence

Team Support & Development

  • Lead onboarding, training, and calibration for new psychologists

  • Support your team's ongoing growth and skill development

  • Run regular 1:1s and team meetings that keep people aligned, supported, and unstuck

  • Own change management for new tools, processes, and programs across the team

  • Set clear expectations and hold your team accountable to them — with warmth, and without avoiding the hard conversations when they're needed

Operational Alignment

  • Partner with Intake and Operations to build workflows, scheduling, and communication that actually work

  • Spot the operational gaps that get in the way of quality or efficiency, and help fix them

  • Turn good clinical ideas into concrete, sequenced plans, with real metrics and timelines, not just principles

Product & Technology Partnership

  • Partner closely with Engineering and Product on report tools, documentation templates, and workflows

  • Bring specific, proactive ideas for where technology could save time without costing quality — you don't just flag problems, you help solve them

  • Help identify, track, and prioritize product issues with clear clinical context

  • Partner with Customer Success to close the loop between client experience and clinical practice

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Represent the clinical point of view in conversations about scaling, tooling, and how we design our services

  • Help hire, evaluate, and calibrate new psychologists and speech-language pathologists

  • Advocate for standardized, scalable workflows where they help us serve more families, even when that means less case-by-case customization

  • Contribute to quality improvement and clinical governance efforts

Travel

  • Occasional travel to New Mexico and other markets for team training, calibration, and partnership-building

  • Frequent visits to our Denver headquarters to stay connected with the clinical operations team

Who You Are

  • A doctoral-level psychologist with deep experience in autism and developmental evaluation

  • Skilled in telehealth-based assessment, with strong clinical judgment, report writing, and ADOS (Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule) administration

  • Experienced training, mentoring, and leading interdisciplinary clinical teams

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and building consistency in a fast-growing environment

  • Experienced managing the performance of licensed clinicians serving underserved communities

  • A natural partner to technologists and product teams — you can talk concretely about where tools and workflows intersect with clinical quality, not just work around what exists

  • Someone who makes good decisions under time pressure, not only when things are calm

  • Comfortable standardizing and scaling processes, and willing to prioritize consistency when it's what's best for the most families

  • An assertive, steady leader who can set a clear standard for a team and hold to it

What Success Looks Like

  • Clinicians have a reliable go-to person for day-to-day questions and support

  • Evaluation quality is consistent, timely, and meets gold-standard practices

  • Workflows between Ops, Intake, and Clinical run smoothly

  • New clinicians ramp up quickly with strong support

  • A cohesive team culture aligned with our mission to close the care gap

  • A well-maintained library of clinical SOPs and documentation

  • Clear, measurable improvements in quality and/or throughput — not just team morale

  • A strong, trusted working relationship with Product and Engineering, built on specific and proactive ideas

Why Frontera Health?

  • Help shape the future of pediatric behavioral healthcare

  • Lead and grow a clinical team at a company built to close the care gap

  • Join a mission-driven team backed by leading investors

  • Make a real, measurable difference in the lives of children and families who need care

  • Competitive compensation and benefits package

Join us in building the future of behavioral healthcare.

At Frontera, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and safe—period. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to maintaining an environment where harassment, discrimination, and retaliation have no place.

Join Our Team: Do Meaningful Work and Improve People’s Lives

Our purpose, to improve customers’ lives by making healthcare work better, is far from ordinary. And so are our employees. Working at Premera means you have the opportunity to drive real change by transforming healthcare.

It’s this commitment that has earned us recognition as one of the best companies to work for. Learn more about our recent awards and recognitions as a greatest workplace.

Systems Analyst II


Job Description Summary

Analyzes business functions, processes, and procedures to provide solution recommendations, including system specifications and business process implications, based on business objectives, business requirements, and cost effectiveness. Collaborates with others in system development and design, which may include database, report, and interface design. Assists in the development of test plans and coordination or execution of testing activities and helps triage issues, anomalies, and opportunities to improve solutions. Provides analysis and recommendations on problems of moderate scope and complexity. Works under general guidance while developing expertise within an assigned business domain. Able to analyze workflows and improve operational challenges by leveraging automation solutions to reduce manual effort and rework.


This role is Telecommuter.


What You’ll Do

Job Responsibilities

  • Represent the business within an Agile delivery team; develop and maintain strong relationships with business stakeholders; engage business partners to understand and develop expertise within the aligned business domain; and act as a liaison between business and IT for new system implementations, enhancements, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Collaborate with business partners, IT partners, and delivery team members to identify, refine, and document requirements in the form of epics, features, user stories, use cases, business requirements, functional requirements, UI specifications, and business rules.
  • Apply business process analysis and cost-benefit analysis techniques to evaluate solution options and support business decision-making.
  • Develop and maintain knowledge of Premera systems, applications, and business processes within the aligned domain.
  • Analyze and document current and future-state business processes to identify pain points, risks, and opportunities for operational efficiencies through technology solutions.
  • Use system tools and data sources to perform data analysis, validate requirements, troubleshoot issues, support root cause analysis, and provide solution recommendations.
  • Support the development of low-code and automation solutions to reduce repetitive manual work and improve process consistency.
  • Perform and assist with data analysis to define business, process, functional, and data requirements; identify and resolve conflicting requirements; conduct gap analyses; and support reporting and data-mapping activities.
  • Support end users in preparing, documenting, and executing test scenarios; create test scripts and test cases with guidance from team members; and assist with User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Provide input on backlog priorities, dependencies, and sprint planning activities.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement through analysis of business processes and technology solutions; collaborate with the delivery team to improve both team effectiveness and solution quality.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What You’ll Need


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Two (2) years of business systems analysis experience, including requirements gathering, business process analysis, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver technology solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a software development environment utilizing Agile delivery practices, including Scrum and SAFe.
  • Knowledge of project delivery methodologies, including Agile and Waterfall.
  • Experience using SQL for data analysis, data validation, troubleshooting, or reporting.
  • Knowledge of healthcare or health insurance industry processes and systems.
  • Experience with product development and collaboration tools such as Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, Confluence, and Product Plan.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Customer-focused with demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions to business needs, operational impact, and customer value.
  • Demonstrates accountability and delivers results within a self-organized team environment.
  • Ability to develop an understanding of business strategies, processes, and objectives within the aligned domain.
  • Hands-on exposure to at least one relational or cloud database platform, such as SQL Server, Snowflake, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar technology.
  • Experience using reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Interest in using AI, low-code, and workflow automation technologies to solve operational problems, improve processes, and reduce manual work.
  • Basic understanding of APIs, system integrations, and data exchange between applications.
  • Ability to build strong partnerships with business and IT stakeholders and maintain a high-quality stakeholder experience.
  • Understands and applies quality standards, incorporating both functional and non-functional requirements into solution design.
  • Collaborates effectively within a delivery team and is viewed as a trusted team member by peers and stakeholders.
  • Experience defining and documenting software requirements for low to moderately complex products, systems, or business processes.
  • Fundamental understanding of analytical tools, relational databases, software applications, and data structures.
  • Ability to elicit, analyze, organize, document, and trace business and system requirements throughout the solution lifecycle.
  • Ability to analyze data, business processes, and system interactions to identify issues and recommend solutions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Makes sound tactical decisions using analysis, experience, judgment, and business context.
  • Basic problem-solving and root cause analysis skills.
  • Ability to facilitate small group discussions and workshops to achieve defined outcomes.
  • Comfortable working in environments with changing priorities and evolving business needs.

Premera total rewards

Our comprehensive total rewards package provides support, resources, and opportunities to help employees thrive and grow. Our total rewards are more than a collection of perks, they're a reflection of our commitment to your health and well-being. We offer a broad array of rewards including physical, financial, emotional, and community benefits, including:

  • Medical, vision, and dental coverage with low employee premiums.

  • Voluntary benefit offerings, including pet insurance for paw parents.

  • Life and disability insurance.

  • Retirement programs, including a 401K employer match and, believe it or not, a pension plan that is vested after 3 years of service.

  • Wellness incentives with a wide range of mental well-being resources for you and your dependents, including counseling services, stress management programs, and mindfulness programs, just to name a few.

  • Generous paid time off to reenergize.

  • Looking for continuing education? We have tuition assistance for both undergraduate and graduate degrees.

  • Employee recognition program to celebrate anniversaries, team accomplishments, and more.

For our hybrid employees, our on-campus model provides flexibility to create your own routine with access to on-site resources, networking opportunities, and team engagement.

  • Commuter perks make your trip to work less impactful on the environment and your wallet.

  • Free convenient on-site parking.

  • Subsidized on-campus cafes make lunchtime connections with colleagues fun and affordable.

Role Overview

The Build & Release Support Engineer provides high-impact technical support for the customer’s build, release, and CI/CD systems, which every developer depends on to ship software.

This role is deeply developer-facing and centers on build pipelines, software supply chain workflows, and release tooling. You will help engineers resolve blockers across tools like Maven, Java build systems, Docker, Spinnaker, Artifactory, and Jenkins.

Success depends on strong troubleshooting skills, clear communication, and the ability to manage multiple threads and tickets in parallel. You will be the front line, ensuring developers can deliver reliably, safely, and at high velocity.

Business Outcome

Become a deep expert in the customer’s build and release ecosystem and deliver fast, accurate support across Slack and tickets. Your work will maintain high developer velocity and minimize disruption across global engineering teams.


Success Measures

  • Healthy volume of threads and tickets handled with high-quality outcomes

  • Consistent achievement of time-based SLAs

  • High customer satisfaction through surveys

  • Accurate classification of issue type, severity, and patterns

What Will Be True When You Succeed

  • Developers ship faster with fewer build and release blockers

  • CI/CD and software supply chain tooling become more reliable and more usable

  • Escalations decrease due to strong frontline troubleshooting


Core Work Units

1. Frontline Support for Build & Release Systems

  • Manage Slack threads and tickets (roughly 50/50)

  • Triage build failures, broken pipelines, dependency issues, and configuration errors

  • Provide fast, accurate context before escalating

  • Handle multiple interactions in parallel without losing track

2. Deep-Dive Troubleshooting & Incident Support

  • Diagnose complex build, packaging, or artifact problems independently

  • Investigate issues involving Maven builds, Java compilation, Docker images, Artifactory repos, Jenkins jobs, and Spinnaker pipelines

  • Provide structured guidance throughout incidents

3. Escalation Management

  • Complete a thorough analysis before escalating

  • Gather all required details upfront to reduce back-and-forth

  • Produce clean, high-quality escalation tickets that downstream teams can act on immediately

4. Documentation & Knowledge Development

  • Maintain and refine FAQs and internal documentation

  • Create problem–solution one-pagers for recurring issues

  • Document newly solved problems instinctively and thoroughly

High-Quality Work — what top performance looks like

Frontline Support

  • Quickly identifies whether the issue is build-related, config-related, or infra-related

  • Moves smoothly from triage to deeper analysis

  • Juggles multiple developer inquiries without missing follow-ups

Deep-Dive & Incident Support

  • Resolves complex pipeline or build issues without escalation

  • Coordinates multi-user incidents involving large build failures

  • Communicates clearly during investigation, root-cause analysis, and resolution

Escalations

  • Only escalates after a thorough investigation

  • Provides complete logs, reproduction steps, build metadata, and context

  • Saves downstream engineers time with clean, accurate handoffs

Documentation

  • Documentation is so clear that users avoid opening tickets

  • Proactively updates and refines materials for clarity and accuracy

  • Quickly turns real-world issues into reusable knowledge

Typical Day / Work Patterns

  • ~50% Slack support, ~50% ticket handling

  • Documentation and PRs during low ticket volume periods

  • Weekly team meeting to review escalated tickets

  • High rate of context switching and parallel issue management

Required Skills & Experience

Non-Negotiable Skills

  • Git proficiency and GitHub expertise

  • CI/CD tooling expertise (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.)

  • Build & Release engineering fundamentals

  • Maven and Java build tooling

  • Understanding of software supply chain lifecycle

  • Comfort supporting Artifact repositories (Artifactory, Nexus, etc.)

  • Experience with Spinnaker or similar deployment orchestration

  • Strong troubleshooting ability

  • Clear written and spoken communication

  • SDLC understanding

  • Unix command-line proficiency

  • Linux command-line proficiency

  • Scripting (Python/Bash)

  • Container knowledge (Docker/Kubernetes)

Nice-to-Haves

  • Monitoring tools (Prometheus/Grafana)

  • Prior SRE experience

Minimum Qualifications

  • 2–5 years in Build/Release Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or software development

  • Strong troubleshooting skills

  • Clear communication skills

  • Strong linux skills, scripting, Git, and containers

  • Solid Linux/Unix experience

  • Experience with build tools (Maven/Gradle), containers, and artifact management systems

  • Disqualifiers: no CI/CD experience, poor communication

What You’ll Love

  • Constant learning and rapid skill growth

  • Hands-on technical problem solving

  • Directly unblocking developers across a global organization

What May Be Challenging

  • High context switching

  • Repetitive problem patterns

  • Pressure from supporting high-visibility systems

  • Global team across 130+ countries

  • High autonomy and respect for your time

  • Exposure across multiple clients and modern systems

  • Meaningful, impactful technical challenges

PENN Entertainment, Inc. is North America’s leading provider of integrated entertainment, sports content, and casino gaming experiences. From casinos and racetracks to online gaming, sports betting and entertainment content, we deliver the experiences people want, how and where they want them.

We’re always on the lookout for those who are passionate about creating and delivering cutting-edge online gaming and sports media products. Whether it’s through Hollywood Casino, theScore Bet Sportsbook, or theScore media app, we’re excited to push the boundaries of what’s possible. These state-of-the-art platforms are powered by proprietary in-house technology, a key component of PENN’s omnichannel gaming and entertainment strategy.

When you join PENN Entertainment’s digital team, you’ll not only work on these cutting-edge platforms through theScore and PENN Interactive, but you’ll also be part of a company that truly cares about your career growth. We’re committed to supporting you as you expand your skills and explore new opportunities.

With locations throughout North America, you can build a future at PENN Entertainment wherever you are. If you want to challenge conventions in gaming, media and entertainment, we want to talk to you.

About the Team & Role

As part of the team, you will be working with cross-functional teams of friendly and dedicated Engineers, Product Managers and Designers determined to deliver some of the best apps the market has to offer. You will be responsible for monitoring and responding to security events within our environment in addition to participating in security uplift initiatives by developing internal tools and processes to automate security workflow, perform integration work, and threat analysis.

About Work

  • Serve as the primary technical contact for escalated security events, leading and coordinating incident response from triage through containment, remediation, and post-incident review.
  • Develop and maintain automation for security workflows using scripting and orchestration to reduce manual Level 1 tasks.
  • Monitor, investigate, and triage security alerts, abuse reports, and security events, using AI-assisted tools to accelerate enrichment, analysis, and prioritization.
  • Create, tune, and optimize detection, correlation, and response content in SIEM, EDR, and other security platforms to improve threat detection and reduce alert fatigue.
  • Conduct proactive threat hunting and detection validation, and continuously improve monitoring coverage.
  • Develop and refine incident response processes, playbooks, and procedures for efficient handling of security incidents.
  • Maintain expertise in current and emerging threats, including AI-driven attack techniques and abuse of generative AI platforms.
  • Conduct vulnerability assessments, prioritize remediation, and validate corrective actions across infrastructure, applications, cloud services, and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Evaluate and optimize security technologies, including AI-powered tools, that improve analyst efficiency and automate routine operations, and support the secure integration of new and existing systems into the security program.
  • Support compliance and audit activities by gathering evidence, documenting controls, and assisting with remediation, including responsible and secure adoption of AI technologies.
  • Collaborate effectively with peers and other departments to enhance security practices, uphold a culture of exceptional customer service, and promote continuous professional development through mentorship, industry best practices, and emerging AI security capabilities.
  • Other duties as required.

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM and EDR platforms, including detection engineering and tuning.
  • Working knowledge of scripting or automation (Python, PowerShell, or similar) and SOAR or orchestration tools.
  • Experience with cloud security monitoring (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Familiarity with frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and NIST.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to brief technical and non-technical stakeholders during incidents.
  • Preferred: GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, Security+, CySA+, or equivalent certification; experience in a regulated industry such as gaming, finance, or healthcare.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Comprehensive Benefits package.
  • Fun, relaxed work environment.
  • Education and conference reimbursements.
Salary Range
$155,000—$185,000 CAD

jobs.title: Solutions Design Analyst
jobs.excerpt: At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific we are seeking a detail-oriented and collaborative Solutions Design Analyst to join our team in Costa Rica.
jobs.description:
At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific we are seeking a detail-oriented and collaborative Solutions Design Analyst to join our team in Costa Rica. In this role, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality eCOA (electronic Clinical Outcome Assessment) solution designs for our pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to review study protocols, translate client requirements into optimized solution designs, and ensure accurate and efficient project delivery aligned with clinical objectives.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Private health insurance
  • Engaging employee programs

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Coordinate the overall Solutions Design Process for client studies.
  • Review clinical trial protocols to identify solution needs and define study-specific eCOA designs.
  • Gather sponsor requirements and recommend Clario’s best design components to meet study needs.
  • Create and maintain design specifications ensuring consistency across data capture, delivery, and database structures.
  • Collaborate with Project Management, Data Management, Product, and Clinical Systems Translation & Licensing (CSTL) to align on requirements and data integrity.
  • Present solution designs during internal and external milestone meetings.
  • Support project scoping, change control, and testing processes as needed.
  • Contribute to product and process improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain organized documentation and support study tracking efforts.

What We Look For

  • Bachelor’s degree (BS/BA) or equivalent; degree in science or healthcare-related field preferred.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in clinical trials or equivalent role.
  • Ability to interpret clinical trial documentation such as protocols, questionnaires, and data models.
  • Proven experience in translating client requirements into design specifications.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience interacting with clients at all levels.
  • Familiarity with FDA regulatory processes and clinical research standards.
  • Highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in MS Office Suite; experience with technical documentation tools a plus.
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal, are required.
  • Based in Costa Rica, with ability to work fully remote.

At Clario, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.


The duties and responsibilities listed in this job description represent the major responsibilities of the position. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned, as required. Clario reserves the right to amend or change this job description to meet the needs of Clario. This job description and any attachments do not constitute or represent a contract.

The Department Head has the discretion to hire personnel with a combination of experience and education, which may vary from the above listed qualifications.
