Strong vendor and partner management skills, including contracts, performance, service levels, product roadmaps, security requirements, implementation accountability, and risk allocation. Strategic problem solver who can connect Tax and Treasury technology, data, controls, and AI capabilities to outcomes such as compliance, liquidity visibility, risk reduction, payment integrity, operational resilience, and improved efficiency. Demonstrated experience identifying and implementing automation, AI/ML, advanced analytics, and agentic workflows in controlled financial processes. Ability to define a governed data strategy that improves data quality, accessibility, lineage, reuse, and decision support across jurisdictions and business divisions. Comfortable operating in a matrixed, global environment, balancing enterprise standardization with local tax, banking, legal, regulatory, and market requirements. jobs.excerpt: Warp: We're Building the Platform for Agentic Development Warp began with the vision of reimagining one of the fundamental dev tools, the terminal, to make it more usable and powerful for all developers.
jobs.description:
Warp: We're Building the Platform for Agentic Development

Warp began with the vision of reimagining one of the fundamental dev tools, the terminal, to make it more usable and powerful for all developers. As AI has advanced, Warp has evolved beyond its terminal roots into a full agentic development environment: a workbench for dispatching agents to code, deploy, and debug production software.

Today, we have three products. Warp is the agentic development environment born out of the terminal, built on an orchestration platform for running hundreds of cloud agents in parallel. And Warp Factories is our newest product: infrastructure for engineering teams to build and run their own cloud software factories, where fleets of agents triage, spec, implement, review, and verify code across a company's entire SDLC. Together, these products are creating the scaffolding for developers to build their own workflows for working with agents.

In Warp, you can seamlessly switch between running commands, launching agents, and iterating on code with agents, eliminating the need to jump between a terminal and an IDE. It all works with our built in SOTA agent or top agents like Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. On the orchestration side, you can build custom agents that are triggered programmatically, tracked centrally, and shared across full teams to run agents across organizations without compromising security or reliability. Continue a cloud agent run locally in Warp or on the web with one click. And with Warp Factories, teams can go a step further and set up entire automated workflows around their SDLC, retaining full control over their data, models, and compute along the way.

With over 1 million active developers at companies including Docker, Ramp, and Peloton, and over half of the Fortune 500, and revenue that grew over 44x last year, Warp is one of the fastest growing startups in the AI development space.

Our mission has remained the same even as AI has advanced: to empower developers to ship better software more quickly, freeing them to focus on the creative and rewarding aspects of their work. If you want to help define what development looks like in the agentic era at a company where your work reaches hundreds of thousands of engineers every day, we'd love to have you. For more information on our team and culture, we highly recommend reading our' How We Work' guide.

As a Product Designer, you will…

  • Design and prototype product experiences for Warp using Figma in close collaboration with Warp’s engineering, product, and growth teams.
  • Iterate on existing features to improve ergonomics, cognitive load, workflow friction, design pattern consistency, and comprehension.
  • Craft every detail of new product features, from idea to UX to pixel-perfect execution.
  • Contribute to and help manage Warp’s design system and ensure implementation meets specification.
  • Use Warp to ship UI nits, bugs, and modifications to production.
  • Test designs with our internal team and developer community.
  • Drive the product forward. You will be expected to operate as a product thinker as much as a designer.

You may be a good fit if...

  • You have 3+ years of experience working on AI, ML, DevTools, Data, or other technical products.
  • You enjoy iterating and perfecting detailed workflows.
  • You have a lived understanding of developers’ needs and want to improve their relationships with their tools.
  • You're committed to building and facilitating relationships with non-designers to execute on your shared vision of building the best product for our users
  • You have great communication skills, and have experience working with engineers on a technical product.
  • You have experience contributing to or managing design systems.
  • Bonus:
    • Familiar with the developer experience
    • Some basic experience with coding or using a terminal
    • Experience at a fast paced startup environment
    • Experience designing for AI tools

Salary Transparency

Warp operates from a place of high trust and transparency around compensation. We state the pay range that best aligns with our understanding of the market and the needs for the open role.

When we find the right person, we try to put our best foot forward with an offer that excites you. We consider your skills, the level of experience you bring, and what similar jobs in the market pay, all while ensuring equal pay for equal work at Warp.

Total compensation at Warp consists of: (1) a market-competitive base salary, (2) a generous benefits package, and (3) meaningful equity.

jobs.excerpt: As an engineer at Bask you will work directly with the CEO and CTO to build and design the software infrastructure that will serve as the backbone of telehealth.
jobs.description:
As an engineer at Bask you will work directly with the CEO and CTO to build and design the software infrastructure that will serve as the backbone of telehealth.

We are looking to expand our software engineers, seeking those with deep rooted entrepreneurial spirit.

Our serverless platform is a multi-tenant monorepo — Next.js and React on the front, tRPC and Prisma behind it, deployed on SST, TypeScript throughout. One engineer can follow a change from a form field to the database without crossing a team boundary. That's the point.

Engineering at Bask Health is AI-first and builder-led. Work starts with general understanding of problem, moves to tools like Claude and Cursor for further investigation, making a plan and building, tested on staging with realistic data, released to production, tested with real patient and care teams, and then back for systems and polish. AI is a default part of how we work, not a side experiment — because moving fast in healthcare requires every advantage.

We are looking for engineers who take end-to-end ownership, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about building software that meaningfully improves how healthcare is delivered.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and ship high-quality product experiences. Own key surfaces end to end, from concept through production. Write elegant, well-tested code — we have a real test suite and we intend to keep it that way.
  • Work across the stack. Follow a feature from the interface through the API to the database. No handoffs, no waiting on another team.
  • Work AI-first with Cursor and Claude Code. Use LLMs as your starting point. Draft intent, explore implementations, scaffold components, and refactor with AI in the loop. Apply your own judgment to meet the quality bar healthcare demands.
  • Prototype fast and validate with real users. Build and test quickly with real patients and care teams. Use what you learn to refine before fully committing — especially in sensitive clinical contexts where getting it right matters.
  • Build for scale and own the codebase. Translate product needs into reusable, well-architected patterns that make the next feature faster to ship.
  • Make automation legible and trustworthy. Build systems that clearly communicate what AI and automation are doing on behalf of patients and providers. Earn trust through transparency, reliability, and thoughtful defaults.
  • Champion performance, accessibility, and reliability. Ship work that is fast, robust, and accessible. Partner across the team to debug, optimize, and raise the bar over time.
  • Share AI-native workflows. Document prompts, patterns, and workflows that work, so we move faster together without cutting corners that matter to patient outcomes.

We are a highly collaborative team.

Requirements

A full-stack generalist who has taken a product from 0 to 1 and can apply that instinct inside a system that already has real patients on it. Entrepreneurial, willing to roll up their sleeves, and drawn to a mission that disrupts how healthcare gets delivered.

  • 1+ Years of experience
  • You are a highly skilled dev (React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind and JavaScript).
  • You also have backend skills (tRPC, Drizzle ORM, SQL, Node, SST).
  • You can work independently and are comfortable owning entire projects or large areas of the codebase.
  • Strong experience building paid products and services is preferred.
  • React Native or Expo experience is a plus.
  • You are a strong communicator, able to clearly articulate technical problems, constraints, and timelines.
  • You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, unstructured, startup environment.

If you are a Regional Mental Wellness Coordinator looking to build on your strong track record of assessing and supporting regional mental wellness needs, let’s talk!

Thunderbird invites you to come make a real difference in the lives of Indigenous people!

Organization Description

Thunderbird Partnership Foundation is a national non-profit organization serving First Nations in mental wellness. Our mandate is set by three frameworks:

  1. Honouring Our Strengths: A Renewed Framework to Address Substance Use Issues Among First Nations People in Canada
  2. Indigenous Wellness Framework
  3. First Nations Mental Wellness Continuum (FNMWC)

Our core stakeholders are First Nations communities and the network of First Nations adult and youth treatment centres. To support the mandate, Thunderbird has two office locations, one based in a First Nations community in southwestern Ontario, and the other in the city of London, Ontario. This position is a remote position.

Your opportunity

  • The Regional Mental Wellness Coordinator will establish regional representation to strengthen mental wellness capacity of First Nations across Canada guided by the First Nations Mental Wellness Continuum, Indigenous Wellness Framework and Honouring Our Strengths frameworks.
  • You will assess regional needs and evaluate and provide ongoing support.
  • You will develop and maintain strong professional relationships with the stakeholders of the region as well as with Thunderbird Partnership Foundation staff and First Peoples Wellness Circle (FPWC) staff.
  • You will work on a team with others like yourself who are dedicated to work which has real value and meaning in the lives of others.
  • You will apply all your experience, skills, talents, and passion for the benefit of others while learning from the expertise of your wellness focused team.
  • You will enjoy the satisfaction that comes from knowing that your work is much more than just a job.

As the Thunderbird Partnership Foundation Regional Mental Wellness Coordinator, you will

  • continuously build understanding of the FNMWC implementation efforts nationally and regionally.
  • work to enhance your understanding of the differing and shared objectives and priorities of Thunderbird Partnership Foundation and First Peoples Wellness Circle and apply this knowledge where relevant in regional coordination activities.
  • provide overall support in increasing capacity in mental wellness to the regional stakeholders through establishing Thunderbird Partnership Foundation and maintaining ongoing work.
  • fulfill Thunderbird and FPWC objectives and participate in established regional committees on mental wellness when relevant.
  • coordinate a regional mental wellness committee and working groups to assist in the work of enhancing regional mental wellness.
  • map regional networks and resources supporting First Nations mental wellness services including provincial and territorial services.
  • engage relevant regional First Nations entities, networks, and non-profit organizations in creating and maintaining
    • standardized curriculum for Addictions Services,
    • FNMWC core competencies and evaluation,
    • regional strategies for opioids and methamphetamines, and
    • crisis response planning and intervention.
  • support development, implementation and sustainability of research coordination and mental wellness data governance to include substance use health, treatment, harm reduction, trauma, crisis, culture based programming and regional and national training.
  • evaluate the needs of the region in consultation with stakeholders and make recommendations.
  • maintain systems maps to communicate treatment pathways and manage a regional database of stakeholders and partners.
  • build and maintain strong working relationships with stakeholders and assure readiness, quality, and delivery of services.
  • participate in creating local awareness of Thunderbird Partnership Foundation and FPWC.
  • manage effective networking, communication and information sharing between Thunderbird, FPWC and stakeholders.
  • ensure alignment to the Thunderbird and FPWC strategic plans, missions, and visions.
  • contribute to the implementation of Thunderbird’s business plan and prepare comprehensive work plans for work completion.
  • assess all assigned projects and coordinate their phases from initiation to completion.
  • ensure that all activities planned for the region are implemented and on schedule.
  • coordinate meetings with Thunderbird and FPWC personnel and stakeholders as required, keeping everyone involved in progress and changes to project plans.
  • prepare meeting agendas, reports, briefing notes and any other accompanying documents for the CEO, Board of Directors, stakeholders, and others as required.
  • monitor activities within the regions based on allocated funds and ensure expenditures stay within budget.

  • two years work-related experience (with a master’s degree) and 4 years of work-related experience (with a bachelor’s degree)
  • excellent writing skills in English and the ability to communicate clearly.
  • hands on experience with Microsoft Office.
  • proficiency in using Zoom and other platforms as required for hosting online meetings and events.
  • experience working with First Nations, or an Indigenous organization.
  • fluency in a First Nations language (which is considered an asset).
  • knowledge of First Nations culture and customs including natural healing.
  • excellent interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written).
  • the ability to work collaboratively with internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • the ability to function autonomously with minimal supervision, to be flexible and adaptable to change.
  • a high level of professionalism and an ability to always maintain confidentiality.
  • a strong work ethic and commitment to quality.
  • organizational, time-management and multitask skills with the ability to work on multiple assignments in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.

  • public speaking and presentation skills along with community engagement and networking.
  • the ability to network and build strong working relationships.
  • the means to travel and access worksites not accessible by public transit.

The Senior Data Analyst works independently and collaboratively with Statistical and Data Analysts to provide analytical data support.

  • Detects anomalies in healthcare data and investigates potential indicators of fraudulent activity. Identifies outliers that demonstrate patterns consistent with fraud, waste, or abuse.

  • Extracts and manipulates Medicare, Medicaid, and other healthcare claims data housed in cloud environments using software tools including Python, R, SQL, SAS and others as appropriate to the task.

  • Maintains ongoing knowledge of Medicare and Medicaid policies, including updates and changes. Evaluates the implications of policy changes on fraud detection models and adjusts methodologies accordingly.

  • Prepares detailed analytical reports.
  • May serve as a Team Lead, responsible for planning, coordinating, and documenting project activities, managing team performance, and serving as a primary liaison with clients.

  • Minimum 4-year degree in statistics, mathematics, computer science or related field or possesses a minimum of 6 years of data analysis experience within the healthcare industry.

jobs.excerpt: BackgroundThe African Climate Foundation (ACF) is the first and only African-led climate change re-granting organisation on the continent.
jobs.description:
Background

The African Climate Foundation (ACF) is the first and only African-led climate change re-granting organisation on the continent. Through a combination of grant making, fellowships, transformational research, technical assistance, coalition building and advocacy the ACF seeks to support interventions at the nexus of climate change, and development that have the greatest potential to deliver long-term socio-economic transformation and inclusive development. ACF also provides Fiscal Hosting (also called Fiscal Sponsorship) services to support emerging and mission aligned organisations and initiatives.

About the New Economy Hub

The New Economy Hub partners with people campaigning to decarbonise Africa and build an inclusive low-carbon economy that delivers social security and economic justice. We offer flexible and movement-generous support to initiatives that are building movement power and advancing concrete development pathways for a clean and equitable energy future that underpins a new economy and just society in Africa.

The New Economy Hub is an incubated hub of the African Climate Foundation.

About the 99%

The We the 99% platform emerged from the 2025 Johannesburg People’s Summit, where 5,000 participants from over 200 organisations across 30 countries agreed the We the 99% Declaration. Its ten demands span taxing the 1%, debt justice, corporate accountability, a funded fossil fuel phase-out, the redistribution of care work, food sovereignty and the protection of civic space. The platform is co-convened by the New Economy Hub, the Fight Inequality Alliance and Mobilize.

Purpose

We are looking for a strategic and dynamic We the 99% Engagement Coordinator to lead a programme of South-South and North-South dialogue across the platform’s membership. Multilateral cooperation is fragmenting, and rebuilding confidence in it requires national claims to converge from the ground up. The Engagement Coordinator will work with member organisations to contextualise the ten demands of the Declaration in the countries and territories where the platform is represented. They will then bring those national interpretations together into a shared programme of action, timed to key moments in the 2027 global governance calendar including G20 and COP moments. The Engagement Coordinator will be the primary touchpoint between the Hub, the platform’s co-convenors and its membership.

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

Programme coordination and network engagement (30%)

  • Leads the design of the engagement programme. Delivers an inception plan within three weeks of appointment, setting out the sequence of dialogues, teach-ins and mobilisation moments, participation targets and the approach to contextualising the ten demands.
  • Maps the membership and keeps the record up to date, by country or territory, demand area, language and capacity to take part.
  • Serves as the day-to-day coordination point between the the platform’s co-convenors, convening regular check-ins and documenting decisions.
  • Maintains regular communications and an effective flow of information between the platform and its membership, including through a regular bulletin to member organisations.
  • Manages the programme workplan, the delegated activity budget and logistics, including interpretation, virtual platforms and scheduling across time zones.

Convening and contextualisation (30%)

  • Designs and facilitates at least five virtual South-South and North-South dialogues, reaching at least 300 participants from Africa, South and East Asia, and Latin America and the Caribbean.
  • Convenes at least eight webinars, debates and teach-ins with member organisations, reaching at least 500 participants across at least six countries and territories. These are co-hosted with national-level actors so that the framing comes from the national level.
  • Ensures convenings are accessible across languages, time zones and bandwidth, and that they bring out differing priorities rather than forcing consensus too early.
  • Compiles a record of engagements documenting how each of the ten demands is understood, prioritised and contextualised across the represented countries and territories, applying consistent documentation, consent and data-protection protocols.
  • Leads a consultation with the body of the We the 99% platform to draft a synthesis statement that links national interpretations to a shared programme of action, ready for co-convenor review within 8 months of their appointment.

Advocacy and mobilisation (20%)

  • Develops and maintains a live advocacy calendar registering mobilisations and direct actions timed to key global governance processes including the G20 UK 2027 and preparations for the COP32 Ethiopia processes.
  • Coordinates, with the body of the We the 99% platform, at least three joint mobilisations and direct actions at key moments, flagging safety, civic space and reputational risks to the line manager in advance.
  • Coordinates the development of engagement tools and resources, such as briefs, presentations, mobilisation toolkits and press releases, that advance the platform’s advocacy priorities.
  • Co-creates integrated media and communications campaigns with the Hub’s Strategic Communications Officer, the co-convenors and relevant partners.

Learning (20%)

  • Leads the development of a light-touch monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL) framework for the programme at inception, including two or three learning questions agreed with the line manager and co-convenors.
  • Monitors the programme’s performance against its indicators, collecting participation data broken down by region, country, gender and type of organisation.
  • Produces short reflection notes after each convening and a periodic learning digest for the co-convenors, and leads a mid-point learning review to adjust delivery.

Requirements include but are not limited to:

  • Honours’s degree in Social Sciences, Law, Development, Economics, Journalism, Media Studies or related field.
  • 5 years’ experience in network coordination, movement building and/or advocacy, including work across more than one country.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and facilitating convenings across several countries, including virtual convenings across languages and time zones.
  • Working knowledge of the global economic justice agenda, with depth in at least one of the Declaration’s demand areas, and an understanding of how civil society engages multilateral processes such as the G20 and UNFCCC.
  • Demonstrable experience delivering advocacy campaigns and trans-national mobilisations that catalyse action.
  • A strategic thinker with an entrepreneurial orientation.
  • Outstanding synthesis, communication and report-writing skills, with the ability to turn many voices into a coherent record without flattening their differences.
  • Experience applying participatory monitoring, evaluation and learning methods.
  • Excellent organisational and planning skills, with close attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English; working proficiency in Spanish, French or Portuguese is a strong advantage.
  • Adaptable, resourceful, self-motivated and able to prioritise with ease in a fast-moving, remote environment.
  • Excellent organisational and planning skills, with close attention to detail.

Start date: Position available immediately.

Location: ACF’s operational hub is in Cape Town, South Africa. Remote working will be considered for candidates based on the African continent.

Contract duration: 12 months (renewable based on mutual agreement).

Closing date: 11 November 2026.

Application Details:

  • Applicants must have the legal right to work in the country where they are based.

For further information about the ACF, visit

Should you not hear back from us by 31 December 2026, please consider your application to be unsuccessful.

The ACF strives to be an equitable organisation with a team which reflects the diversity of Africa.

In compliance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), The ACF assures all applicants that any personal information provided during the recruitment process will be treated with the utmost confidentiality and used solely for recruitment purposes. Your privacy and data security are of paramount importance to us. By applying for this position, you consent to the collection, processing, and storage of your personal information for recruitment-related activities only. The ACF is committed to safeguarding your privacy and maintaining the trust you place in us.

GTX Solutions leads data activation and delivery for enterprise CRM programs on the Salesforce platform, including Marketing Cloud and Data 360, spanning email, SMS and direct mail. The Implementation Engineer implements web and app measurement, tagging and data collection across GTX client engagements.   • Experience implementing GA4 or Adobe Analytics, including event configuration, data validation and troubleshooting discrepancies.

jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks two Senior Database Administrators to support daily database operations, monitoring, maintenance, access administration, patching, backup and recovery, and troubleshooting under the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

These positions will administer Microsoft SQL Server environments supporting mission applications, data analysis, AI-related data activities, and data warehouse operations. The Database Administrators will maintain database health, security, performance, and recoverability while supporting approved schema changes and maintaining accurate operational documentation.

The successful candidates will collaborate with database architects, data engineers, application teams, infrastructure personnel, cybersecurity specialists, and Government stakeholders to sustain reliable database services and resolve operational issues.

These positions are remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Senior Database Administrators will:

  • Perform daily monitoring and administration of Microsoft SQL Server environments.
  • Monitor database availability, performance, capacity, storage utilization, job execution, and system alerts.
  • Execute scheduled maintenance, integrity checks, indexing, statistics updates, and other approved database maintenance activities.
  • Plan and implement approved database patches and updates, including pre-change checks, validation, and rollback preparation.
  • Administer database accounts, roles, permissions, and service access in accordance with approved access requests.
  • Review access configurations and support periodic access validation.
  • Execute and monitor database backups, investigate failures, and maintain backup records.
  • Perform database restores and recovery testing to verify recoverability.
  • Support outage restoration and database recovery in coordination with architecture, infrastructure, application, and operations teams.
  • Troubleshoot database connectivity, job failures, blocking, resource contention, integrity issues, and performance degradation.
  • Tune queries, indexes, configurations, and maintenance processes within approved technical standards.
  • Support database and warehouse operations, including scheduled loads, data refreshes, and integration dependencies.
  • Implement approved schema changes, database objects, and configuration updates.
  • Coordinate changes with application, data engineering, analytics, and testing teams.
  • Validate database health and dependent services following maintenance, patches, schema changes, or restoration.
  • Support database security monitoring and remediation of assigned findings.
  • Maintain operational logs, incident records, change documentation, configuration records, and maintenance procedures.
  • Update backup, recovery, troubleshooting, and administration runbooks.
  • Escalate complex architectural, availability, security, or performance issues to the Database Architect and appropriate technical leads.
  • Support operational handoffs, knowledge transfer, and continuous improvement of database administration practices.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

The following must-have qualifications are drawn from the supplied position requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Minimum of eight years of relevant professional experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, information systems, or a related field, or a permitted equivalent.
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server administration.
  • Experience performing database patching.
  • Experience administering database access controls.
  • Experience with database performance tuning.
  • Experience performing database backup and recovery.
  • Ability to perform daily database monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
  • Ability to support warehouse operations, approved schema changes, and database documentation.
  • CompTIA Security+ CE or another approved IAT Level II certification.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • Relevant database platform certification.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense database environments.
  • Experience with SQL Server Agent, Transact-SQL, and database administration scripting.
  • Experience supporting high-availability configurations, replication, or failover operations.
  • Experience supporting data warehouses, ETL/ELT jobs, and scheduled data integrations.
  • Familiarity with database auditing, encryption, vulnerability remediation, and configuration hardening.
  • Experience automating monitoring, maintenance, backup validation, or administrative tasks.
  • Experience supporting database migrations, upgrades, refreshes, and recovery exercises.
  • Familiarity with cloud-hosted or hybrid database environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and cross-team coordination skills.

You own full-cycle accounting for a portfolio of eCommerce client files. Reconciliations, A/P, A/R, journal entries, month-end and year-end close. You are responsible for the numbers being right and delivered on time.

  • English at B2 level or above, written and spoken

Nice to have

  • Month end is the most demanding period of the month and falls within the first ten business days. It eases considerably after that.

Job title: Sr. Director of Security Operations

Reports to: Vice President, Global Clients Datacenters

About our team

We are a dynamic, dedicated team that provides management and support for a global guarding services account that spans across 30+ countries. Our client is an industry-leading datacenter organization, and we pride ourselves in delivering best-in-class solutions through our teams made up of Security Operations, Business Operations, Shared Services, Threat and Incident Management, Environmental Health and Safety, and Human Resources. As part of this team, you’ll be part of our leadership team and work alongside a group of professionals that are committed to excellence and innovation.

About the role

The Sr. Director of Security Operations is responsible for overseeing a worldwide security operations team that protects the critical data center infrastructure for a complex, multi-hundred-million-dollar client account. This senior leadership position also leads operational control of the Physical Security Operations Center (PSOC), integrating strategic threat response with operational security oversight. The role provides executive-level direction, aligns Securitas and client objectives, and drives program performance, service delivery, and global consistency across all regions. This role requires a forward-thinking professional with a strong command of security operations, a passion for operational excellence, and the ability to lead and inspire high-performing teams in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will lead regional directors and manage the full spectrum of global physical security operations, ensuring audit compliance, operational standardization, and quality control. You will also lead global threat and incident response initiatives, develop preventative security strategies, and ensure effective PSOC operations. Your responsibilities include delivering executive-level briefings, nurturing key client relationships, collaborating across functions and time zones, and driving continuous improvement in security operations. Additionally, you’ll coordinate closely with our Program Management Office (PMO), lead cross-functional teams, and provide strategic insights to internal and client leadership.

What you need to apply

We are looking for a seasoned professional that has a bachelor’s degree in business, security, or a related field, along with 10–15 years of progressive leadership experience in physical security or account management, including 3–5 years at the senior director level. Global operational experience is required and a background in data centers, threat response, or PSOC leadership are strongly preferred. The role demands excellent communication skills across all organizational levels, strong leadership and crisis management capabilities, and a process-driven mindset.

This position involves travel (approximately 30% of the time), so a passion for travel (and a valid passport) is essential. This role may also have to work nights and weekends to support high priority events and off-hours incidents.

All applicants to this role must have reliable means of communication, reliable means of transportation (public or private) to get to/from work, the legal right to work in the country where the position is located, and the ability to speak, read and write in English proficiently.

What you’ll get

We believe great work deserves great rewards—and we’re committed to staying competitive. This role offers a base salary of $200,000 to $230,000. That range is based on the Greater Seattle Area and may flex depending on your experience and location. We’ve got you covered with medical, dental, and vision insurance, along with life insurance, parental leave, and paid time off.

The extra stuff

This position requires—with or without reasonable accommodation—the physical and mental ability to perform all essential job functions effectively. This includes maintaining composure under pressure while interacting with clients, authorities, executives, and staff; working independently without direct supervision; and managing multiple tasks simultaneously. The role involves regular use of a computer and keyboard, frequent lifting or moving of items up to 10 pounds, and occasional lifting of up to 25 pounds. Visual acuity for both near and far distances, as well as the ability to adjust focus, is required. The position may involve handling sensitive or confidential information and requires flexibility in scheduling to meet operational demands.

Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

As a Product Manager, Degree Programs in the USA Product team, you’ll own TripleTen’s new online Master’s in Applied AI end to end: its positioning, why students choose it, and how it runs day to day. We’re launching the program with an accredited US college, and you’ll be the main bridge between the college and our product, marketing, and sales teams. You’ll work directly with the college’s leadership and faculty, so the role runs fully in English.

What you will do

  • Own the program as a product. Set the vision, roadmap, key metrics, and unit economics model for the online MS in Applied AI.
  • Prioritize what to build. Turn student, market, and partner insights into clear priorities, and decide what ships first.
  • Own the student experience. Shape the journey from application and onboarding to graduation, and fix friction points using student feedback and data.
  • Set learning experience requirements. Define class schedule, live and self-paced mix, project formats, and review turnaround standards with the curriculum and operations teams.
  • Run product research. Interview hiring managers and students, and analyze competing online Master’s degrees, AI bootcamps, and certificates.
  • Shape the value proposition. Define and test positioning with marketing and sales, and equip them with briefs, FAQs, and answers to student objections.
  • Manage the university partnership. Be the main contact for the college’s leadership, faculty, and admissions; run syncs, negotiate, and resolve issues early.

Requirements

Must have

  • 4+ years in product management, including 2+ in EdTech, online education, or B2C subscription. You work with funnels and unit economics, build financial models, and decide from data.
  • Positioning and partnerships. You’ve built value propositions with marketing and sales and driven shared decisions with external partners.
  • Native or near-native English. You write clearly, present with confidence, and negotiate comfortably with US partners.

Nice to have

  • Higher education experience. Online degrees, university partnerships, OPM, accreditation, or admissions, ideally in the US market.
  • Go-to-market for education. Background in product marketing or launching education products.
  • AI and ML knowledge. Enough grounding in the AI and ML landscape, ideally hands-on, to discuss the program credibly with faculty and students.

What we can offer you

  • Ownership. Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage.
  • Remote and flexible. Fully remote, full-time collaboration.
  • International team. Colleagues across the US, Latin America, and Europe.
  • Digital office. Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.

Location: Remote, New York City, or Oakland, CA

Role Type: Full-time

Compensation: $150,000

Reports to: Chief Impact Officer

Visa sponsorship: Not available

Hires remotely in: United States

Experience: 5+ years

-

Recidiviz is thrilled to be hiring a Senior Product Manager to join our team! We’re a small, fast-moving nonprofit that builds tools that impact criminal justice decision making and outcomes. That’s where you come in. We’re looking for a creative, high-agency product leader who can help shape our roadmap, rally cross-functional teams, and bring impactful ideas to life with scrappy execution and strategic insight.

About us

Recidiviz is creating safer, healthier communities by improving outcomes for people in the criminal justice system. We build technology to reduce the number of people in prison and to help criminal justice leaders embrace data-driven decision-making.

Using software tools and thoughtful product design, we’ve been able to safely and permanently reduce incarceration and improve outcomes. We work side-by-side with leaders of the criminal justice system, people in prison and on supervision, and ecosystem partners to build a better path forward. In addition to the revenue we earn from state partners, some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations support our work.

People who succeed at Recidiviz lead with kindness and humility, assume good intent, learn from failure, and fix problems when they see them. They are excited to work arm in arm with government leadership and staff to improve outcomes. They are great listeners. They build deep relationships with and empathy for the people we work with and the people who our mission serves, even when those two groups feel at odds.

About the role

Senior Product Managers at Recidiviz own big, complex, mission-critical problem spaces and turn them into high-impact, highly-loved software. You’ll work with engineers, designers, and justice system leaders to identify opportunities, ship products, and iterate fast. Travel is part of the role and planned collaboratively — but the role is remote-flexible with offices in NYC and Oakland for those who prefer hybrid.

Please note: We expect this role will require 10-25% of time spent traveling domestically across the US, about 1-3 trips per quarter. We expect these trips to include visits to prisons and parole offices.

Core responsibilities

  • Lead strategy and execution for one or more of our key agency partnerships and flagship product lines — from vision to wireframe to deployment and iteration
  • Translate ambiguous real-world needs into smart, user-centric product decisions in collaboration with state partners, engineers, and designers
  • Drive product discovery with grit and creativity — conducting interviews, mapping workflows, and testing hypotheses in scrappy ways
  • Define metrics, track outcomes, and communicate impact across internal and external audiences
  • Foster a strong product culture grounded in clarity, curiosity, and urgency
  • Roll up your sleeves to help with whatever it takes — we’re a small team, and we all pitch in

Wild success

In your first year at Recidiviz, you might:

  • Launch a new tool that helps thousands of people safely exit the correctional system — and scale that tool to be used in multiple states within months.
  • Own a portfolio of tools that enable decision makers in corrections to improve reentry outcomes of justice-impacted individuals.
  • Collaboratively define a product vision and strategy that reimagines the criminal justice system into an engine for economic mobility.

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product management building user-facing software
  • Strong product sense and strategic intuition — you can see the big picture and sweat the details
  • Comfortable leading through ambiguity and independently making calls with imperfect data
  • Proven ability to collaborate with complex stakeholder relationships with empathy, diplomacy, and clarity
  • Love being scrappy - you spot opportunities others miss and aren’t afraid to roll up your sleeves to chase them. You treat constraints as catalysts, not roadblocks, and bring ingenuity to both strategy and execution.
  • Technical fluency — you’re comfortable working closely with engineers and understanding architectural tradeoffs
  • Passion for our mission to make the criminal justice system more humane, equitable, and effective
  • Willing to travel: We expect this role will require 10-25% of time spent traveling domestically across the US, about 1-3 trips per quarter. These trips include visits to prisons and parole offices.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience shipping products in government, health, criminal justice, or similarly complex domains
  • Background in startups, civic tech, or other resource-constrained, impact-driven environments
  • Strong storytelling skills for motivating teams, aligning stakeholders, and driving change
  • Corrections industry working experience, or lived experience navigating the corrections system

Compensation

Compensation is standardized based on roles and responsibilities. This ensures equitable compensation and responsible stewardship of our resources. As such, we do not negotiate compensation offers.

The compensation for this role is $155,000.

What we offer

  • Effective, extremely thoughtful colleagues, working together on a mission that matters
  • 90% medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage for you and your dependents
  • Flexible time off, including 20 days of PTO, 3 days of paid volunteering time, and 13 paid holidays per year
  • 401(k) retirement plan with 5% company match and no vesting period
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Complimentary One Medical membership (availability based on location)
  • Partnership with Carrot to provide employees with inclusive fertility and family-forming benefits, as well as a small but growing number of hormonal health and gender-affirming care benefits
  • Monthly ClassPass credit for personal wellness
  • Free mental health support via Talkspace
  • Well-located offices in Oakland and Manhattan, with the flexibility to work remotely or go into either office as you choose
  • An annual company offsite and other ad-hoc gatherings
  • All the exhilarating challenges and stretch opportunities of a tech startup, combined with the mission-driven heart of a nonprofit

More about Recidiviz

Recidiviz was an all-volunteer effort until early 2019, when Clementine, Andrew, and Joshua founded the organization. Since then, we’ve built an A-team of software engineers, designers, product managers and domain experts, from companies like Google, Apple, Dropbox, Opower, and Sidewalk Labs. Recidiviz was part of Y-Combinator’s 2019 class and has received support from some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations, including Ford Foundation, Mackenzie Scott, Schmidt Futures, Arnold Ventures, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, and the Mozilla Foundation.

Today, Recidiviz works with (and earns revenue from) over 18 state partners – big and small, red and blue – and covers more than 40% of the US incarcerated population. We have helped to get tens of thousands of people out of the criminal justice system, safely and equitably, and saved states nearly $1 billion. In the next five years, Recidiviz plans to partner with 40 states and help 250,000 people who are stuck in the system to get out and stay out. In addition to partnering with state Departments of Corrections, Recidiviz collaborates with and learns from partners – from organizations like the Correctional Leaders Association (CLA) to community based organizations and justice-impacted individuals, whose perspectives guide our work.

To learn more about how we do what we do, check out our 2024 Year in Review, read some press coverage, or watch our TED Talk. And if you’re really keen to see our work, you can dive into our Github :).

An important note

Lasting change is always built on diversity. Recidiviz recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, gender identity and all protected status as required by applicable law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a special need that requires accommodation, please let us know in your application. Even if you don't think you meet all the criteria above, drop your resume, and we'll take a look – you might be great for another role or another time!

Nie szukamy wykładowców. Szukamy praktyków z historią do opowiedzenia.

Takich, którzy pamiętają swój pierwszy odrzucony projekt, wiedzą, jak wygląda brief o 23:00 i mają w sobie tę jedną rzecz, której nie da się wygooglować: doświadczenie.

Ty wnosisz wiedzę, swoje case'y i perspektywę z branży. My pomagamy przełożyć je na kurs, który naprawdę działa: wspieramy Cię metodycznie, produkcyjnie i organizacyjnie.

A na końcu zostaje coś, czego nie zrobi za Ciebie żadne AI: ludzie, którzy dzięki Tobie potrafią zrobić coś, czego wcześniej nie potrafili.

Kreatywna Polska nie potrzebuje więcej teorii dla samej teorii. Potrzebuje ludzi, którzy wiedzą, jak to się naprawdę robi.

Requirements

Kogo szukamy?

  • Masz doświadczenie, niekoniecznie tytuł.
    Liczy się to, co zrobiłeś/aś, nie stanowisko zapisane w CV. Projekty, klienci, produkty, kampanie, decyzje i problemy, które udało Ci się rozwiązać.
  • Masz historie.
    Realne projekty, sukcesy, fuck-upy i rzeczy, których człowiek uczy się dopiero po którymś deadline'ie. To właśnie z nich powstają najlepsze zajęcia.
  • Nadal jarasz się swoją branżą.
    Nawet jeśli widziałeś/aś już setki briefów, nadal masz ochotę dyskutować o tym, jak robić rzeczy lepiej.
  • Chcesz dzielić się wiedzą.
    Nauczanie to nie mówienie do kamery. To chęć, żeby ktoś dzięki Tobie zrozumiał coś szybciej, niż Ty kiedyś. Jeśli mentorujesz, prowadzisz warsztaty albo jesteś tą osobą, do której juniorzy przychodzą z pytaniem „ej, możesz mi to wytłumaczyć?”, mamy dobry znak.
  • Chcesz też nauczyć się czegoś nowego.
    Bo kiedy próbujesz wytłumaczyć komuś swoją pracę od podstaw, nagle sam/a zaczynasz patrzeć na nią inaczej.

Benefits

Co z tego masz?

  • Budujesz swoją markę ekspercką.
    Twój kurs i Twoje nazwisko pojawiają się przed ludźmi, których naprawdę interesuje Twoja branża. My pomagamy dotrzeć z nimi dalej.
  • Nie zostajesz z kursem sam/a.
    Pomagamy zamienić Twoją wiedzę w dobrze zaprojektowany program. Wspieramy Cię metodycznie, produkcyjnie, organizacyjnie i promocyjnie.
  • Poznajesz ludzi z branży.
    Wokół SKVOT-u są twórcy, projektanci, artyści, managerowie i eksperci z różnych kreatywnych światów. Czasem zaczyna się od kursu, a kończy na nowym projekcie, współpracy albo znajomości, której wcześniej nie miałeś/aś.
  • Porządkujesz lata własnego doświadczenia.
    Wiedza, która do tej pory żyła w projektach, notatkach, prezentacjach i Twojej głowie, zaczyna układać się w konkretny system.
  • Zostawiasz coś po sobie.
    Portfolio to jedno. Drugie to ludzie, którzy zaczynają robić lepsze rzeczy, bo kiedyś trafili na Twoje zajęcia.

Nie widzisz teraz kursu ze swojej dziedziny?

Idealnie. Właśnie po to tu jesteś.

Budujemy bazę ekspertów, z którymi chcielibyśmy tworzyć kolejne kursy SKVOT. Opowiedz nam, czym się zajmujesz, w czym jesteś naprawdę dobry/a i czego mógłbyś/mogłabyś nauczyć innych.

Jeśli będziemy tworzyć projekt, do którego pasuje Twoje doświadczenie, odezwiemy się.

Może następnego kursu SKVOT jeszcze nie ma. Może zaczyna się właśnie od Ciebie.

Job Description:

Senior Enterprise Solutions Architect – Microsoft Dynamics 365 & Power Platform

Position Detail

About the Company

GVW is a leading automotive manufacturer executing a multi-year digital transformation to modernize enterprise systems and unlock value with Microsoft technologies. The GVW Technology Roadmap centers on Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and Azure, building a unified, data-driven, AI-enabled application landscape.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly experienced architect to lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade solutions across Dynamics 365 (Finance & Supply Chain, Customer Engagement, HR) and Power Platform. You will define architectures, own integration strategy (Teamcenter,NetSuite, ServiceNow, Boomi, and line-of-business systems), and drive delivery quality using modern ALM and governance—directly advancing the GVW roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities

•Architect and deliver end-to-end solutions using Dynamics 365SCM,F&O, CE, HR, and Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages).

•Lead technical design sessions, produce solution documentation, and oversee implementation teams.

•Define integration strategies with legacy systems and third-party platforms (e.g., Teamcenter, Supplier Portal, Boomietc.) using Azure Logic Apps, Functions, Service Bus, and APIs.

•Establish and enforce best practices for data governance, security, and performance optimization.

•Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

•Guide the adoption of new Microsoft features and updates, ensuring alignment with GVW’s roadmap.

•Support DevOps practices including CI/CD, environment provisioning, and release management.

•Apply Microsoft Success by Design methodology and ALM best practices (LCS, Power Platform Admin Center, Azure DevOps).

Advantageous Responsibilities

•Design and govern agentic AI solutions (Copilot Studio, Azure AI, multi-agent orchestration) to augment business processes.

•Implement responsible AI controls, prompt safety, and telemetry for AI-enabled solutions.

•Define KPIs and value realization for AI-driven business outcomes.

•Collaborate with Data/AI teams on model selection, evaluation, and responsible AI practices.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise architecture and solution delivery.
  • Proven success in leading Dynamics 365 implementations across multiple modules (ERP, CRM, HR).
  • Expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure services, and integration frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data architecture, security models, and cloud-native design.
  • Proficiency in C#, .NET, JavaScript, and Dynamics 365 SDK.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and DevOps tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub).
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred/Advantageous Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Solution Architect Expert.
  • Experience in manufacturing, automotive, or supply chain domains.
  • Deep expertise in Azure architecture, including infrastructure, security, and scalability.
  • Advanced proficiency in Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate).
  • Familiarity with AI technologies such as AI Builder, D365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and machine learning integration.
  • Exposure to legacy ERP migration and modernization strategies.
  • Microsoft Certified: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect (AB-100)or similar

Success Metrics

  • Percentage of Dynamics 365 projects delivered on time and within scope, aligned with GVW Technology Roadmap milestones.
  • Rate of solution designs approved without major revisions, based on governance reviews and stakeholder feedback.
  • Percentage of integrations (e.g., Teamcenter, Supplier Portal, Boomi) deployed without critical post-launch issues.
  • Number of new Microsoft features (e.g., Power Platform components, Azure services, AI tools) successfully evaluated and implemented per quarter.
  • Value realization and adoption metrics for AI-enabled solutions (if applicable).

Why Join Us?

  • Drive strategic transformation in a high-impact role.
  • Work with cutting-edge Microsoft technologies.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Legal, Finance, HR, and Engineering.
  • Competitive compensation, flexible work arrangements, and a culture of innovation.

Job Level

  • Mid-level technicalprofessionalaccountablefor the architecting and delivering of a legacy application transformationtoa consolidated modernized Microsoft stack.

jobs.excerpt: About JobGetAs the #1 app focused on everyday workers, JobGet is redefining the future of hiring.
jobs.description:
About JobGet

As the #1 app focused on everyday workers, JobGet is redefining the future of hiring. Founded in 2019, JobGet began as the only mobile-first hiring platform for everyday workers. Since then, we’ve grown by joining forces with Snagajob, the largest hourly job board in the U.S., followed by Seasoned, the leading platform for restaurant hiring. Each acquisition has brought JobGet closer to the frontline, making the platform faster, smarter, and more effective.

While most platforms chase volume, JobGet is laying the foundation for a new kind of hiring infrastructure focused on precision, speed, and real outcomes. Our AI-powered engine learns, adapts, and improves continuously. Employers don’t just get candidates, they get hires. Workers don’t just search, they get matched. The result is a more efficient hiring process with less friction and better results.

We serve a diverse range of industries, from food service and customer support to healthcare, logistics, and manufacturing. With access to over 200 million job seekers, our platform leverages cutting-edge AI to match qualified, role-ready candidates, automating key parts of the hiring process for faster decisions and better outcomes. By combining scale with precision, we’re transforming how businesses hire and how people find meaningful work.

Our mission is simple: to help everyday workers thrive by providing accessible, frictionless hiring solutions that deliver real results. Join us as we continue to build the future of work for the millions of people who power our world every day.

Learn more about our culturehere.

Who We Are

We’ve designed our values to be more than just buzzwords; they’re things we can do. We hope that our culture reflects our values by our commitment to living them every day.

Make a difference every day

  • Teamwork - We make time to help colleagues across JobGet succeed.
  • Excellence - We set ambitious targets, put in extraordinary effort, and persevere until we have accomplished — or exceeded — our goals.
  • Innovation - We’re a team of creative, outside-the-box thinkers who thrive in a continuously evolving environment. To us, innovation is about questioning the status quo and always striving to do things better.

Have Unwavering grit

  • Resilience - By remaining resilient and adaptable, we grow stronger as individuals and as an organization.
  • Accountability - We operate with an ownership mentality where everyone feels a sense of responsibility to make us better and always act in the best interest of JobGet.
  • Speed - We make decisions fast and execute them even faster. Bias for speed is one of our core strengths and a key advantage over our competitors.

Grow through curiosity & kindness

  • Respect - We treat each other with mutual respect, kindness, and celebrate our differences.
  • Learning - We ask questions and seek to understand by being genuinely curious & communicative.
  • Culture - We believe that each of us is responsible for our culture. It requires self-discipline and the drive to contribute to something greater than ourselves.

What You’ll Do

We are looking for an exceptional and ambitious engineer who enjoys architecting systems, working in an agile start-up development environment, and leveraging AI to redefine engineering velocity. As an engineer on our team you will focus on backend development across all our products.

You will be the engineer others look to when the problem is hard, the path forward is unclear, or the stakes are high. As a key individual contributor, you won't just build; you will bridge the gap between engineering and the broader business, translating long-term goals into technical reality while modeling the engineering best practices that elevate our entire organization. As part of our tight-knit team, you thrive in building scalable, flexible systems with an emphasis on improving maintainability.

Strategic Leadership & Alignment

  • Shape Technical Strategy: Proactively partner with leadership to bridge the gap between engineering and the broader business to ensure technical strategies and roadmaps directly support and accelerate overarching business goals.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Priorities: Collaborate with product and development managers to surface trade-offs and ensure engineering priorities are communicated persuasively across the organization.
  • Navigate Complex Environments: Align impact across a multi-product, multi-team environment, identifying opportunities for platform consolidation and technical consistency.
  • Autonomy & Decision Making: Demonstrate high resourcefulness; you are empowered to make significant technical decisions and drive projects end-to-end with limited oversight.

Hands-On Execution & Technical Excellence

  • High Contribution: Maintain a high bar for individual execution by writing clean, efficient, and production-ready code.
  • Rigorous Testing & Validation: Lead by example in code quality by defining testing standards and utilizing AI to generate robust test suites and edge-case discovery that ensure comprehensive coverage.
  • Proactive Problem Solving: Personally identify and execute fixes for deep-seated bottlenecks, architectural bugs, and performance issues that impact system stability.
  • Modernize Tooling: Evaluate and integrate emerging AI-powered tools to enhance operational efficiency and developer productivity. Maintain a high bar for execution by mastering AI-augmented coding practices to write, refactor, and deploy code with unprecedented speed and quality.

Architectural Oversight & Quality

  • System Design & Scalability: Lead architectural evaluations and design reviews to ensure systems remain flexible and scalable as the business grows.
  • QA Partnership: Partner effectively with QA to define test strategies, improve automated testing coverage, and ensure a seamless handoff from development to production.
  • Operational Health: Lead incident response and postmortem processes, establishing best practices to prevent recurrence of high-severity issues.
  • Champion Standards: Maintain code quality, organization, and automation across the broader engineering organization.

Mentorship & Cultural Impact

  • Technical Multiplier: Elevate the engineers around you through rigorous code reviews, design feedback, and modeling mature, thoughtful engineering judgment.
  • Lead Technical Discussions: Move teams to decisions, ensuring the best ideas surface regardless of where they originate.
  • Foster Accountability: Champion a culture of quality, where engineers take pride in end-to-end ownership, technical excellence, and proficiency in leveraging AI tools.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with a demonstrated track record of leading and executing technically complex, high-impact initiatives from inception through delivery.
  • Recent experience working on a small, agile team contributing to all phases of the software development lifecycle in a start-up environment.
  • Primary experience in Go, comfortable working across existing .NET and TypeScript codebases.
  • Experience implementing event-driven architecture within microservices ecosystems using tools like Apache Kafka.
  • Experience creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, and algorithms.
  • Strong experience with AWS platforms, including an understanding of their capabilities and limitations.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks.
  • Proven ability to operate across organizational lines, you are comfortable influencing without authority, building consensus among diverse teams, and driving decisions that require alignment across product, engineering, and business stakeholders.
  • Deep software engineering fundamentals, with experience in multi-product architectures.
  • Experience working in an environment shaped by acquisitions or rapid growth, with an appreciation for the technical and cultural complexity that comes with it.
  • A track record of making well-reasoned technical decisions, you evaluate options carefully, push back on the first solution when a better one exists.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills. Able to clearly communicate to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A bias for ownership, you take projects seriously from start to finish, hold yourself accountable for outcomes, and proactively identify and resolve risk before it becomes a problem.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a builder's mindset: you thrive when the path forward isn't defined, and you enjoy working through complexity, solving tough problems, and enabling others to move faster.

At JobGet, we’re looking for people who see themselves in our Values. If you have made a measurable impact in your career and are known for your grit and curiosity, we encourage you to apply.

Please only apply to one position with JobGet; we regularly cross-reference submitted resumes for other open roles.We look forward to hearing from you. We look forward to hearing from you.

Benefits & Rewards

  • Purpose-driven organization
  • Savings Fund (Fondo de Ahorro) Bonus
  • 30 Day El Aguinaldo
  • 20 Days of PTO
  • Remote-first
  • Flexible work hours - our employees are in multiple time zones
  • Medical coverage
  • Parental leave
Applications identified as AI-generated will be auto-rejected.

Domain & Functional Leadership

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Mission Data & AI Business Analyst to define reporting requirements, key performance indicators, business rules, data needs, and acceptance criteria for artificial intelligence, data analysis, and business intelligence capabilities supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Mission Data & AI Business Analyst to define reporting requirements, key performance indicators, business rules, data needs, and acceptance criteria for artificial intelligence, data analysis, and business intelligence capabilities supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

This position will work with Government mission owners, users, data professionals, developers, testers, and technical leadership to translate operational needs into traceable requirements and measurable outcomes. The Mission Data & AI Business Analyst will analyze mission data, map current and future workflows, prioritize AI use cases, identify appropriate human-review checkpoints, and coordinate user acceptance testing.

The analyst will also support requirements for governed data ingestion, AI-ready datasets, data warehouse capabilities, analytical models, dashboards, and self-service reporting. The successful candidate must be able to connect technical capabilities to mission value while ensuring that requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, test results, and implementation outcomes remain traceable.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Mission Data & AI Business Analyst will:

  • Elicit, analyze, document, validate, and manage mission, business, data, reporting, and AI requirements.
  • Translate Government and user needs into business requirements, user stories, process models, business rules, and measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Define key performance indicators, operational metrics, reporting requirements, and success measures for AI, data analysis, and business intelligence capabilities.
  • Map current-state and future-state workflows to identify inefficiencies, automation opportunities, data dependencies, decision points, and required human-review checkpoints.
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI use cases based on mission value, feasibility, data availability, operational risk, and expected impact.
  • Define the data needed to support AI use cases, analytical models, automation, dashboards, reports, and informed decision-making.
  • Help define requirements for training, validation, and testing datasets used to develop or evaluate AI and analytical models.
  • Support requirements for centralized data ingestion, data transformation, data governance, data quality, metadata, and AI-ready data architectures.
  • Collaborate with data engineering and technical teams on data warehouse, extract-transform-load, data modeling, and data integration requirements.
  • Define requirements and acceptance criteria for dashboards, analytical tools, data visualizations, and self-service reporting capabilities.
  • Analyze mission and operational data to identify trends, performance gaps, risks, opportunities, and actionable insights.
  • Establish and maintain traceability among mission needs, business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, test cases, defects, and delivered capabilities.
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing with Government mission owners and representative users.
  • Develop or support user acceptance test plans, scenarios, scripts, test data, expected results, and evaluation criteria.
  • Facilitate test-readiness reviews, user testing sessions, results analysis, defect triage, and acceptance decisions.
  • Document test results, user feedback, unresolved issues, corrective actions, and final acceptance status.
  • Evaluate whether AI-generated outputs and analytical products meet documented customer expectations, accuracy standards, and human-review requirements.
  • Support safeguards for AI-enabled processes, including output validation, operational-risk controls, appropriate human oversight, and escalation paths.
  • Measure mission impact following implementation and compare delivered outcomes with established KPIs, baselines, and expected benefits.
  • Present findings, requirements, recommendations, risks, and performance results to Government stakeholders and program leadership.
  • Coordinate with Agile delivery teams to refine and prioritize backlog items, clarify requirements, resolve questions, and support sprint demonstrations and reviews.
  • Maintain requirements, process documentation, decision logs, meeting records, traceability artifacts, and other program documentation.
  • Support continuous improvement by incorporating user feedback, analytical findings, testing results, and lessons learned into future requirements and backlog priorities.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all the following requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, business, or a related field, or a permitted equivalent.
  • Minimum of eight years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience performing requirements analysis for complex business, data, or technology initiatives.
  • Experience developing and managing user stories and measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Experience maintaining requirements traceability throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Experience defining reporting requirements, key performance indicators, business rules, and data requirements.
  • Experience analyzing mission, operational, business, or program data.
  • Experience coordinating or supporting user acceptance testing.
  • Experience mapping business processes or operational workflows.
  • Experience working with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate mission needs into implementable requirements.
  • Business analysis or Agile certification.
  • Ability to evaluate and prioritize AI or automation use cases based on mission value, feasibility, risk, and data requirements.
  • Ability to define appropriate human-review checkpoints and acceptance measures for AI-enabled workflows.
  • Ability to communicate complex data, AI, and technical concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Strong written communication, facilitation, analytical, and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • Advanced or additional business analysis certification, such as CBAP, PMI-PBA, or a comparable credential.
  • Additional Agile certification, such as Certified ScrumMaster, Professional Scrum Master, or PMI Agile Certified Practitioner.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense programs.
  • Experience working with AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, or agent-based solutions.
  • Experience defining requirements for AI training, validation, or testing datasets.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles, AI output validation, model-performance monitoring, model drift, and controls intended to reduce inaccurate or unsupported outputs.
  • Experience with data governance, data quality, metadata management, data warehouses, or extract-transform-load processes.
  • Experience developing requirements for business intelligence platforms, dashboards, data visualizations, or self-service reporting.
  • Experience with Microsoft Power BI, including familiarity with data models, dashboard design, or Data Analysis Expressions.
  • Familiarity with DoD Impact Level 4 environments or comparable controlled-data environments.
  • Experience using requirements, backlog, and traceability tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience measuring operational benefits, user adoption, mission impact, or return on technology investments.

Skills

  • Business and mission requirements analysis.
  • AI use-case evaluation and prioritization.
  • Data and reporting requirements definition.
  • KPI and performance-measure development.
  • Workflow and business-process mapping.
  • User-story and acceptance-criteria development.
  • Requirements traceability.
  • User acceptance testing coordination.
  • Data analysis and interpretation.
  • Stakeholder facilitation and consensus building.
  • Clear technical and executive-level communication.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation quality.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders, priorities, and technical workstreams.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
