jobs.description:
About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will keep the development team building a federal agency's filer application system on schedule, on scope, and ahead of its risks. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a remote position. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Your first project will likely have you running delivery for the team building the application that carries a federal agency's filer applications from submission to decision, built in Python on Amazon Web Services (AWS). Depending on the assignment, you may:

  • Own the schedule: build and maintain the integrated plan, track milestones and dependencies, and see slippage early enough to do something about it.
  • Run the Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives, with a backlog the team and the product owner both trust.
  • Manage risks and issues: keep the risk register current, drive each issue to an owner and a date, and escalate what the team cannot resolve on its own.
  • Report status that leadership can act on: weekly reports, sprint metrics, and briefings that state progress, risks, and decisions needed without dressing them up.
  • Track outcomes, not only activity: measure whether each release improves how quickly and accurately the agency processes its filer applications.

You help deliver a secure, automated system that carries filings from submission to decision, on a schedule a regulated federal program can rely on.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of project management experience on software development projects
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Running Agile delivery: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives
  • Building and maintaining project schedules, including milestones, dependencies, and the critical path
  • Risk and issue management, including maintaining a risk register and driving mitigation
  • Status reporting to client and internal leadership, in writing and in briefings
  • Agile tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps, and scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project or Smartsheet
  • Working with developers, testers, and product owners to plan releases and manage scope
  • Enough technical fluency in software and cloud delivery to judge estimates, dependencies, and release risk with the engineers
  • Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
  • Agile certification, such as Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP)
  • Managing delivery of cloud applications on AWS
  • Managing delivery of document-processing or case-management systems
  • Federal information technology experience, including contract deliverables and reporting
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted project management tooling

Who you are

You keep a team moving without getting in its way. You know where every piece of work stands and what could stop it, you raise a risk while there is still time to act on it, and you tell leadership what is true rather than what is comfortable. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What you bring

  • Delivery discipline: a schedule that reflects reality, milestones that mean something, and dependencies tracked before they bite.
  • Agile practice that serves the team: ceremonies that are short, useful, and end in decisions.
  • Risk judgment: telling a risk that needs escalation from one the team can absorb, and acting on the difference.
  • Status reporting that is accurate, brief, and clear about what is needed from whom.
  • Clear communication with developers, testers, product owners, and client stakeholders, so that scope and priorities are understood the same way by everyone.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $100,000 to $140,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What we offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What we commit to

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

jobs.excerpt: Why WarriorBabe?  At WarriorBabe, we believe in the power of dedication and personal growth.
jobs.description:
Why WarriorBabe?

At WarriorBabe, we believe in the power of dedication and personal growth. You'll be surrounded by a vibrant team that shares your passion for fitness and helping women flourish. Together, we are on a mission to transform lives and create a community that thrives on empowerment.

Offering personalized macronutrient plans and workout programming, WarriorBabe ensures each woman's unique needs are met. With one-on-one coaching, a dedicated mobile app, and a vibrant online community, WarriorBabe provides the tools and support necessary for lasting success. Ideal for women of all ages and fitness levels, WarriorBabe adapts to ensure continuous progress and achievement of fitness goals.

Our Mission

Help 100,000 women regain their personal power and feel confident in their skin.

About the role

WarriorBabe is seeking an Analytics Engineer who can own the reliability and performance of our Supabase/PostgreSQL database and turn business data into clear, actionable insights.

You will maintain data integrations and refresh processes, develop reliable data models, and build useful Metabase dashboards. You will also work directly with leadership and business teams to investigate performance, explain what is driving results, identify opportunities, and recommend measurable actions.

You will help evaluate and improve our data architecture as the business evolves. We welcome recommendations grounded in business needs, reliability, performance, maintainability, and cost.

Success means keeping the data accurate, current, and well documented—and using it to help the business make better decisions.

Key Responsibilites

Database ownership and performance

  • Manage and improve our Supabase/PostgreSQL reporting database, including tables, views, materialized views, indexes, and SQL queries.
  • Diagnose slow queries, blocking, failed refreshes, and resource bottlenecks; use evidence to prioritize improvements.
  • Maintain appropriate permissions, review schema changes, and support backup and recovery readiness.
  • Plan and validate database changes with clear dependency checks, migration steps, and rollback procedures.
  • Evaluate the existing architecture and recommend practical improvements while preserving reporting continuity.

Data integrations and n8n

  • Build, maintain, and troubleshoot production n8n workflows used for data ingestion, synchronization, and reporting.
  • Maintain Fivetran connections and custom API integrations, with clear ownership of each source, writer, destination, and downstream dependency.
  • Work with CRM, ERM, and other business systems as required.
  • Handle authentication, pagination, rate limits, duplicate events, partial failures, retries, and safe backfills.
  • Monitor actual data delivery and freshness, including failures that may be hidden behind a successful workflow or scheduler status.

Data modeling and reporting reliability

  • Develop reusable SQL models with clear record definitions, keys, relationships, and treatment of historical changes.
  • Maintain agreed definitions for revenue, clients, conversion, refunds, renewals, retention, and other business metrics.
  • Reconcile reporting with its underlying sources and distinguish missing data from a verified zero.
  • Prevent duplicate counts and inconsistent totals across dashboards, including differences caused by dates, time zones, attribution, or counting rules.
  • Document data lineage, metric definitions, refresh behavior, known limitations, and operating procedures.

Metabase dashboards

  • Build and maintain Metabase dashboards, saved questions, filters, and record-level drill-throughs.
  • Translate stakeholder questions into reporting that supports a specific business decision.
  • Verify saved configuration and the dashboard users actually see, including filters, totals, drill-throughs, and links to operational records.
  • Maintain documentation alongside analytical dashboards and preserve dependent reports when making changes.

Business analysis and insights

  • Proactively analyze acquisition, sales conversion, revenue, refunds, renewals, retention, and coaching performance.
  • Investigate performance changes by relevant cohorts, products, channels, teams, and time periods.
  • Distinguish business changes from data-quality problems and clearly separate evidence, hypotheses, and remaining uncertainty.
  • Present findings with their business impact, recommended action, and a practical way to measure the result.
  • Partner with business owners to evaluate whether actions taken improved outcomes.

AI-assisted development and analysis

  • Use AI tools such as Claude or OpenAI to accelerate SQL development, data modeling, n8n workflow design, troubleshooting, documentation, and business analysis.
  • Use AI to explore patterns, develop hypotheses, review queries and calculations, and identify potential errors or edge cases.
  • Validate AI-generated code, calculations, and conclusions against source data and reproducible checks before deploying changes or presenting findings.
  • Protect confidential information and protected health information (PHI) when using AI, following company policies and using approved tools.

Qualifications

  • Hands-on ownership of a production PostgreSQL or Supabase database, including troubleshooting and performance optimization.
  • Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregation, query plans, and indexing.
  • Practical experience building and troubleshooting production n8n workflows. Be prepared to explain a workflow you personally implemented and how it handled failures.
  • Experience with API integrations, webhooks, authentication, pagination, rate limits, and reliable synchronization.
  • Experience with Metabase or a comparable BI platform, with the ability to work hands-on in Metabase.
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate business performance, quantify findings, and recommend actions.
  • Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude or OpenAI to build, improve, analyze, and check work, with the ability to explain and independently verify the results.
  • Ability to explain technical issues and business conclusions clearly to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience using Git and maintaining clear technical documentation and controlled production changes.

Preferred Experience

  • Working knowledge of HIPAA and the privacy and security considerations involved in handling protected health information (PHI) across databases, integrations, and reporting.
  • CRM and ERM data structures, relationships, and integrations.
  • Fivetran configuration and monitoring.
  • Payment, subscription, refund, renewal, or customer-retention reporting.
  • Python or JavaScript for scripting and automation.
  • Experience with Metabase for understanding and reconciling existing reports.

What Success Looks Like

  • Business teams can understand what key metrics mean and trace results to supporting records.
  • Data integrations and reporting refreshes operate within agreed freshness and completeness expectations, with actionable monitoring.
  • Database and dashboard improvements have documented validation and preserve dependent reporting.
  • Leadership receives useful explanations and recommendations, with follow-up on the actions taken.
  • Architecture recommendations include their benefits, tradeoffs, costs, and a practical implementation path.

Why Join Us

  • Fully remote work with flexibility and Eastern Time overlap.
  • Ownership across the database, integrations, reporting, and business analysis.
  • Direct collaboration with business leaders and the opportunity to influence decisions.
  • An environment that values precision, clear communication, and practical improvements.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Linux Engineer
jobs.excerpt: If you're an Embedded / Firmware Engineer who is just as comfortable on a Linux board as on a microcontroller, and you know that a boot hang or a flaky BLE connection is rarely "just a software bug," we'd love to talk.
jobs.description:
If you're an Embedded / Firmware Engineer who is just as comfortable on a Linux board as on a microcontroller, and you know that a boot hang or a flaky BLE connection is rarely "just a software bug," we'd love to talk.

We're looking for a freelancer with a strong embedded foundation: C/C++, hardware-aware debugging, and real embedded Linux experience (Yocto or Buildroot, U-Boot, kernel, device tree, drivers). The role is not tied to one platform: depending on the project, you might work on a Cortex-A SoC, a Raspberry Pi-class board, or a Cortex-M microcontroller next to it.

You'd join us on a freelance, time & material basis: you're paid for the hours you actually work on real client projects. We're ready to start right away. The first three months are about getting to know each other, and if it works, we'd love to bring you into our core team with a fixed salary and the full benefits package. Not a promise, a real possibility we actively root for.

About intent

We've been designing and co-creating connected devices since 2008. Wearables, smart audio, health-tech hardware, and IoT products for clients like Oura, BOSE, Neurable, and McIntosh. We're a 60+ person, fully remote team that works at the intersection of physical and digital products.

At intent, firmware is not treated as an isolated layer. It sits right in the middle of hardware, mobile, cloud, QA, and product decisions. That means you'll work with people who care about what actually happens on the device, not just what the ticket said should happen.

Who this role is NOT for

If you only want to be handed a perfectly written spec, disappear for two weeks, and return with a pull request, we're probably not your people.

Embedded work at intent means dealing with real-world constraints: imperfect hardware, changing client needs, boards that boot on the bench and not in the enclosure, radios that behave differently in the lab than in the field, power trade-offs, vendor BSPs, datasheets, errata, and edge cases that don't always show up on day one.

We're looking for someone who asks "why?" before jumping into implementation, who can read a schematic and question it, and who understands that "it works on my desk" is not the same as "it works in the product."

Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional experience in embedded or firmware development.

  • Strong hands-on experience with C / C++ for embedded systems.

  • Hands-on experience with embedded Linux build systems such as Yocto Project or Buildroot.

  • Good understanding of the Linux kernel, device drivers, and the device tree.

  • CI/CD experience for embedded projects (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).

  • Experience with bootloaders, particularly U-Boot.

  • Experience with embedded constraints: timing, memory, peripherals, boot time, and power consumption.

  • Ability to debug firmware and hardware-adjacent problems using practical tools: JTAG/SWD, serial logs, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes.

  • Comfort reading schematics, datasheets, technical documentation, and errata.

  • Familiarity with common embedded interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, GPIO, or similar.

  • Proficiency with Bash and/or Python for automation and testing.

  • Solid Git skills and comfort collaborating on GitHub: pull requests, code reviews, shared repos.

  • Good command of written and spoken English, minimum B2.

  • Ownership, self-reliance, and responsibility for assigned work.

  • Clear communication, with engineers, PMs, QA, and clients.

  • A problem-solving mindset over line-counting.

Nice to have

  • Experience with different platforms (even exotic ones).

  • Embedded Linux toolchains, drivers, and user-space apps.

  • Experience with microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M) and RTOS such as FreeRTOS or Zephyr.

  • Bluetooth / BLE beyond the basics: GATT design, pairing and bonding, connection parameters, throughput and power trade-offs, and secure OTA/DFU.

  • Networking: TCP/IP, Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and IoT protocols such as MQTT.

  • Multimedia and audio: GStreamer, V4L2, ALSA, I2S, codecs, graphics acceleration.

  • Security: Secure Boot, OP-TEE, TrustZone, encrypted filesystems, cryptography.

  • Sensor integration (IMU, PPG, biosignals) and power profiling.

  • Containerization on embedded devices (e.g., Docker).

  • A portfolio of personal projects on a GitHub or GitLab profile.

What you'll do

  • Design, develop, and maintain a custom embedded Linux distribution using Yocto or Buildroot.

  • Bring up new hardware platforms, working closely with the hardware team to debug issues from schematics to software.

  • Develop and maintain the BSP and bootloaders (e.g., U-Boot), and customize the Linux kernel, including writing and debugging drivers (e.g., I2C, SPI, UART, MIPI-CSI/DSI).

  • Write robust, efficient C/C++ code for system services and applications.

  • Optimize system performance: boot time, memory usage, and power consumption.

  • Implement and maintain system security features such as Secure Boot and encrypted filesystems.

  • Debug firmware and hardware-adjacent issues using JTAG/SWD, serial logs, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and vendor tooling.

  • Collaborate with hardware, mobile, QA, backend, product, and client-side engineering teams to solve cross-functional device problems.

  • Participate in requirements discussions, technical planning, architecture decisions, estimations, and delivery planning.

  • Test firmware releases, investigate issues found during development or QA, and maintain technical documentation.

  • Share knowledge and contribute to better engineering practices within our Firmware & Hardware chapter.

How we work

Fully remote. We have an office in Warsaw. The team operates between 10:00 and 18:00 CET, and that's when most meetings happen. Depending on the project, occasional evening calls with US-based clients (up to ~20:00) may happen, always scheduled in advance, never a surprise. You'll be part of the Firmware & Hardware chapter for knowledge-sharing, and simultaneously on a project squad led by a PM for day-to-day delivery.

What we offer

  • 120-180 PLN/h net B2B, depending on your experience

  • Truly flexible hours (most of the team works 10-18 CET, but you organize your day)

  • Fully remote (all Europe)

  • Access to our internal knowledge-sharing: tech talks, experiments, side projects

No sugarcoating: during the freelance period there's no paid leave or medical benefits. Those come with the permanent contract, and we're transparent about that upfront.

Your first weeks

We don't throw you into the deep end on day one. New engineers go through a structured ramp-up period before landing on target projects: you'll work alongside the team, get paired with a technical buddy, and tackle progressively bigger tasks so both sides can see how the collaboration feels. Feedback comes early and often, no one waits three months to tell you something isn't working. We believe in fast, honest signals: if it's great, you'll know. If something needs adjusting, you'll hear about it while there's still time to adjust.

Recruitment process

The entire process is in English. All interviews are recorded for internal evaluation purposes.

  1. HR call (~45 min, casual)

  2. Technical meeting (~90 min, with the technical team)

  3. Final feedback within a few days

About Versapay 🚀

Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage.

With over 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually.
Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!
About the role

Versapay is hiring its first GTM Engineer to remove manual work from the revenue engine, speed up response to inbound demand, and run automated outbound plays for Sales and Marketing. You will design, build and maintain the workflows, integrations and AI agents that connect our GTM systems, with Salesforce as the system of record.

This is a builder role inside Revenue Operations and reports to VP of Revenue Operations. You will own problems end to end: find where reps and marketers lose time, design the fix, ship it, and measure the result. We care about hours given back to the field and faster pipeline, not about how many tools/workflows you deploy.

What you'll do

    Speed to lead and inbound orchestration
  • Own the inbound path from form fill or meeting request to first rep touch, and cut response time to minutes.
  • Build lead-to-account matching, qualification and routing logic, with clear SLAs and alerts when they are missed.
  • Design and automate instant follow-up: rep notifications, meeting booking, and context-rich handoffs so reps know who they are talking to before they call.
    • Automated plays for Sales and Marketing
  • In partnership with marketing design signal-based plays, for example website visits from target accounts, product or event engagement, job changes of known champions, and renewal or expansion triggers.
  • Turn each signal into an action: a task, an alert, a sequence enrollment or an account brief for the right owner.
  • Partner with Marketing on campaign follow-up, event lead processing and nurture handoffs so no lead sits untouched.
    • Eliminating manual work
  • Map where reps, SDRs, marketers and CSMs spend time on low-value tasks, and rank fixes by hours saved.
  • Automate CRM hygiene: field completion, duplicate prevention, activity capture and stage-change requirements.
  • Build AI-assisted workflows such as pre-call account research, call summaries written back to Salesforce, follow-up email drafts and deal-risk flags.
    • Data and enrichment
  • Improve coverage and accuracy of account and contact data using our current data sources.
  • Support the evaluation if we choose a dedicated enrichment and orchestration platform (for example Clay), and lead its rollout if approved.
    • Systems, integrations and governance
  • Support integrations between Salesforce, marketing automation, sales engagement, conversation intelligence and other GTM tools, using APIs, webhooks and workflow platforms.
  • Work within Salesforce data-model and change-control standards set with the Salesforce admin team.
  • Document every workflow: what it does, what it writes, who owns it and how to turn it off.

What you'll bring

    Required
  • 4+ years in a technical GTM role such as GTM engineering, RevOps systems, marketing ops engineering or sales ops automation at a B2B SaaS company.
  • Deep working knowledge of Salesforce: objects, fields, flows, validation rules, and how lead, contact, account and opportunity data relate.
  • Hands-on experience building production workflows in at least one automation platform, such as n8n, Workato, Make, Zapier or Tray.
  • Comfort with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and authentication; able to read API docs and connect two systems without vendor help.
  • Working scripting skills in Python or JavaScript, and basic SQL.
  • Practical experience using LLMs in workflows: prompt design, structured outputs, testing for accuracy, and knowing when not to use AI.
  • A track record of shipping automations that measurably saved time or improved conversion, with numbers to show it.
  • Clear written documentation habits and the judgment to build things others can maintain.
    • Nice to have
  • Experience with Clay or similar enrichment and orchestration tools (Apollo, ZoomInfo workflows, Common Room).
  • Experience with lead routing and scheduling tools such as LeanData or Chili Piper.
  • Experience with intent platforms, such as 6sense or Demandbase
  • Familiarity with marketing automation (ex., HubSpot) and sales engagement platforms (Outreach, Salesloft, Gong Engage).
  • Exposure to a data warehouse and reverse ETL (ex., Snowflake).
  • Experience in a PE-backed or fast-scaling SaaS company, or in fintech, payments or AR/AP software.

How we'll measure success

    Success means faster pipeline and fewer manual hours, measured against a baseline set in your first 30 days.

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.

If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

The Role

We're looking for a Data Engineer to own the data infrastructure behind all of Scale Media's brands. You'll build and run the pipelines that bring together data from Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Meta, Google Ads, Klaviyo, and Odoo, etc. and make sure the teams who rely on that data can trust it.

You'll join our existing engineering team as its dedicated data specialist. That means real ownership: you'll set the direction for how we model, move, govern, and use data, with engineering teammates around you to build alongside.

Most of your time will go to data engineering. You'll also be a thought partner on key cross-functional projects, most notably Odoo, which our inventory team uses for inventory management. There, you'll help plan upgrades, design integrations, and keep its data flowing cleanly into the rest of our stack. This is a hands-on builder role for someone who enjoys solving messy data problems and turning them into reliable systems.

What You'll Own

Data Architecture & Pipelines:

  • Own and optimize the company's data architecture and ETL/ELT pipelines, including scheduling, orchestration, and monitoring with tools like Airflow and dbt.
  • Maintain, optimize, and expand our hosting infrastructure and scripts as data volume and use cases grow.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across every source system, so reporting and decisions rest on numbers people trust.

Integrations & Data Connectors:

  • Maintain API integrations and data connectors with platforms including Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Meta, Google Ads, Klaviyo, etc.
  • Scope and build new data integrations as the business adds tools, channels, and brands.

Odoo Partnership:

  • Act as the go-to technical partner for Odoo, supporting our inventory team on Odoo-related initiatives.
  • Help plan and execute Odoo upgrades with minimal disruption to day-to-day inventory operations.
  • Design, build, and maintain integrations and ETL processes between Odoo and our other internal and external systems.

Data Governance & Documentation:

  • Oversee data governance, access controls, and security practices that protect our systems and customer data from breaches.
  • Document configurations, integrations, and data flows so the rest of the team can understand and build on them.
  • Act as a thought partner to analytics and marketing teams to define, standardize, and maintain business-critical KPIs across all data models and reporting layers.

AI/ML & Automation:

  • Implement AI/ML-driven solutions for data enrichment, anomaly detection, forecasting, and process automation.
  • Continuously review data workflows and performance, and find new ways to use data to make the business run more efficiently.
  • Ownership and setup of MCP connection to the data warehouse to allow users access to data through LLM

What You Bring

  • Strong SQL and Python skills, with hands-on experience building and maintaining production data pipelines.
  • Experience with modern orchestration and transformation tools such as Airflow and dbt, and with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar).
  • Hands-on experience with Odoo, including working with its data model, building integrations, and supporting or executing version upgrades.
  • Experience working with Shopify data and APIs, and integrating ecommerce and marketing platforms such as Amazon Seller Central, Meta, Google Ads, or Klaviyo.
  • Comfort managing cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar) and the scripts and jobs that run on it.
  • A solid grasp of data governance, security, and access-control practices.
  • Clear documentation habits and the ability to explain data systems to non-technical teammates.
  • 3–5 years of experience in data engineering or a closely related role. Strong backgrounds include:
  • Data engineers at DTC or ecommerce brands who have owned the full stack from source to warehouse
  • ERP or Odoo developers who have grown into broader data engineering and pipeline work
  • Analytics engineers who have taken on infrastructure, orchestration, and integration ownership

Preferred, But Not Required

  • Experience in DTC, consumer subscription, supplements, or wellness.
  • Experience building custom Odoo modules in Python.
  • Hands-on work applying AI/ML to forecasting, anomaly detection, or data enrichment.
  • Familiarity with inventory, supply chain, or demand-planning data.
